source.name: 中道MajjhimaPatipada
source.title: 阿姜曼自述他曾连续五百世投生为猎狗的原因｜四恶道成因｜隆普贴圆寂后“隐民（与人类最接近的一种鬼）”集体搬家的奇闻（全篇）

words.title: 没有觉性就是累积痴
words.titleEn: Without Self-Awareness, You Pile Up Delusion

detail.meaning: 念、觉知（中文书和开示里也常译作“觉性”），是心记得、知道当下自己的身体或心在做什么的那个能力。它不是思考，而是心自己清楚地知道；有了觉性，才能看到烦恼和心的变化。常说“有觉性”“觉性要常常生起”。

compare.diff: สติ是知道、记得当下；สมาธิ是心稳定安住不动。

senses.use: 修行中指记得、觉察当下的心的功能，如 มีสติ、สติ สำคัญ
日常指神志清楚、有知觉，如 หมดสติ（失去意识）、ได้สติ（回过神来）
指冷静、不冲动的头脑，如 ตั้งสติ（定下心神）、เสียสติ（失去理智）

en.meaning: Mindfulness is the mind's ability to remember and know what the body or mind is doing right now. It is not thinking; it is the mind clearly knowing for itself. With mindfulness, a person can see defilements and the changes in the mind, so it is often said that mindfulness should arise often.

senses.use: In practice, the mind's ability to remember and notice the present moment, as in มีสติ or สติสำคัญ.
In daily speech, being awake and aware, as in หมดสติ (lose consciousness) or ได้สติ (come to).
A calm, clear head that does not act on impulse, as in ตั้งสติ (collect oneself) or เสียสติ (lose one's mind).

compare.diff: สติ is knowing and remembering the present moment, while สมาธิ is the mind staying steady and settled.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

words.title: 整天不停地觉知自己
words.titleEn: Be Aware of Yourself All Day Long

detail.meaning: 修行中最常用的词，意思是心清楚地知道自己此刻的身体、心在做什么，而不是迷失在妄念里。它是修行的基础，要一整天常常去做。用法如“รู้สึกตัวไว้”（保持觉知自己）。

compare.diff: รู้สึกตัว是知道自己；ลืมตัวเอง是心跑掉、没有觉知自己。

senses.use: 修行中指觉察到身心当下的状态，如 รู้สึกตัว ทั้งวัน
指从昏迷、睡梦中恢复知觉，如 คนไข้ รู้สึกตัว แล้ว

en.meaning: To be aware of oneself means the mind clearly knows what the body and mind are doing at this moment, instead of being lost in wandering thoughts. It is the basis of practice and is meant to be done often throughout the day. It is commonly used as an instruction, such as รู้สึกตัวไว้ (keep being aware of yourself).

senses.use: In practice, noticing the present state of body and mind, as in รู้สึกตัวทั้งวัน.
Coming back to awareness from unconsciousness or sleep, as in คนไข้รู้สึกตัวแล้ว.

compare.diff: รู้สึกตัว is clearly knowing oneself, while ลืมตัวเอง is the mind having wandered off with no awareness of oneself.

parts.note: ว 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel

words.title: 每一天都用心修行
words.titleEn: Practice Wholeheartedly Every Day

detail.meaning: 指做事一直持续、规律、不间断。常用来劝人修行要天天做、长期做，不是想起才做一下。

senses.use: 指一直保持、不间断地做，如 ทำ ให้ สม่ำเสมอ
指平整、一致、没有起伏，如 หายใจ สม่ำเสมอ

en.meaning: This word means doing something steadily, regularly and without breaks. It is often used to urge people to practice every day over the long term, rather than only when they happen to remember.

senses.use: Continuing to do something regularly without stopping, as in ทำให้สม่ำเสมอ.
Smooth and uniform without ups and downs, as in หายใจสม่ำเสมอ.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.noteEn: ำ reads am. ม follows the ส before it and takes the low tone

parts.noteEn: เ is written before ส but read after ม. ม follows ส and takes the rising tone

words.title: 学得慢就要忍耐
words.titleEn: If You Learn Slowly, Have Patience

detail.meaning: 忍耐、耐得住，遇到困难、进步慢或不舒服时仍坚持下去。学得慢的人要靠这个，不断地学、不断地练。

senses.use: 指面对困难、不适时撑住不放弃，如 อดทน ฝึก

en.meaning: Patience means enduring and holding on when things are hard, progress is slow, or something is uncomfortable. It is used to encourage someone who learns slowly to keep studying and practicing without giving up.

senses.use: Staying the course through difficulty or discomfort without giving up, as in อดทนฝึก.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; ด as a final reads t.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 没有谁一开始就很棒
words.titleEn: No One Is Good from the Start

detail.meaning: 本意是做生意的本钱、资本。在讲法中借来比喻每个人过去积累下来的修行基础，各人不一样，所以进步的快慢也不同。

senses.use: 指已有的基础、资本或条件，如 ต้นทุน ไม่ เท่ากัน
指做生意或生产的花费，如 ต้นทุน การผลิต

en.meaning: Literally, this is the capital a business starts with. In Dhamma talks it is used figuratively for the foundation of practice each person has built up in the past. Because this differs from person to person, people progress at different speeds.

senses.use: The foundation, resources or conditions someone already has, as in ต้นทุนไม่เท่ากัน.
The expense of doing business or producing something, as in ต้นทุนการผลิต.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 禅定要修对也要够
words.titleEn: Practice Concentration Right, and Enough

detail.meaning: 定，指心稳定、安住、不乱跑。特别强调要是“正确的定”，也就是心有觉知地安住，而不是呆住或被定力吸进去、不知道自己。

compare.diff: สมาธิ是心稳住不动；สติ是心记得并知道当下。

senses.use: 指心安住、专一的状态，如 ทำ สมาธิ、เข้า สมาธิ
日常指集中精神做事，如 ไม่ มี สมาธิ เรียน

en.meaning: Concentration is the mind being steady, settled and not wandering. It stresses that it should be right concentration, where the mind rests with awareness, not a dull blankness or being sucked into a calm state without knowing oneself.

senses.use: In practice, the mind resting steadily and with one focus, as in ทำสมาธิ or เข้าสมาธิ.
In daily speech, putting one's attention on a task, as in ไม่มีสมาธิเรียน.

compare.diff: สมาธิ is the mind staying steady and still, while สติ is the mind remembering and knowing the present moment.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

words.title: 心没有真的安住
words.titleEn: The Mind Isn't Really Firmly Established

detail.meaning: 指心稳稳地安住、立在那里，是觉知的、不被念头拉走的状态。讲正确的定时常用“心ตั้งมั่น”，心一跑出去就不再ตั้งมั่น。

senses.use: 修行中指心稳定地停在一处、不动摇，如 จิต ตั้งมั่น
指意志、决心稳固不动摇，如 ตั้งมั่น ใน ความ ดี

en.meaning: This describes a mind that stands steady and settled, aware and not pulled away by thoughts. It is often used for right concentration, as in จิตตั้งมั่น. Once the mind wanders off, it is no longer ตั้งมั่น.

senses.use: In practice, the mind staying steady in one place without wavering, as in จิตตั้งมั่น.
Will or determination that is firm and unshaken, as in ตั้งมั่นในความดี.

words.title: 知道方法然后修对
words.titleEn: Know the Method, Then Do It Right

detail.meaning: 修行，就是实际去做，把佛法用在自己的身心上。修行不只是打坐，日常生活中除了睡觉和必须动脑工作的时间，其余时间都可以修。

senses.use: 佛法中指实际修习，如 ปฏิบัติ ธรรม、การ ปฏิบัติ
一般指照规定、指示去做，如 ปฏิบัติ ตาม กฎ
指对人的态度与做法，如 ปฏิบัติ ต่อ ผู้อื่น

en.meaning: Practice means actually doing it, applying the Dhamma to one's own body and mind. It is not only sitting meditation; apart from sleeping and work that needs thinking, one can practice during the rest of daily life.

senses.use: In Buddhism, actually training in the teachings, as in ปฏิบัติธรรม or การปฏิบัติ.
In general use, following rules or instructions, as in ปฏิบัติตามกฎ.
How one behaves toward other people, as in ปฏิบัติต่อผู้อื่น.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.noteEn: ฏ reads t

parts.note: ต 作尾音读 t，ิ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ต as a final reads t; ิ is silent

words.thai: จุดตั้งต้น
words.title: 觉知自己是修行契入点
words.titleEn: Being Aware of Yourself Is the Starting Point

detail.meaning: 起点、出发点，由“จุด（点）”和“ตั้งต้น（开始）”组成。用来说明觉知自己是修行的起点，从这里才能开始对治烦恼。

senses.use: 指开始的地方或出发点，如 จุดตั้งต้น ของ การ ปฏิบัติ

en.meaning: This means the starting point, made from จุด (point) and ตั้งต้น (to begin). It is used to say that being aware of oneself is where practice begins, and from there one can start dealing with defilements.

senses.use: The place where something begins, as in จุดตั้งต้นของการปฏิบัติ.

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 要努力地去觉知自己
words.titleEn: Make an Effort to Be Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 字面是“忘记自己”，指心被妄念、情绪或外境带走，没有觉知自己的身心。一般人一整天都在这种状态里，所以要练习รู้สึกตัว。

compare.diff: ลืมตัวเอง是迷失、没觉知；รู้สึกตัว是清楚知道自己。

senses.use: 修行中指失去对自己身心的觉知，被念头或情绪带走
日常指忘了自己的身份、分寸而失态

en.meaning: Literally "forgetting oneself", this means the mind has been carried away by thoughts, emotions or outside things and is not aware of one's own body and mind. Ordinary people are in this state most of the day, which is why they need to practice being aware of themselves.

senses.use: In practice, losing awareness of one's body and mind, carried off by thoughts or feelings.
In daily speech, forgetting one's place or manners and behaving improperly.

compare.diff: ลืมตัวเอง is being lost with no awareness, while รู้สึกตัว is clearly knowing oneself.

parts.note: ว是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

words.title: 呼吸时觉知自己
words.titleEn: Be Aware of Yourself While You Breathe

detail.meaning: 呼吸，把气吸进来再呼出去。常说“看见身体在呼吸”，是把呼吸当作身体的活动来觉知，而不是去控制它。

compare.diff: หายใจ 是动作“呼吸”，ลมหายใจ 指呼吸时进出的那股气。

senses.use: 指一呼一吸的整个动作，如 หายใจออก、หายใจเข้า 合起来

en.meaning: To breathe: to draw air in and let it out. In meditation talks it is used for noticing the body breathing as an activity, rather than controlling the breath.

senses.use: The whole act of taking air in and out, as in หายใจออก and หายใจเข้า together.

compare.diff: หายใจ is the action of breathing, while ลมหายใจ is the air that moves in and out.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 呼吸时觉知自己
words.titleEn: Be Aware of Yourself While You Breathe

detail.meaning: 呼气，由 หายใจ（呼吸）加 ออก（出）组成。修行时在呼气时知道身体正在呼气，保持觉知。

compare.diff: 方向相反，หายใจเข้า 是吸进来，หายใจออก 是呼出去。

senses.use: 指把气息从身体呼出去的那一半动作

en.meaning: To breathe out. It is หายใจ (breathe) plus ออก (out). It names the out-going half of the breath, which one can know as the body breathing out.

senses.use: The half of breathing where air leaves the body, as in หายใจออกก็รู้สึกตัว.

compare.diff: It is the opposite direction: หายใจเข้า brings air in, หายใจออก sends it out.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: 第二个อ是元音 aw；ก作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: The second อ is the vowel aw; ก as a final reads k.

words.title: 呼吸时觉知自己
words.titleEn: Be Aware of Yourself While You Breathe

detail.meaning: 吸气，由 หายใจ（呼吸）加 เข้า（进）组成。修行时在吸气时知道身体正在吸气，保持觉知。

compare.diff: 方向相反，หายใจออก 是呼出去，หายใจเข้า 是吸进来。

senses.use: 指把气息吸进身体的那一半动作

en.meaning: To breathe in. It is หายใจ (breathe) plus เข้า (in). It names the in-coming half of the breath, which one can know as the body breathing in.

senses.use: The half of breathing where air enters the body, as in หายใจเข้าก็รู้สึกตัว.

compare.diff: It is the opposite direction: หายใจเข้า brings air in, หายใจออก sends it out.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

words.title: 走神太松苦闷太紧
words.titleEn: Wandering Is Too Loose; Strain Is Too Tight

detail.meaning: 心飘走、走神发呆，人在这里，心却不知道飘到哪里去了。这是觉知太松、失去觉知的状态，和“太紧”是两个极端。

compare.diff: ใจลอย 是太松、心飘走，เคร่ง 是太用力、绷得太紧，两者都不是正确的觉知。

senses.use: 心飘到别处，没有在当下，如 นั่งใจลอย
人坐着出神、呆呆的，没想什么具体的事

en.meaning: A state where the mind floats away from what is happening now, so the person is present but the mind is elsewhere. It describes awareness that is too loose or lost.

senses.use: The mind drifts off from the present, as in นั่งใจลอย or เดินใจลอย.
Sitting blankly, dazed, without thinking of anything in particular.

compare.diff: ใจลอย is too loose, with the mind drifting off, while เคร่ง is too forced and tense; neither is right awareness.

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

words.title: 走神太松苦闷太紧
words.titleEn: Wandering Is Too Loose; Strain Is Too Tight

detail.meaning: 严格、绷紧，指修行时过于用力、板着脸逼自己。这样会变成苦闷紧张，反而不是自然的觉知。

compare.diff: ตึง 指拉得紧、绷得紧的状态，เคร่ง 更偏向对自己要求严、过于认真用力。

senses.use: 修行或做事对自己绷得太严、太用力，如 เดินเคร่ง ๆ
遵守规矩、戒律很严格，如 เคร่งศีล

en.meaning: Strict or rigid. In practice it means being too forceful with oneself, which turns into tension and strain instead of natural awareness. It can also mean being strict about rules.

senses.use: Practising with too much force or stiffness, as in เดินเคร่ง ๆ.
Keeping rules very carefully, as in เคร่งศีล.

compare.diff: เคร่ง leans toward being overly demanding and earnest with oneself, while ตึง is the tight, strained feeling itself.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；有声调符号，这里读短音
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. There is a tone mark, and here the vowel is read short.

words.title: 走神太松苦闷太紧
words.titleEn: Wandering Is Too Loose; Strain Is Too Tight

detail.meaning: 紧、绷紧，像绳子拉得太紧。用来形容修行时心或身体太用力、太紧张，与“松”相对。

compare.diff: เคร่ง 偏指对自己要求太严、太用力，ตึง 是紧绷这个感觉本身。

senses.use: 身心绷得太紧、不放松，如 ตึงเครียด
绳子、肌肉等拉得紧绷，不松弛

en.meaning: Tight or taut, like a rope pulled too hard. It describes a mind or body that is too tense or forced, and is the opposite of loose.

senses.use: Mind or body strained and not relaxed, as in ตึงเครียด.
A rope, muscle or surface pulled tight, not slack.

compare.diff: ตึง is the tight feeling itself, while เคร่ง is more about being too demanding and forceful with oneself.

words.title: 让心和自己在一起
words.titleEn: Keep Your Mind with Yourself

detail.meaning: 本义是身体、个体，也可以指“自己”。รู้สึกตัว（觉知自己）指知道身体和心此刻正在做什么、是什么状态。

compare.diff: ตน 更书面、更庄重，ตัว 是日常口语里的“身、自己”。

senses.use: 指自身，如 รู้สึกตัว（觉知自己）
指人或动物的躯体，如 ตัวเปียก
动物、物件等的量词，如 สุนัขสองตัว

en.meaning: Literally the body or an individual. It also means oneself. In รู้สึกตัว (to be aware of oneself) it refers to knowing what the body and mind are doing right now.

senses.use: Oneself, as in รู้สึกตัว, to be aware of oneself.
The physical body of a person or animal, as in ตัวเปียก.
Counting animals or objects, as in สุนัขสองตัว.

compare.diff: ตน is more formal and written, while ตัว is the everyday spoken word for body or self.

parts.note: ว 是元音 ◌ัว 的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel ◌ัว, not a final consonant

words.title: 身体行住坐卧不停觉知
words.titleEn: Keep Aware of Your Body, Moving or Still

detail.meaning: 身体，指整个身躯。常见于“看见身体在动、在呼吸”这类说法，把身体当作被观察的对象，而不是“我”。

compare.diff: กาย 更短、更偏佛法用语，ร่างกาย 是日常说的整个身体。

senses.use: 指人的肉身、色身，如 เห็นร่างกายหายใจ

en.meaning: The body, the whole physical form. In talks it often appears in phrases like seeing the body move or breathe, treating the body as something observed rather than as "me".

senses.use: The whole physical body, as in เห็นร่างกายหายใจ.

compare.diff: กาย is shorter and more of a Dhamma term, while ร่างกาย is the ordinary word for the whole body.

parts.note: 尾音 ย 读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i

words.thai: เคลื่อนไหว
words.title: 身体行住坐卧不停觉知
words.titleEn: Keep Aware of Your Body, Moving or Still

detail.meaning: 移动、动作，指身体在动。常见于“身体移动、身体静止都要觉知”，也用来说喜欢动的修行方式，如经行、做家务。

compare.diff: 意思相反，เคลื่อนไหว 是在动，หยุดนิ่ง 是停下来不动。

senses.use: 身体动起来、有动作，与静止相对
指事情、团体等有动静、有行动

en.meaning: To move: the body being in motion. It is used for knowing the body whether it moves or is still, and for active kinds of practice such as walking meditation or housework.

senses.use: The body is in motion, the opposite of still, as in ร่างกายเคลื่อนไหว.
A group, event or situation showing activity or action.

compare.diff: They are opposites: เคลื่อนไหว is moving, หยุดนิ่ง is stopping and staying still.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读，อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读，ห不发音只管声调
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it; ห is silent and only sets the tone.

words.title: 身体行住坐卧不停觉知
words.titleEn: Keep Aware of Your Body, Moving or Still

detail.meaning: 停下来不动、静止。指身体停住的状态，常见于“动或不动时都要不停地觉知”这类说法。

compare.thai: เคลื่อนไหว
compare.diff: 意思相反，เคลื่อนไหว 是在动，หยุดนิ่ง 是停住不动。

senses.use: 身体停下来不动，与移动相对

en.meaning: To stop and be still, with no movement. It describes the body when it has stopped moving, and is often paired with moving in the idea of knowing the body in both states.

senses.use: The body has stopped and is not moving, as in ร่างกายหยุดนิ่ง.

compare.thai: เคลื่อนไหว
compare.diff: They are opposites: หยุดนิ่ง is staying still, เคลื่อนไหว is being in motion.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只改声调；ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only changes the tone; ด as a final reads t

words.title: 乐苦生起都要觉知
words.titleEn: Happiness or Suffering Arises: Be Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 指乐、舒服的感受。乐和苦一样，只是身体或心里生起的一种感受，是觉知的对象，不是“我”的乐。有乐生起时只需知道它在，不必抓着它不放。

compare.diff: ความสุข是乐受，ความทุกข์是苦受，两者都只是会来会去的感受。

senses.use: 指乐受、乐的感受，与苦相对（มีความสุข 有乐）
泛指幸福、开心的状态

en.meaning: Happiness is the pleasant, comfortable feeling that arises in the body or the mind. It is the opposite of suffering. In this usage it is simply a feeling that comes and goes, something to be known, not something that belongs to a self or must be held onto.

senses.use: A pleasant feeling in body or mind, as in มีความสุข (to have happiness).
General well-being or a happy state of life.

compare.diff: ความสุข is the pleasant feeling and ความทุกข์ is the unpleasant one; both are feelings that simply come and go.

parts.note: 尾音 ข 读 k
parts.noteEn: Final ข reads k

words.title: 乐苦生起都要觉知
words.titleEn: Happiness or Suffering Arises: Be Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 指某个东西出现、生起。常见于“某某生起了就去觉知”，如乐、苦、贪、嗔生起，强调它们是自己来、自己去的，不是我们造出来的。

senses.use: 指某种心理状态、感受或现象出现、产生（กิเลสเกิดขึ้น）
指事情、事件发生

en.meaning: To arise means that something appears or comes into being. It is used for feelings, defilements and mental states that show up by themselves. The word stresses that they come on their own conditions and are not created by us.

senses.use: A feeling, mental state or defilement appears, as in กิเลสเกิดขึ้น (defilements arise).
An event or incident takes place.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读，ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ด as a final reads t.

words.title: 乐苦生起都要觉知
words.titleEn: Happiness or Suffering Arises: Be Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 作感受讲时，指身体或心里不舒服的苦受，是觉知的对象。它也可指四圣谛中的苦，即心被逼迫、不自在的状态。

compare.diff: ความสุข是舒服的感受，ความทุกข์是不舒服的感受。

senses.use: 指苦受，或佛法所说的苦，与乐相对
泛指难过、烦恼、不好受的状态

en.meaning: Suffering here means the unpleasant feeling in the body or mind, something to be known as it appears. The word can also mean the suffering of the Noble Truths, the mind being oppressed and not at ease, but that is not the meaning in this talk.

senses.use: An unpleasant feeling in body or mind, or the suffering of the Dhamma teaching.
General pain, trouble or unhappiness in everyday speech.

compare.diff: ความทุกข์ is the uncomfortable feeling and ความสุข is the comfortable one.

parts.note: ข์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ข์ is silent

words.title: 贪消失了也要觉知
words.titleEn: Be Aware Even When Greed Disappears

detail.meaning: 贪，指心想要、想得到、粘着不放的烦恼。贪生起时直接觉知它，贪消失了也知道，不用去压制。

compare.diff: โลภ是心想要、想靠近，โกรธ是心排斥、不喜欢。

senses.use: 指想要、渴求的烦恼心（มีความโลภ）
指对财物等贪得无厌、想占有更多

en.meaning: Greed is the defilement of the mind wanting, craving and clinging to get something. When it arises it is simply known, and when it fades that is known too, without suppressing it. It is used for craving in the mind as well as for ordinary greediness for things.

senses.use: A mind that wants and grasps, as in มีความโลภ (there is greed).
Wanting to get or own more and more, especially wealth or possessions.

compare.diff: โลภ is the mind wanting and moving toward something, while โกรธ is the mind rejecting and disliking it.

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在后面读；尾音 ภ 读 p
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it; ภ as a final reads p.

words.title: 贪消失了也要觉知
words.titleEn: Be Aware Even When Greed Disappears

detail.meaning: 生气，是心里不满、排斥而发火的烦恼，属于嗔一类。看到生气生起、又消失，只是觉知它，不用跟它纠缠，也不用压下去。

compare.diff: โกรธ是排斥、不喜欢，โลภ是想要、粘着。

senses.use: 指对人或事发怒、动怒（โกรธเขา）

en.meaning: Anger is the mind being displeased, rejecting something and flaring up. It belongs to the family of aversion. It is known as it arises and fades, without fighting it or pushing it down.

senses.use: Being angry at a person or thing, as in โกรธเขา (angry at him or her).

compare.diff: โกรธ is rejecting and disliking, while โลภ is wanting and clinging.

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在后面读；ธ 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it; ธ as a final reads t.

words.title: 贪消失了也要觉知
words.titleEn: Be Aware Even When Greed Disappears

detail.meaning: 散乱，指心飘来飘去、静不下来，思绪乱飞。可以把它当作一种心的状态，来了就知道，不必赶走。也可以用在日常，形容人心浮、静不下来。

senses.use: 指心飘来飘去、静不下来

en.meaning: Restlessness is the mind drifting about and unable to settle, with thoughts scattering everywhere. It is treated as a state of the mind that is known when it comes, not chased away. In daily speech it also describes a person whose mind is unsettled and flighty.

senses.use: A mind that drifts and cannot settle.

words.title: 不知觉知自己的价值
words.titleEn: Missing the Value of Being Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 迷失，指心跑去想事、被念头或外境带走，却不知道自己在迷失。常与“觉知”相对，能知道自己迷失了，就不再是迷失。

compare.diff: หลง是整个心迷进去、被带走，เผลอ是一时失去觉知、没留意。

senses.use: 指心忘失自己、被念头或境界带走而不自知
指走错方向、找不到路（หลงทาง）
指沉迷、痴迷于某人某物（หลงรัก）

en.meaning: Lost means the mind has gone off into thoughts or is carried away by outside things, without knowing it is lost. It is the opposite of awareness; once one knows one is lost, one is no longer lost. The word is also used for losing one's way and for being infatuated.

senses.use: The mind forgets itself and is carried off by thoughts or objects without knowing it.
Going the wrong way and not finding the path, as in หลงทาง.
Being besotted with someone or something, as in หลงรัก.

compare.diff: หลง is the whole mind being drawn in and lost, while เผลอ is a brief lapse of awareness.

parts.note: ห 不发音只管声调；隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; hidden vowel o

words.title: 不知觉知自己的价值
words.titleEn: Missing the Value of Being Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 指一时疏忽、走神，忘了觉知自己。常用来说心忘记了觉知，跑去想事或看外面，不是什么大错，知道了就回来。

compare.diff: เผลอ偏向一下子没留意，หลง偏向心被带进去、迷在里面。
เพลิน是沉浸在喜欢的事里，เผลอ是单纯失去觉知，不一定有享受。

senses.use: 指心走神、忘了觉知自己，不知不觉飘走
指一时疏忽、不小心做了或说了某事（เผลอพูด）

en.meaning: Absent-minded means a moment of carelessness when awareness of oneself is forgotten and the mind wanders off to think or look outward. It is not a big fault, and once it is noticed the mind simply comes back. In daily speech it also means doing or saying something without meaning to.

senses.use: The mind slips and forgets to be aware, drifting off without noticing.
Doing or saying something by accident, as in เผลอพูด (to blurt out).

compare.diff: เผลอ is a momentary lack of attention, while หลง is the mind being drawn in and lost inside something.
เพลิน has a pleasant, enjoying quality, while เผลอ is just a lapse of awareness and need not be enjoyable.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

words.title: 不知觉知自己的价值
words.titleEn: Missing the Value of Being Aware of Yourself

detail.meaning: 指沉浸在某件事里觉得愉快，玩得入神、忘了时间。心陶醉在念头或外境里就是迷失，虽然觉得舒服，却是不觉知的状态。

compare.diff: เพลิน带着愉快、享受的味道，เผลอ只是没留意。

senses.use: 指沉浸其中、玩得投入而忘了自己（เพลินๆ）

en.meaning: Carried away means being absorbed in something enjoyable so that one forgets oneself and the time. When the mind is carried away by thoughts or outside things, it is lost, even though it feels pleasant. It is a state without awareness.

senses.use: Being absorbed and enjoying something, forgetting oneself, as in เพลินๆ.

compare.diff: เพลิน carries a flavor of pleasure and enjoyment, while เผลอ is only not paying attention.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

words.title: 走神的心非常危险
words.titleEn: A Wandering Mind Is Very Dangerous

detail.meaning: 危险，指可能带来伤害或坏结果的事。用于提醒：心走神、陶醉看似舒服，其实是在累积痴，对修行有害。

senses.use: 指可能造成伤害或损失、不安全

en.meaning: Danger means something that can bring harm or a bad result. It is used here as a warning that a mind which drifts or is carried away may feel comfortable, yet it is building up delusion and harms practice.

senses.use: Something likely to cause harm or loss, or that is unsafe.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: ย 作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i.

words.title: 走神的心非常危险
words.titleEn: A Wandering Mind Is Very Dangerous

detail.meaning: 结果、果报。讲业的时候，指做了善或不善的事（因）之后，到时候成熟现前的结果，比如带着痴死去，果报现前就去投生为畜生。也可以泛指一般的结果、成果。

compare.diff: วิบาก专指业成熟后所受的果报，ผล范围更广，也可指一般结果。

senses.use: 指因而生的结果、果报，如 ส่งผล（果报现前）、ผลของการปฏิบัติ
指树上结的果子，如 ผลไม้、ผลมะม่วง

en.meaning: ผล means a result or outcome that comes from a cause. In talks on kamma, it is the ripened consequence of a good or bad action, such as dying with a deluded mind and the result then taking one to rebirth as an animal. It can also mean any ordinary result, and it is the word for a fruit on a tree.

senses.use: The outcome or consequence of a cause, including the ripening of kamma, as in ส่งผล (the result comes into effect) or ผลของการปฏิบัติ.
A fruit that grows on a tree, as in ผลไม้ or ผลมะม่วง.

compare.diff: วิบาก refers only to the result that kamma gives when it ripens, while ผล is wider and also covers ordinary results.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；ล 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; ล as a final reads n.

words.thai: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน
words.title: 走神的心非常危险
words.titleEn: A Wandering Mind Is Very Dangerous

detail.meaning: 畜生，四恶道之一。带着痴的心死去，果报现前，就会投生到畜生道。用法上指畜生道的众生，不只是普通动物。

compare.diff: สัตว์是泛称的动物或众生，สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน特指畜生道。

senses.use: 指恶道之一的畜生道众生，如 เกิดเป็นสัตว์เดรัจฉาน

en.meaning: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน means an animal, and in Dhamma talks it refers to the animal realm, one of the woeful realms. It is where a being is reborn after dying with a mind full of delusion. It is used for beings of that realm, not just for ordinary animals.

senses.use: Beings of the animal realm, as in เกิดเป็นสัตว์เดรัจฉาน (be born as an animal).

compare.diff: สัตว์ is the general word for an animal or living being, while สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน refers specifically to the animal realm.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

parts.note: จ 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: จ as a final reads t

words.thai: อบาย ภูมิ
words.title: 畜生因痴而生
words.titleEn: Animals Are Born from Delusion

detail.meaning: 恶道，指没有快乐、容易受苦的生存界，共四种：地狱、阿修罗（饿鬼的一类）、饿鬼、畜生。这个词用来提醒心被痴、嗔、贪带着走的危险。

senses.use: 指地狱、阿修罗、饿鬼、畜生这些苦的去处，如 ตกอบายภูมิ

en.meaning: อบาย ภูมิ means the woeful realms, the states of existence where there is little happiness and much suffering. There are four: hell, asura (a kind of hungry ghost), hungry ghost, and animal. The word is used as a warning about where a mind led by delusion, anger and greed can go.

senses.use: The four realms of suffering: hell, asura, hungry ghost and animal, as in ตกอบายภูมิ (fall into the woeful realms).

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a，同时是前一音节的尾音
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a, which is also the final sound of the previous syllable.

parts.note: ิ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ิ is not pronounced as a separate sound

words.title: 畜生因痴而生
words.titleEn: Animals Are Born from Delusion

detail.meaning: 地狱，恶道中受苦最重的一界。带着嗔心死去，容易去投生为地狱众生。

compare.diff: นรก主要由嗔而去，เปรต则多由贪、粘着而去。

senses.use: 指恶道中受苦最重的去处，如 ตกนรก、สัตว์นรก
比喻极痛苦的处境，如 นรกบนดิน

en.meaning: นรก means hell, the realm of the heaviest suffering among the woeful realms. A mind that dies with anger can be reborn there. It is also used figuratively for any extremely painful situation.

senses.use: The realm of the heaviest suffering, as in ตกนรก or สัตว์นรก (a hell being).
A figure of speech for a terribly painful situation, as in นรกบนดิน (hell on earth).

compare.diff: นรก is mainly reached through anger and is a realm of heavy suffering, while เปรต is mainly reached through greed and clinging and is a realm of hunger and dissatisfaction.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 畜生因痴而生
words.titleEn: Animals Are Born from Delusion

detail.meaning: 饿鬼，恶道之一。心里还有贪、有粘着和抓取，死去时就可能去投生为饿鬼。

compare.diff: เปรต是饥渴不满的鬼道，นรก是受苦更重的地狱。

senses.use: 指恶道之一，因贪而饥渴不满的众生，如 เกิดเป็นเปรต

en.meaning: เปรต means a hungry ghost, one of the woeful realms. A mind that still has greed, attachment and grasping at the time of death can be reborn as one. It is a being that is always hungry and never satisfied.

senses.use: A being of the woeful realm of craving and constant hunger, as in เกิดเป็นเปรต (be born a hungry ghost).

compare.diff: เปรต is a realm of hunger and dissatisfaction, while นรก is the hell realm, where the suffering is heavier.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

words.title: 畜生带着痴来出生
words.titleEn: Animals Are Born Carrying Delusion

detail.meaning: 出生、生起。可以说人或众生投生，也可以说心里、身体里的感受或状态生起，比如乐、苦生起了要去觉知。讲法时常用เกิดขึ้น来说法尘在身心里的生灭。

compare.diff: เกิด是生起，ตาย是灭去，两者相对。

senses.use: 指生为某种众生、投生，如 เกิดเป็นสัตว์เดรัจฉาน
指身心的现象出现，如 ความสุขเกิดขึ้นในใจ
指事情出了、发生了，如 เกิดเรื่อง、เกิดอุบัติเหตุ

en.meaning: เกิด means to be born or to arise. It is used for beings being born into a realm, and also for feelings and states arising in the body or mind, such as happiness or suffering arising and being known. In Dhamma talks, เกิดขึ้น is often used for things arising in body and mind.

senses.use: A being is born into a particular state, as in เกิดเป็นสัตว์เดรัจฉาน (be born as an animal).
A feeling or state appears in the body or mind, as in ความสุขเกิดขึ้นในใจ (happiness arises in the mind).
An event takes place, as in เกิดเรื่อง or เกิดอุบัติเหตุ (an accident happens).

compare.diff: เกิด is to arise or be born, while ตาย is to die or pass away, so the two are opposites.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

words.title: 畜生带着痴来出生
words.titleEn: Animals Are Born Carrying Delusion

detail.meaning: 痴，不知道真相、迷糊的烦恼。走神、迷失在念头里，没有觉性，都是在累积痴。

compare.diff: 两者意思很近，โมหะ常指心里痴的状态，อวิชชา指不知四圣谛的根本无明。

senses.use: 指迷失、不明白实相的烦恼，如 สะสมโมหะ

en.meaning: โมหะ means delusion, the defilement of not knowing the truth and being confused. Drifting off, being dazed, or getting lost in thoughts without awareness all build up delusion.

senses.use: The defilement of being lost and not understanding the truth, as in สะสมโมหะ (accumulate delusion).

compare.diff: The two are close in meaning, but โมหะ usually describes the deluded state of the mind, while อวิชชา is the root ignorance of the Four Noble Truths.

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 投生为动物会一直重复
words.titleEn: Being Born as an Animal Keeps Repeating

detail.meaning: 动物，也可指众生。在讲轮回时，多指有情众生，如สัตว์ นรก（地狱众生）。单独用时多指动物，比如野兽。

compare.thai: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน
compare.diff: สัตว์是泛称，สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน特指畜生道的众生。

senses.use: 指飞禽走兽等动物，如 สัตว์ป่า、สัตว์เลี้ยง
指有情识的生命，如 สัตว์นรก、สัตว์โลก

en.meaning: สัตว์ means an animal, and it can also mean a living being. Used alone it usually means an animal such as a wild beast. In talks on rebirth it means a sentient being, as in สัตว์ นรก (a hell being).

senses.use: Animals such as birds and beasts, as in สัตว์ป่า (wild animal) or สัตว์เลี้ยง (pet).
A living being with consciousness, as in สัตว์นรก (hell being) or สัตว์โลก (beings of the world).

compare.thai: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน
compare.diff: สัตว์ is the general word for an animal or being, while สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน refers specifically to the animal realm.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

words.title: 投生为动物会一直重复
words.titleEn: Being Born as an Animal Keeps Repeating

detail.meaning: 放在数字前面，强调数量很多，相当于「足足、整整」。比如 ตั้ง 500 ชาติ，就是「足足五百世」。另外 ตั้งใจ（用心）、ตั้งแต่（从……起）里也有 ตั้ง，但那是别的意思。

senses.use: 放在数量前强调多或久，如 ตั้งสิบปี
指安放、建立、确立，如 ตั้งใจ、ตั้งชื่อ
指时间或起点，如 ตั้งแต่แรก（从一开始）

en.meaning: ตั้ง placed before a number stresses that the amount or time is large, like "as many as" or "a full". For example, ตั้ง 500 ชาติ means "as many as five hundred lifetimes". The word also appears in ตั้งใจ (to be intent) and ตั้งแต่ (since), but those have different meanings.

senses.use: Placed before a number to stress that it is large or long, as in ตั้งสิบปี (a full ten years).
To place, establish or fix something, as in ตั้งใจ (be intent) or ตั้งชื่อ (give a name).
Marks a starting point in time, as in ตั้งแต่แรก (from the very beginning).

words.title: 众生黏着在状态里
words.titleEn: Beings Get Stuck in Their Mental States

detail.meaning: 满意、喜欢、知足。指心里喜欢某种状态，比如满意于迷失的快乐，其实是被烦恼带着走。

compare.thai: เพลิดเพลิน
compare.diff: พอใจ是满意、认可，เพลิดเพลิน是沉浸其中、乐在其中。

senses.use: 指对某事觉得合意、知足，如 พอใจที่จะหลง
指中意某人或某物，如 พอใจเขา

en.meaning: พอใจ means to be satisfied, pleased or content. It describes the mind liking a certain state, for example being satisfied with the pleasure of drifting and being lost, which means being led around by defilements.

senses.use: Feeling content or approving of something, as in พอใจที่จะหลง (be satisfied with being lost).
Taking a liking to a person or thing, as in พอใจเขา (like them).

compare.thai: เพลิดเพลิน
compare.diff: พอใจ is being satisfied with or approving of something, while เพลิดเพลิน is being absorbed in it and enjoying it.

parts.note: อ 在这里是元音，不是声母
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel, not an initial consonant

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 众生黏着在状态里
words.titleEn: Beings Get Stuck in Their Mental States

detail.meaning: 本义是黏住、卡住，也指连上、沾上。常用来说心黏着、执着在某个境界或状态上，例如心黏着在欲界、黏着在某种存在状态里；心一黏住就不自由了。

compare.diff: ติด 是心被黏住、粘在上面；ยึด 是心主动抓着不放。

senses.use: 心执着、黏在某处不放，如 จิตติดในกาม
东西被卡住、粘住或受阻动不了，如 รถติด、ติดอยู่
物体贴上、粘上、沾上，如 ติดกาว、ติดเชื้อ

en.meaning: ติด basically means to stick, to get caught, or to be attached to something. In Dhamma talks it describes the mind sticking to a realm, state, or experience so that it is no longer free. It is more passive than grasping: the mind is stuck there, not actively holding on.

senses.use: The mind clings to or sticks in some state or object, as in จิตติดในกาม or ติดในภพ.
Something is jammed, blocked, or unable to move, as in รถติด or ติดอยู่.
One thing adheres to or catches another, as in ติดกาว or ติดเชื้อ.

compare.diff: ติด is the mind being stuck to something, while ยึด is the mind actively gripping and refusing to let go.

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

words.title: 众生黏着在状态里
words.titleEn: Beings Get Stuck in Their Mental States

detail.meaning: 人。指人类，也可以泛指某个人、某类人，前面常加 บาง（有的）、ที่（……的）来说「有的人」「那些人」。

compare.diff: มนุษย์ 较书面、指整体的人类或人道；คน 是口语常用的「人」。

senses.use: 指人类或某个人，如 คนไทย、บางคน

en.meaning: คน means a person or human being. It is the ordinary spoken word for people, and often follows บาง (some) or comes before ที่ (who/that) to say 'some people' or 'those people'.

senses.use: Refers to a human being or a kind of people, as in คนไทย or บางคน.

compare.diff: มนุษย์ is more formal and refers to humans as a whole, while คน is the everyday spoken word for a person.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 投生为动物副作用最强
words.titleEn: Being Born an Animal: Strongest Side Effects

detail.meaning: 指过失、害处、坏的后果。มีโทษ 是说某件事、某种烦恼会带来苦的后果，副作用大。注意它与巴利语 dosa（嗔）写法相近，但在这里是「过患、害处」的意思。

compare.diff: โทษ 是害处、坏的后果；ประโยชน์ 是好处。
โทสะ 是嗔恨这种烦恼；โทษ 是过失与害处。

senses.use: 事物的害处、副作用、不好的后果，如 มีโทษ
犯的错、罪过，如 มีโทษ ทำผิด
把错归咎于人，如 โทษคนอื่น

en.meaning: โทษ means the harm, danger, or bad consequence of something. In Dhamma talks, saying a defilement มีโทษ means it brings suffering and has heavy bad effects. It is not the same word as โทสะ (aversion), even though they look similar.

senses.use: The bad side effects or consequences of something, as in มีโทษ.
A wrong done or a punishable offense, as in ทำผิดมีโทษ.
To put the fault on someone, as in โทษคนอื่น.

compare.diff: โทษ is the harm or bad result of something, while ประโยชน์ is its benefit.
โทสะ is the defilement of anger or hatred, while โทษ is the fault or harm of something.

parts.note: ษ作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ษ as a final reads t

words.title: 投生为动物副作用最强
words.titleEn: Being Born an Animal: Strongest Side Effects

detail.meaning: 严重、厉害、后果很重。常放在 โทษ 等词后面，说害处很大、很严重，如 มีโทษร้ายแรง。

compare.diff: ร้ายแรง 强调坏的程度严重；รุนแรง 强调力度猛烈，不一定是坏事。

senses.use: 后果、程度很重很厉害，如 โทษร้ายแรง

en.meaning: ร้ายแรง means severe or serious, describing something bad whose consequences are heavy. It is often placed after words like โทษ to say the harm is very great.

senses.use: A bad thing is very serious in degree or consequence, as in โทษร้ายแรง.

compare.diff: ร้ายแรง stresses that the badness is serious, while รุนแรง stresses force and intensity and is not necessarily bad.

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

words.thai: ผิดชอบชั่วดี
words.title: 投生为动物副作用最强
words.titleEn: Being Born an Animal: Strongest Side Effects

detail.meaning: 是非对错、善恶好坏。说 รู้ผิดชอบชั่วดี 就是懂得分辨什么对、什么错、什么善、什么恶。动物因为痴重，不知道这些。

compare.diff: บาปบุญ 讲的是业的善恶与福报；ผิดชอบชั่วดี 讲的是分辨对错善恶的能力。

senses.use: 分辨对错好坏的能力，如 รู้จักผิดชอบชั่วดี

en.meaning: ผิดชอบชั่วดี means right and wrong, or good and bad. It is used in the phrase รู้ผิดชอบชั่วดี, meaning to be able to tell what is right from wrong and good from bad. Animals, because of heavy delusion, lack this ability.

senses.use: The ability to tell right from wrong and good from bad, as in รู้จักผิดชอบชั่วดี.

compare.diff: บาปบุญ is about the kamma of good and bad deeds and their results, while ผิดชอบชั่วดี is the ability to tell right from wrong.

parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

parts.noteEn: บ as a final reads p

parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel

words.thai: สัตว์ นรก
words.title: 带着嗔心死去投生地狱
words.titleEn: Die with Anger, Be Born in Hell

detail.meaning: 指投生在地狱的众生。临死时心被嗔恨等强烈的烦恼占据、满是痛苦，就容易去到这样的地方。是四恶道之一。

compare.diff: 饿鬼是另一类恶道众生，常受饥渴之苦；地狱众生受的是更重的苦刑。

compare.thai: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน
compare.diff: 畜生就是一般的动物，也属恶道，但苦比地狱轻。

senses.use: 投生在地狱道受苦的众生

en.meaning: สัตว์นรก means a being born in hell. A mind overwhelmed by strong defilements such as anger and full of suffering at the time of death tends to go to such a place. It is one of the four lower realms.

senses.use: Beings reborn in the hell realm and suffering there.

compare.diff: เปรต is another kind of lower-realm being, often suffering from hunger and thirst, while สัตว์นรก suffers the heavy torments of hell.

compare.thai: สัตว์ เดรัจฉาน
compare.diff: สัตว์เดรัจฉาน is an ordinary animal, also in the lower realms but with less suffering than hell beings.

parts.note: ว์不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.title: 带着嗔心死去投生地狱
words.titleEn: Die with Anger, Be Born in Hell

detail.meaning: 指被某种力量压住、控制住。常用来说烦恼（嗔、痴等）占据了心，让心不由自主地被它牵着走。

senses.use: 烦恼等力量压住、支配心，如 โมหะครอบงำจิต
一方凌驾、操控另一方，如 ครอบงำความคิด

en.meaning: ครอบงำ means to overpower or dominate, to hold something under its power. In Dhamma talks it is used when defilements such as anger or delusion take over the mind so that the mind is dragged along helplessly.

senses.use: A defilement or force overpowers the mind, as in โมหะครอบงำจิต.
One thing rules over or steers another, as in ครอบงำความคิด.

parts.note: บ作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: บ as a final reads p

parts.note: ำ读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

words.title: 地狱众生也会后悔
words.titleEn: Hell Beings Feel Regret Too

detail.meaning: 意识到、醒悟、反省而生出的悔悟与良知。常指意识到自己做错了、不该这样做，如 สำนึกได้ 是「能够醒悟过来」。

compare.diff: เสียใจ 只是伤心遗憾；สำนึก 带有醒悟、认识到错误的意思。

senses.use: 意识到自己做错、心里有所醒悟，如 สำนึกผิด
对某事有自觉，如 สำนึกในหน้าที่

en.meaning: สำนึก means to come to realize, and to feel the conscience or remorse that comes from realizing. It is often used for realizing one has done wrong and should not have done it, as in สำนึกได้ (to come to one's senses).

senses.use: Realizing one has done wrong and feeling remorse, as in สำนึกผิด.
Being conscious of something such as one's duty, as in สำนึกในหน้าที่.

compare.diff: เสียใจ is just feeling sad or regretful, while สำนึก includes waking up and recognizing one's mistake.

parts.note: ◌ำ 读 am
parts.noteEn: ◌ำ is read am

words.title: 地狱众生也会后悔
words.titleEn: Hell Beings Feel Regret Too

detail.meaning: 知道。日常指知道、懂得、学会；讲禅修时，รู้ 指心有觉知地看着，如 รู้สึกตัว（觉知自己）、รู้กาย รู้ใจ，是重点在「知」而不是在「想」。

compare.diff: คิด 是脑子里想；รู้ 是直接觉知，两者要分清。
รู้สึก 是感受到、觉到；รู้ 范围更广，包括知道与学会。

senses.use: 了知、明白、觉知到某事，如 รู้สึกตัว
学会、掌握某种知识或技能，如 เรียนรู้
熟识某人或某事物，如 รู้จัก

en.meaning: รู้ means to know. In daily speech it means to know, understand, or have learned something. In meditation talks it means the mind knowing directly with awareness, as in รู้สึกตัว or รู้กาย รู้ใจ, where the emphasis is on knowing rather than thinking.

senses.use: To know or be aware of something directly, as in รู้สึกตัว.
To learn or master knowledge or a skill, as in เรียนรู้.
To be familiar with a person or thing, as in รู้จัก.

compare.diff: คิด is thinking in the head, while รู้ is direct awareness, and the two need to be told apart.
รู้สึก is to feel or sense something, while รู้ is broader and includes knowing and learning.

words.title: 祈愿投生为狗很困难
words.titleEn: Wishing to Be Born a Dog Is Hard

detail.meaning: 功德、福报。指做善事、持戒、修行带来的善的力量，能让心清净、让人得到好的果报。修心、有觉知所得的功德最大。

compare.diff: กุศล 是善的心与善法本身；บุญ 偏重行善之后积累的福德与果报。
บาป 是恶行带来的不好的结果；บุญ 是善行带来的好结果。

senses.use: 善行带来的福德、善业，如 ทำบุญ
善业成熟的好结果，如 บุญเก่า

en.meaning: บุญ means merit, the wholesome power that comes from giving, keeping precepts, and practicing. It cleans the mind and brings good results. Merit from training the mind and being aware is regarded as the greatest.

senses.use: The wholesome power gained from good deeds, as in ทำบุญ.
The good result of past wholesome deeds, as in บุญเก่า.

compare.diff: กุศล is the wholesome state of mind or quality itself, while บุญ stresses the merit and good results built up from doing good.
บาป is the bad result that comes from bad deeds, while บุญ is the good result of good deeds.

parts.note: ญ 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ญ as a final reads n

words.title: 祈愿投生为狗很困难
words.titleEn: Wishing to Be Born a Dog Is Hard

detail.meaning: 原指下定决心、坚定的意愿，日常多用来指做了功德之后许愿、祈愿。常见有人做完功德就祈愿来世如何如何，但这样的愿未必真有好处。

compare.diff: ปรารถนา 是心里想要、渴望；อธิษฐาน 是明确地许愿或下决心。

senses.use: 发愿希望将来得到某种结果，如做功德后 อธิษฐาน ขอให้…
下定决心要做成某事，如 อธิษฐานจิต

en.meaning: To make a wish or a firm resolution. In everyday speech it most often means making a wish after doing a good deed, such as asking to be born in a certain way in a future life. It can also mean resolving firmly to do something.

senses.use: Hoping for a particular result after doing merit, as in อธิษฐานขอให้…
Making a firm decision to accomplish something, as in อธิษฐานจิต

compare.diff: ปรารถนา is the inner wanting or longing itself, while อธิษฐาน is the act of clearly stating a wish or making a resolution.

parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.noteEn: ษ as a final reads t

words.title: 祈愿投生为狗很困难
words.titleEn: Wishing to Be Born a Dog Is Hard

detail.meaning: 指让某样东西变好、进步、发展。用在修行上，常说 พัฒนาจิตใจ，意思是提升、培养自己的心。

compare.diff: เจริญ 偏指自然增长、兴盛；พัฒนา 偏指有意识地去提升、改进。

senses.use: 让自己或心的水平变得更好，如 พัฒนาจิตใจ、พัฒนาตัวเอง
国家、地区、事业等向前发展建设，如 พัฒนาประเทศ

en.meaning: To make something better, to improve and grow it. It is used for people, the mind, places and businesses. In practice talk, พัฒนาจิตใจ means to improve and train one's own mind.

senses.use: Deliberately improving oneself or one's mind, as in พัฒนาจิตใจ or พัฒนาตัวเอง
Moving a country, region or enterprise forward, as in พัฒนาประเทศ

compare.diff: เจริญ leans toward natural growth and flourishing, while พัฒนา implies a deliberate effort to improve.

parts.note: ฒ作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ฒ as a final reads t

parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a, which is also the final sound of the previous syllable.

words.title: 能提升心灵水平的狗
words.titleEn: Dogs That Can Develop Their Minds

detail.meaning: 泛指心、心灵，由 จิต（心）和 ใจ（心）两个词合成，日常用语里指内心、心地、精神层面。乐、苦、不苦不乐在心里生起时，就用这个词指它们发生的地方。

compare.diff: จิต 来自巴利语 citta，是讲法时指能知、能觉知的那个心；จิตใจ 是日常的口语说法，更笼统。
ใจ 是最口语的“心”，单说较随意；จิตใจ 更完整、稍正式。

senses.use: 指内在的心，泛指心的状态，如 พัฒนาจิตใจ、เกิดขึ้นในจิตใจ
指人的品性、善恶，如 จิตใจดี（心地善良）

en.meaning: The mind or heart in a general, everyday sense. It combines จิต and ใจ, and refers to one's inner life, feelings and character. Happiness, suffering and neutral feeling are said to arise in the จิตใจ.

senses.use: The inner mind in general, as in พัฒนาจิตใจ or เกิดขึ้นในจิตใจ
A person's disposition or moral quality, as in จิตใจดี (kind-hearted)

compare.diff: จิต, from Pali citta, is the more technical word for the knowing mind in Dhamma talk, while จิตใจ is the broader everyday term.
ใจ is the most colloquial, casual word for the mind, while จิตใจ sounds fuller and a little more formal.

parts.note: ต 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ต as a final reads t

parts.note: ใ 写在前面，在辅音后读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 能提升心灵水平的狗
words.titleEn: Dogs That Can Develop Their Minds

detail.meaning: 狗。口语词，略随意，有时带点轻视的口气；常用来举动物的例子，说畜生道的众生。

compare.diff: สุนัข 较正式、礼貌；หมา 是日常口语。

senses.use: 指狗这种动物，如 ลูกหมา（小狗）。注意 หมาป่า 是狼，不是狗
用来骂人，表示卑劣、不像样，如骂人 ไอ้หมา

en.meaning: Dog. It is the casual, everyday word, and can sound a bit disrespectful. It is often used as a typical example of an animal when talking about animal rebirth.

senses.use: The animal, as in ลูกหมา or หมาป่า
Used as an insult for someone low or worthless, as in ไอ้หมา

compare.diff: สุนัข is formal and polite, while หมา is ordinary spoken Thai.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只用来抬高声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only raises the tone

words.title: 能提升心灵水平的狗
words.titleEn: Dogs That Can Develop Their Minds

detail.meaning: 基本意思是把东西拿起来、收起来。可以是从地上捡起来（如捡回一条狗），也可以是收拾、收藏（如收拾碗筷、收拾东西）。

compare.diff: หยิบ 是用手拈起、拿取；เก็บ 还有捡拾、收好、保存的意思。

senses.use: 把东西或动物拾起带回，如 เก็บมาเลี้ยง
把东西整理收起来，如 เก็บของ、เก็บชาม
留着保存、储存，如 เก็บเงิน

en.meaning: To pick something up or put it away. It can mean picking something up from the ground, such as taking in a stray dog, or tidying and storing things. It can also mean saving or keeping something.

senses.use: Taking something or an animal found and bringing it home, as in เก็บมาเลี้ยง
Clearing and putting things away, as in เก็บของ or เก็บชาม
Storing or saving something, as in เก็บเงิน

compare.en: to pick up with the fingers, to grab
compare.diff: หยิบ is just taking hold of something with the hand, while เก็บ also covers gathering, putting away and keeping.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在辅音后读；บ 作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. บ as a final reads p.

words.title: 小猫进来也不咬
words.titleEn: Won't Bite Even When a Kitten Walks In

detail.meaning: 猫。开示里常与狗一起出现，用来举动物的例子。

senses.use: 指猫这种动物，如 ลูกแมว

en.meaning: Cat. It often appears alongside dogs as a typical example of an animal.

senses.use: The animal, as in ลูกแมว

parts.note: แ 写在前面，在辅音后读；ว 作尾音读 o
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it; ว as a final reads o.

words.title: 小猫进来也不咬
words.titleEn: Won't Bite Even When a Kitten Walks In

detail.meaning: 不咬。由否定词 ไม่（不）加动词 กัด（咬）组成。例句里指一条善良的狗遇到别的小动物也不咬、不伤害它们。

senses.use: 动物不咬人或不咬别的动物，如 หมาไม่กัด

en.meaning: Does not bite. It is the negative word ไม่ (not) followed by กัด (to bite). It describes an animal that does not bite or harm other creatures.

senses.use: An animal not biting people or other animals, as in หมาไม่กัด

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

words.title: 小猫进来也不咬
words.titleEn: Won't Bite Even When a Kitten Walks In

detail.meaning: 食物、吃的东西。日常用语，指饭菜或任何可以吃的东西。

compare.diff: ข้าว 本指米饭，口语里也泛指吃饭、饭食；อาหาร 是各种食物的统称。

senses.use: 指吃的东西，如 แบ่งอาหารให้กิน

en.meaning: Food. It is an everyday word for meals or anything edible.

senses.use: Anything eaten, as in แบ่งอาหารให้กิน

compare.diff: ข้าว literally means rice and by extension a meal, while อาหาร is the general word for all kinds of food.

parts.note: ร作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ร as a final reads n

words.title: 狗也懂布施持戒
words.titleEn: This Dog Knows Giving and Keeps Precepts: No Harming, No Stealing

detail.meaning: 布施，把自己的东西给予他人，是修福的基础之一。布施能减少吝啬、增加心的慷慨，例句里说连狗懂得分食物给小猫，就是在布施。

compare.diff: บุญ 是做善事后心里得到的善果、功德；ทาน 是其中“给予”这一种具体的行为。

senses.use: 把东西施舍给他人，如 ทำทาน
礼貌地说吃东西，如 ทานข้าว

en.meaning: Giving, the act of generously giving something of one's own to others. It is one of the basic ways of making merit and lessens stinginess. In this talk, even a dog sharing food with a kitten counts as giving.

senses.use: Giving to others generously, as in ทำทาน
A polite word for eating, as in ทานข้าว

compare.diff: บุญ is the good result or wholesome quality that arises from good deeds, while ทาน is one specific good deed, giving.

words.title: 狗也懂布施持戒
words.titleEn: This Dog Knows Giving and Keeps Precepts: No Harming, No Stealing

detail.meaning: 偷，指不经允许拿走别人的东西。在例句里与“不伤害别的众生”并列，说明那条狗持守了不偷盗这一条戒。

senses.use: 偷取别人的东西，如 ไม่ขโมย
指偷东西的人，如 ขโมยขึ้นบ้าน

en.meaning: To steal, meaning to take someone else's belongings without permission. In this talk it is listed with not harming other beings, as part of keeping precepts.

senses.use: Taking another's things, as in ไม่ขโมย
A person who steals, as in ขโมยขึ้นบ้าน

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读；ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it; ย as a final reads i

words.title: 狗也懂布施持戒
words.titleEn: This Dog Knows Giving and Keeps Precepts: No Harming, No Stealing

detail.meaning: 伤害、加害，对象可以是人、动物，也可以是身体。例句里既指对别的众生的伤害，也指恶业的果报回头伤害身体。

senses.use: 使别人或众生受到身体上的伤害，如 ทำร้ายสัตว์、ทำร้ายร่างกาย

en.meaning: To harm or hurt someone or something, usually by physical violence or injury. The object can be a person, an animal, or a body. It is also used when the result of bad karma comes back to injure a person's body.

senses.use: To cause physical injury or suffering to a person or living being, as in ทำร้ายสัตว์.
To assault someone physically, as in ทำร้ายร่างกาย.

parts.note: ำ 读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

parts.note: ย作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

words.title: 死的时候失误
words.titleEn: Slipping Up at Death: Delusion Takes Over and You're Reborn as an Animal

detail.meaning: 出了差错、没做到位、失手。常用来说临终时心没守住、被痴带走，就是“死的时候失误了”。

compare.diff: ผิด是对错上的错，พลาด是本来可以做好却失手、没抓住。

senses.use: 该做对的时候出了差错，如 ตายพลาด（死的时候失误）
没赶上、没抓住机会或目标，如 พลาดโอกาส

en.meaning: To slip up or miss something that could have been done well. It describes a failed attempt, a lapse, or a missed chance. In talks about dying, it describes losing awareness at the moment of death.

senses.use: To make a mistake at the moment that matters, as in ตายพลาด, meaning to slip up at death.
To fail to catch an opportunity or target, as in พลาดโอกาส.

compare.diff: ผิด means being incorrect or against what is right, while พลาด means failing at something you could have done well.

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

words.title: 带着觉性死去
words.titleEn: Dying with Mindfulness: A Calm Mind

detail.meaning: 宁静、平静，指心不躁动、不散乱的状态。可以说心宁静，也可以形容人或环境安静。在开示里，宁静只是心的一种状态，和散乱一样，都是要去觉知的对象。

compare.diff: นิ่ง只是不动、不出声，不一定有平静的内涵；สงบ强调内心平息、安稳。
เงียบ指没有声音，多指外在环境；สงบ多指心里的平静。

senses.use: 心或环境平静、不躁动，如 ใจสงบ

en.meaning: Calm, peaceful, and not restless or scattered. It mostly describes the mind, but it can also describe a person or a place that is quiet and still. In the talks, calm is just one state of mind to be aware of, the same as restlessness.

senses.use: The mind is peaceful and not agitated, as in ใจสงบ.
A place or person is quiet and undisturbed.

compare.diff: นิ่ง only means not moving or not making a sound, while สงบ means the inside has settled and is at ease.
เงียบ means without noise, usually about the surroundings, while สงบ is usually about peace in the mind.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；ง 跟着前面的 ส 读低调；บ 作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; ง takes the low tone from the ส before it; บ as a final reads p.

words.title: 带着觉性死去
words.titleEn: Dying with Mindfulness: A Calm Mind

detail.meaning: 有（巴利 bhava），指众生所处的存在状态，如人、畜生、天人等。心会黏着、满足于自己所在的状态（พอใจในภพ），因此还想再次投生到同样的状态里。

compare.diff: ชาติ指出生、这一世的生命；ภพ指所处的存在状态本身。

senses.use: 指心所处、所黏着的存在状态，如 พอใจในภพ、ติดในภพ
指三界中的生存界域或一期生命，如 ภพภูมิ、ภพชาติ

en.meaning: Bhava, the state of existence a being is in, such as human, animal or deva. The mind clings to and is content with the state it is in (พอใจในภพ), so it wants to be born into the same state again.

senses.use: The state of being that the mind is attached to, as in พอใจในภพ.
A world or level of life within the cycle of rebirth, as in ภพภูมิ.

compare.diff: ชาติ means birth or one lifetime, while ภพ means the state of existence itself.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；พ作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; พ as a final reads p.

words.title: 带着觉性死去
words.titleEn: Dying with Mindfulness: A Calm Mind

detail.meaning: 业，指由意图而做出的行为（身、口、意），会带来相应的结果。业决定众生往哪里去投生、成为什么样的众生。

compare.diff: กรรม是所做的行为（因）；วิบาก是行为成熟后所得的结果。

senses.use: 指造作的行为及其果报，如 ผลกรรม
口语中指倒霉、遭罪，如 กรรมของเรา、เวรกรรม

en.meaning: Karma: an action done with intention, through body, speech, or mind, which brings a matching result. Karma decides where beings are born and what kind of being they become.

senses.use: Intentional action and its results, as in ผลกรรม.
In everyday speech, a misfortune or suffering one has to bear, as in กรรมของเรา or เวรกรรม.

compare.diff: กรรม is the action that is done (the cause), while วิบาก is the result that ripens from it.

parts.note: รร 合起来当元音 a
parts.noteEn: รร together act as the vowel a

words.thai: แผ่ ส่วน บุญ
words.title: 功德回向给快死的动物
words.titleEn: Share Merit So the Mind Isn't Sad or Heavy

detail.meaning: 把自己做善事得来的功德分给别人，愿对方也得到这份福。对象可以是亡者、众生，也可以是动物。常在礼佛、诵经、布施之后说，意思是做完善事后把功德分出去。

compare.thai: แผ่ เมตตา
compare.diff: 散播的是慈爱、祝福的心意；แผ่ส่วนบุญ分出去的是做善事得来的功德。

compare.thai: อุทิศ ส่วน กุศล
compare.diff: 意思几乎相同，是更书面、更正式的说法；แผ่ส่วนบุญ更口语。

senses.use: 把所做的功德分享回向给他人或众生，如 แผ่ส่วนบุญให้

en.meaning: To share merit: to give a share of the good you have done to others, wishing them to receive the benefit too. The receivers can be the dead, other beings, or animals. It is often said after paying respect to the Buddha, chanting, or giving.

senses.use: To dedicate the merit of good deeds to others, as in แผ่ส่วนบุญให้.

compare.thai: แผ่ เมตตา
compare.diff: แผ่เมตตา spreads goodwill and loving wishes, while แผ่ส่วนบุญ passes on the merit gained from good deeds.

compare.thai: อุทิศ ส่วน กุศล
compare.diff: It means almost the same thing but is more formal and written, while แผ่ส่วนบุญ is more spoken.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: ว 在这里当元音 ua
parts.noteEn: ว acts as the vowel ua here

parts.note: ญ 当尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ญ as a final reads n

words.title: 功德回向给快死的动物
words.titleEn: Share Merit So the Mind Isn't Sad or Heavy

detail.meaning: 指暗淡、不明亮，用在心上是心情沉闷、不舒畅、不清朗。常和 เศร้า 连用成「เศร้าหมอง」，指心里忧伤郁闷、不清净。

compare.diff: เศร้า 是伤心难过的感受，หมอง 是心变得暗淡、不明朗的状态。

senses.use: 心情阴郁不开朗，如 จิตหมอง、เศร้าหมอง
颜色、光泽不鲜亮，如 ผิวหมอง

en.meaning: Dull, dim, and not bright. Used about the mind, it means a heavy, gloomy, unclear feeling. It often appears with เศร้า in เศร้าหมอง, meaning a sad and clouded mind.

senses.use: The mind feels gloomy and not clear, as in จิตหมอง or เศร้าหมอง.
A color or skin looks dim and not fresh, as in ผิวหมอง.

compare.diff: เศร้า is the feeling of sorrow, while หมอง is the mind being dim and unclear.

parts.note: ห不发音只管声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent; it only sets the tone

words.title: 功德回向给快死的动物
words.titleEn: Share Merit So the Mind Isn't Sad or Heavy

detail.meaning: 伤心、悲伤，因为失去或不如意而心里难过。常和 หมอง 连用成「เศร้าหมอง」，指心里忧伤郁闷。

compare.diff: หมอง 偏重心不明朗、不清净的状态，เศร้า 偏重伤心难过的情绪。

senses.use: 因失去、离别等而难过悲伤，如 เศร้าใจ

en.meaning: Sad: feeling sorrow because of loss or things not going as wished. It often appears with หมอง in เศร้าหมอง, meaning a sad and clouded mind.

senses.use: Sorrowful because of loss or separation, as in เศร้าใจ.

compare.diff: หมอง stresses a mind that is dim and unclear, while เศร้า stresses the emotion of sadness.

parts.note: ร 不发音；เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ร is silent; เ is written before but read after

words.title: 狗死时心会悲伤
words.titleEn: Dying Among Strangers: A Dog Without Happiness, a Sad Mind

detail.meaning: 字面是「不舒服」，日常最常用来指身体不适、生病了。用在人或动物身上都可以，也可以指心里不舒服。

compare.diff: 直接说得了病，语气比ไม่สบาย更明确、更重；ไม่สบาย说得委婉，只是不舒服。
指某个地方痛或受了伤；ไม่สบาย是整体不舒服。

senses.use: 身体不舒服、有病，如 ไม่สบายจะตาย
身心感到不适、不自在，如 ไม่สบายใจ

en.meaning: Literally "not comfortable". In daily speech it most often means being unwell or sick in the body. It can be said of people or animals, and it can also mean feeling uneasy in the mind.

senses.use: The body is unwell, as in ไม่สบายจะตาย.
Feeling uncomfortable in body or mind, as in ไม่สบายใจ.

compare.diff: ป่วย says directly that someone has a disease and sounds more serious, while ไม่สบาย is a softer way to say not feeling well.
เจ็บ means pain or injury in a particular place, while ไม่สบาย is feeling unwell overall.

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

words.thai: คิด ถึง บ้าน
words.title: 狗死时心会悲伤
words.titleEn: Dying Among Strangers: A Dog Without Happiness, a Sad Mind

detail.meaning: 想家，离开了家，心里惦记着家、想回去。คิดถึง是「想念」，บ้าน是「家」。对人或动物都可以用。

compare.diff: 后面可接人或地方，只是想念；คิดถึงบ้าน特指想念家。
偏重放不下、担心对方的情况；คิดถึง偏重思念。

senses.use: 思念家乡或家，如 หมาคิดถึงบ้าน

en.meaning: To miss home: to be away from home and long to go back. คิดถึง means to miss or think of, and บ้าน means home. It can be said of people or animals.

senses.use: To long for one's home, as in หมาคิดถึงบ้าน.

compare.diff: คิดถึง can be followed by a person or a place, while คิดถึงบ้าน is specifically missing home.
ห่วง stresses being unable to let go and worrying about someone's situation, while คิดถึง stresses longing.

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

words.title: 衣服气味让它快乐
words.titleEn: Even Dying Can Be Happy Beside a Piece of Clothing With Your Scent

detail.meaning: 指善巧的办法、方便的手段，用聪明灵活的方式去达成目的或帮助别人。在这套开示里译作“善巧方便”，也可以泛指想出来的巧办法。

senses.use: 指用巧妙的方法引导、帮助人或事，如「มีอุบาย」
指为达到目的而用的手段、花招、计谋，如「ใช้อุบาย」

en.meaning: A clever, skillful method used to reach a goal or to help someone. In Dhamma talks it means skillful means: a wise, flexible way of guiding people or handling a situation. In everyday Thai it can also mean a trick or scheme.

senses.use: A clever, wise method for helping or guiding, as in "มีอุบาย".
A trick or scheme used to get something, as in "ใช้อุบาย".

parts.note: อ是空声母，只负责承载元音
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial; it only holds the vowel

parts.note: 尾音ย读成i，所以是baai
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i, so it is baai

words.title: 衣服气味让它快乐
words.titleEn: Even Dying Can Be Happy Beside a Piece of Clothing With Your Scent

detail.meaning: 指气味，鼻子能闻到的味道，好闻、难闻都可以说。也可以指某人、某物身上留下的味道。

senses.use: 指能闻到的味道，如「ได้กลิ่น」「กลิ่นตัว」

en.meaning: The smell of something, what the nose picks up. It can be pleasant or unpleasant. It can also mean the smell that a person or object leaves behind.

senses.use: Anything the nose can smell, as in "ได้กลิ่น" or "กลิ่นตัว".

words.title: 变为饿鬼帮助机会产生
words.titleEn: Once It Becomes a Hungry Ghost, the Chance to Help Arises

detail.meaning: 喜爱、疼爱，对人或动物亲昵、舍不得的感情。开示里说动物跟人 รักใคร่ ผูกพัน，是说它对人有感情、放不下，这份牵挂会带到死的时候。

compare.diff: รักใคร่ 偏重心里喜爱、黏着的感情；ผูกพัน 偏重已经被绑住、放不下的关系或牵连。

senses.use: 对人或动物的喜爱、疼爱，如 รักใคร่กัน（彼此相爱）
法义里指带着爱放不下，常与 ผูกพัน 连用

en.meaning: Affection and fondness for a person or animal, a warm feeling one does not want to let go of. When the talk says an animal has รักใคร่ ผูกพัน with people, it means it is fond of them and cannot let go, and this attachment stays with it at death.

senses.use: Fondness for a person or animal, as in รักใคร่กัน (love each other).
In Dhamma talks, love one cannot let go of, often together with ผูกพัน.

compare.diff: รักใคร่ stresses the fondness the heart feels, while ผูกพัน stresses being tied down and unable to let go.

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 变为饿鬼帮助机会产生
words.titleEn: Once It Becomes a Hungry Ghost, the Chance to Help Arises

detail.meaning: 原意是绑在一起，指心被某人、某事系住，放不下、断不了，也就是牵挂、依恋。开示里说动物 ผูกพัน อยู่ กับ คน（跟人有很深的牵挂），死后就可能变成饿鬼。

compare.diff: ผูกพัน 强调被绑住、断不开的牵连；รักใคร่ 强调心里喜爱而黏着。

senses.use: 心系在人或事物上放不开，如 ผูกพันอยู่กับคน
长久相处而感情深、割舍不下，如 ผูกพันกับบ้าน
法律或契约上有约束力，如 มีผลผูกพัน

en.meaning: Literally tied together: the mind is bound to a person or thing and cannot let go, i.e. attachment or a close bond. The talk says an animal that is ผูกพัน อยู่ กับ คน (deeply attached to people) may become a hungry ghost after death.

senses.use: The mind is tied to a person or thing and cannot let go, as in ผูกพันอยู่กับคน.
A deep bond from long time together, as in ผูกพันกับบ้าน.
Legally or contractually binding, as in มีผลผูกพัน.

compare.diff: ผูกพัน stresses being tied down and hard to cut free, while รักใคร่ stresses the fondness in the heart that sticks to something.

words.title: 变为饿鬼帮助机会产生
words.titleEn: Once It Becomes a Hungry Ghost, the Chance to Help Arises

detail.meaning: 指机会、空隙、可以做某事的时机或条件。说“有机会”“没有机会”时都用它。

senses.use: 指可以做某事的时机、机缘，如「มีโอกาส」
指某事发生的几率，如「โอกาสเป็นไปได้」

en.meaning: A chance, an opening, or the right time or condition to do something. It is used both for having a chance and for not having one.

senses.use: A time or opportunity to do something, as in "มีโอกาส" or "ไม่มีโอกาส".
How probable something is, as in "โอกาสเป็นไปได้".

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在后面读，อ 只是占位的声母
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it; อ is just a placeholder initial.

parts.note: 尾音 ส 读成 t
parts.noteEn: Final ส reads t

words.title: 有些饿鬼可以提升
words.titleEn: Some Hungry Ghosts Can Rise Higher

detail.meaning: 原意是「见」，就是看法、见解。开示里多指认定自己是对的、不肯改变的固执己见；错误的见解叫 มิจฉาทิฐิ（邪见）。日常说一个人「有ทิฐิ」或「ทิฐิมานะ」，是说他固执、傲慢、听不进别人的话。

compare.diff: 只是一般的看法，没有固执、不肯放下的意思。

senses.use: 认定自己对、听不进别人，如 ทิฐิแรง、ทิฐิมานะ
中性的看法、观点；错误的见解叫 มิจฉาทิฐิ（邪见）

en.meaning: Literally 'view', an opinion or way of seeing. In talks it usually means holding on to one's own view and refusing to change; a wrong view is มิจฉาทิฐิ. In daily speech, saying someone has ทิฐิ or ทิฐิมานะ means they are stubborn, proud and will not listen.

senses.use: Insisting one is right and not listening, as in ทิฐิแรง or ทิฐิมานะ.
A neutral opinion or view; a wrong view is มิจฉาทิฐิ.

compare.diff: ความเห็น is just an ordinary view with no sense of stubbornness or refusing to let go, while ทิฐิ implies holding on to it.

parts.note: ฐ 同时当前一个音节的尾音 t，读 ทิด
parts.noteEn: ฐ also serves as this syllable's final t, read ทิด.

parts.note: ฐ 读 th
parts.noteEn: ฐ reads th.

words.title: 有些饿鬼可以提升
words.titleEn: Some Hungry Ghosts Can Rise Higher

detail.meaning: 我慢，就是拿自己跟别人比，觉得自己高、自己低或自己一样，由此生出的自我感觉。它是一种烦恼。日常泰语里它也可以指咬牙坚持的毅力，要看上下文。

compare.diff: ทิฐิ是认定自己的看法对，มานะ是拿自己跟人比的高低感。
ถือตัว是日常说的摆架子、自以为了不起，มานะ是更深一层的心里的烦恼。

senses.use: 以自我比较而生的傲慢、自大
咬牙坚持、奋发的毅力，如 มานะทำ

en.meaning: มานะ is conceit: the sense of self that arises from comparing oneself with others and feeling higher, lower, or equal. It is a kind of defilement. In everyday Thai it can also mean gritty determination, so the context decides which is meant.

senses.use: Pride or self-importance that comes from comparing oneself with others.
Gritting one's teeth and pushing on with effort, as in มานะทำ.

compare.diff: ทิฐิ is being sure one's own view is right, while มานะ is the sense of being higher or lower that comes from comparing oneself with others.
ถือตัว is the everyday word for putting on airs and thinking oneself important, while มานะ is a deeper defilement in the mind.

words.title: 有些饿鬼可以提升
words.titleEn: Some Hungry Ghosts Can Rise Higher

senses.use: 四恶道之一的众生，常与恶道并列

en.meaning: Names a kind of being in the lower realms of existence, usually listed together with hell beings, hungry ghosts and animals. It is translated as asura. In everyday Thai it can also mean a frightening monster.

senses.use: A being of the lower realms, listed with hell beings, ghosts and animals, as in สัตว์นรก อสุรกาย เปรต สัตว์เดรัจฉาน.

words.title: 狗和人打成一片变饿鬼
words.titleEn: A Dog That Mixes With People Becomes a Hungry Ghost

detail.meaning: 形容人或动物顽劣、不守规矩、爱捣乱、不听话。说一只狗不เกเร，是说它乖、不惹事。

compare.diff: ดื้อ偏重不听话、硬顶着不改，เกเร偏重行为上调皮捣乱、不守规矩。
ซน多指小孩或小动物活泼乱动，没有那么坏，เกเร带有不守规矩的意思。

senses.use: 形容人或动物顽劣、爱惹事；ไม่เกเร 就是乖、不惹事

en.meaning: เกเร describes a person or animal that is naughty, unruly, and likes to make trouble. It is often used in the negative: saying a dog is ไม่เกเร means it is well-behaved and does not cause trouble.

senses.use: Naughty and troublesome; ไม่เกเร means well-behaved.

compare.diff: ดื้อ stresses not obeying and refusing to give way, while เกเร stresses mischievous, rule-breaking behavior.
ซน is mostly for lively children or young animals moving about and is not so bad, while เกเร carries the sense of breaking the rules.

words.thai: ไหว้ พระ สวด มนต์
words.title: 狗和人打成一片变饿鬼
words.titleEn: A Dog That Mixes With People Becomes a Hungry Ghost

detail.meaning: 合起来说，就是礼拜佛像、念诵经文，像早晚课那样每天做的修持。ไหว้是合掌礼拜，พระ是佛、僧，สวดมนต์是念诵经咒。

compare.diff: ทำวัตร特指寺院里按固定仪轨做的早晚课诵，ไหว้พระสวดมนต์是更宽泛的说法。
坐禅是打坐修定，ไหว้พระสวดมนต์是礼拜和念诵。

senses.use: 每天向佛像礼拜并念诵经文的修习

en.meaning: This phrase means paying respect to the Buddha and chanting, the daily practice done in the morning and evening. ไหว้ is bowing with palms together, พระ is the Buddha or monks, and สวดมนต์ is chanting scriptures or verses.

senses.use: The daily practice of paying respects to the Buddha image and chanting.

compare.diff: ทำวัตร is the fixed morning and evening chanting done in a monastery, while ไหว้พระสวดมนต์ is the broader everyday phrase.
นั่งสมาธิ is sitting to practice concentration, while ไหว้พระสวดมนต์ is bowing and chanting.

parts.note: ห不发音，只管声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent; it only sets the tone

words.title: 狗和人打成一片变饿鬼
words.titleEn: A Dog That Mixes With People Becomes a Hungry Ghost

detail.meaning: 善道、善趣，就是好的去处，指投生为人或天人等苦少乐多的境界。造善业，死后就会往这样的去处。

compare.diff: ทุคติ是地狱、饿鬼、畜生等苦多的去处，和สุคติ正好相反。
สวรรค์只是天界，สุคติ范围更大，人道和天道都算。

senses.use: 好的去处，指人、天等善的投生处，如 ไปสุคติ

en.meaning: สุคติ means a good destination after death, a realm of existence with more happiness than suffering, such as the human or heavenly realms. Good karma leads there after death.

senses.use: A fortunate place of rebirth such as the human or heaven realms, as in ไปสุคติ.

compare.diff: ทุคติ is the realms full of suffering, such as hell, hungry ghosts, and animals, the opposite of สุคติ.
สวรรค์ is only the heavenly realms, while สุคติ is wider and includes the human realm as well.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

words.thai: เวียน ว่าย ตาย เกิด
words.title: 轮回是很神奇的
words.titleEn: Rebirth Is Truly Wondrous

detail.meaning: 轮回，就是不停地死了又生、生了又死，像在水里漂来漂去停不下来。เวียน是绕圈，ว่าย是游，ตาย是死，เกิด是生。

compare.diff: 这是巴利来源的书面词，เวียนว่ายตายเกิด是口语化的说法，意思相同。
ชาติ指轮回中的某一世，เวียนว่ายตายเกิด指整个循环。

senses.use: 众生在生死中不断流转，如 ไม่ต้องเวียนว่ายตายเกิดอีก

en.meaning: This phrase means rebirth: dying and being born again and again, like drifting about in water without being able to stop. เวียน is going around, ว่าย is swimming, ตาย is dying, and เกิด is being born.

senses.use: Beings going round and round through death and birth, as in ไม่ต้องเวียนว่ายตายเกิดอีก.

compare.diff: สังสารวัฏ is the written word from Pali, while เวียนว่ายตายเกิด is the spoken way of saying the same thing.
ชาติ is one single life within the cycle, while เวียนว่ายตายเกิด is the whole cycle.

words.title: 轮回是很神奇的
words.titleEn: Rebirth Is Truly Wondrous

detail.meaning: 原指内容详尽、说得很细。日常多指事情离奇、不寻常、不是一般人想得到的。说轮回พิสดาร，是说其中的变化很出人意料。

compare.diff: แปลก只是和平常不一样，พิสดาร更有曲折离奇、超出想象的味道。
อัศจรรย์带有惊叹赞叹的意思，พิสดาร偏重离奇复杂。

senses.use: 形容事情曲折、出人意料、不寻常，如 เวียนว่ายตายเกิดมันพิสดาร
说明得详细、细致，如 อธิบายพิสดาร

en.meaning: พิสดาร originally means detailed and fully explained. In everyday Thai it more often means strange, out of the ordinary, and beyond what ordinary people would imagine. Saying rebirth is พิสดาร means its twists and turns are surprising.

senses.use: Full of twists and beyond what one would expect.
Explained in full detail, as in อธิบายพิสดาร.

compare.diff: แปลก just means different from the usual, while พิสดาร has more of a sense of being twisting, odd, and beyond imagination.
อัศจรรย์ carries a sense of awe and admiration, while พิสดาร stresses being odd and complex.

parts.note: ส尾音读 t，也是下一音节的声母
parts.noteEn: ส as a final reads t, and it is also the initial of the next syllable

parts.noteEn: ร as a final reads n

words.title: 轮回是很神奇的
words.titleEn: Rebirth Is Truly Wondrous

detail.meaning: 森林、野外。放在动物名前表示野生的，例如สัตว์ป่า是野生动物，หมาป่า是狼。

compare.diff: ดง指树木茂密的林子，ป่า是泛指的森林和野外。
เขา是山，ป่า是长满树木的地方，不一定在山上。

senses.use: 树林、山林，野外的地方，如 สัตว์ป่า
野生、不开化的，如 หมาป่า

en.meaning: ป่า means forest or the wild outdoors. Placed before an animal's name it means wild or living in the wild, as in สัตว์ป่า, 'wild animals'.

senses.use: Woods or wild country, as in สัตว์ป่า.
Wild or living in the wild, as in หมาป่า.

compare.diff: ดง is a dense stretch of woodland, while ป่า is the general word for forest and wild country.
เขา is a mountain, while ป่า is any place covered in trees, which need not be on a mountain.

words.thai: ความรู้สึกตัว
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 觉知到自己的身体和心此刻正在做什么、是什么状态，是修行教导的核心。不是思考，也不是控制，而是清楚地知道。它是对治烦恼、开始修行的起点。

compare.diff: สติ是记得、觉察的能力，ความรู้สึกตัว是这种觉察落在自己身心上的状态。

senses.use: 指心知道自己此刻的身心状态，不忘失自己
指人清醒、有知觉，如「ผู้ป่วยมีความรู้สึกตัว」

en.meaning: Knowing clearly what your body and mind are doing and what state they are in right now. It is not thinking about yourself and not controlling yourself, just clearly knowing. It is the starting point of practice.

senses.use: The mind knows its own body and mind in the present moment and does not lose itself.
A person is awake and responsive, as in "ผู้ป่วยมีความรู้สึกตัว".

compare.diff: สติ is the ability to remember and notice, while ความรู้สึกตัว is the state of that noticing resting on your own body and mind.

parts.note: ก 当尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

parts.note: ว 是元音的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel, not a final consonant

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 心，指能知、能觉的那个东西。修行就是学习观察心：心跑出去了要知道，心有烦恼要知道，不是去改造它。

compare.diff: จิตใจ是日常说法，也带“心地、情感”的味道；จิต更偏向法义里所说的心。

senses.use: 指能知道、能感受的心，如「จิตใจ」「จิตเคลื่อน」
指心理、精神方面，如「จิตแพทย์」「โรคจิต」

en.meaning: The mind, that which knows and feels. In practice it is something to be watched: notice when it wanders off and notice when defilements are in it, rather than trying to remake it.

senses.use: That which knows and feels, as in "จิตเคลื่อน" or "จิตใจ".
Mental or psychological matters, as in "จิตแพทย์" or "โรคจิต".

compare.diff: จิตใจ is the everyday word and also carries a sense of feelings and character, while จิต leans toward the mind as the Dhamma talks use it.

parts.note: ต 当尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ต as a final reads t

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 烦恼，指贪、嗔、痴等染污心的东西。修行的做法是看见烦恼生起，而不是压制它。常被提醒别只看别人的烦恼，要看自己的。

compare.diff: ตัณหา是烦恼中想要、渴求的那一部分，กิเลส是整个染污心的总称。

senses.use: 指贪、嗔、痴等染污心的烦恼习气

en.meaning: The things that stain the mind, such as greed, anger and delusion. In practice you watch defilements arise rather than suppress them. It is easy to see other people's defilements and harder to see your own.

senses.use: Greed, anger, delusion and other mental stains.

compare.diff: ตัณหา is the wanting and thirsting part of the defilements, while กิเลส is the whole group of mental stains.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；尾音 ส 读 t；按规则该读降调，实际读低调 lèet（像前面多了一个 ห）
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The final ส reads t. By the rules this should be falling tone, but it is actually low tone, lèet (as if there were an ห in front).

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 智慧，指如实看见身心的真相，比如无常、苦、无我。它不是靠想出来的，而是觉性够了之后自然看见。

compare.diff: ความรู้是知道的内容，ปัญญา是亲自看见实相的智慧。

senses.use: 指如实了知身心实相的智慧，如「สติปัญญา」
指一般的才智、理解力，如「ปัญญาอ่อน」「ปัญญาชน」

en.meaning: Wisdom: seeing the truth of body and mind as it is, such as impermanence, suffering and not-self. It is not reached by thinking but is seen naturally once awareness is mature enough.

senses.use: Seeing the true nature of body and mind, as in "สติปัญญา".
Ordinary intelligence or understanding, as in "ปัญญาอ่อน" or "ปัญญาชน".

compare.diff: ความรู้ is the content one knows, while ปัญญา is wisdom that directly sees the truth.

parts.note: 尾音 ญ 读 n
parts.noteEn: Final ญ reads n

parts.note: 声母 ญ 读 y
parts.noteEn: The initial ญ reads y

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 心的宁静、安定，通常是修止（禅定）带来的状态。宁静再好也只是心的状态，依然是被观察的对象，不是修行的终点。

compare.diff: ความสุข是感受上的快乐，ความสงบ是心安定不乱的状态，两者常一起出现但不是一回事。

senses.use: 指心安静、不躁动的状态
指环境、社会安定无乱，如「บ้านเมืองสงบ」

en.meaning: Calm of the mind, a settled and steady state, usually produced by practicing concentration. However good it is, it is still only a state of mind and still an object to be watched, not the end of practice.

senses.use: The mind is quiet and not agitated.
A place or society is orderly and undisturbed, as in "บ้านเมืองสงบ".

compare.diff: ความสุข is the pleasant feeling, while ความสงบ is the mind being settled and undisturbed; they often come together but are not the same.

parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

words.thai: กิเลสคนอื่น
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 别人的烦恼。我们很容易看见别人的烦恼，却看不见自己的，这是修行的盲点。另外，刺激别人生起烦恼，自己也要承担过失。

compare.thai: กิเลสตัวเอง
compare.diff: 修行要看的是กิเลสตัวเอง，不是กิเลสคนอื่น。

senses.use: 指别人心里的烦恼习气，常说看到、刺激别人的烦恼

en.meaning: This phrase means the defilements of other people, such as their greed, anger and delusion. It is used for the faults we easily notice in others while overlooking our own. It also appears when we say that provoking someone's defilements makes us share the fault.

senses.use: Refers to the defilements in someone else's mind, often with 'seeing' or 'stirring up' them (เห็นกิเลสคนอื่น, กระตุ้นกิเลสคนอื่น).

compare.thai: กิเลสตัวเอง
compare.diff: กิเลสตัวเอง is the defilement in your own mind, which is what practice needs you to watch, while กิเลสคนอื่น is in someone else and is easy to see but does little for your practice.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；尾音 ส 读 t
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The final ส reads t.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: อ 是空声母；ื 读 ue
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial. ื reads ue

words.thai: กิเลสตัวเอง
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 自己的烦恼。修行要学着看见自己心里的烦恼生灭，而不是只盯着别人。看得越清楚，越能认识自己。

compare.thai: กิเลสคนอื่น
compare.diff: กิเลสคนอื่น是别人身上的，容易看见却对修行帮助不大。

senses.use: 指自己心里的烦恼习气，常与看不见、要去觉知搭配

en.meaning: This phrase means one's own defilements, the greed, anger and delusion arising in one's own mind. In practice it is what we learn to notice as it arises and passes away. It is often used with 'not seeing' or 'being aware of'.

senses.use: Refers to the defilements in your own mind, often with 'not seeing' or 'being aware of' (ไม่เห็นกิเลสตัวเอง, รู้ทันกิเลสตัวเอง).

compare.thai: กิเลสคนอื่น
compare.diff: กิเลสคนอื่น is in other people and is easy to spot, while กิเลสตัวเอง is in your own mind and is the one practice asks you to see.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；尾音 ส 读 t
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The final ส reads t.

parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel

words.thai: นั่ง สมาธิ เยอะ ๆ
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 多多打坐。นั่ง สมาธิ是坐下来修定，เยอะ ๆ是“很多”。这句话用来提醒：只是坐得多、走得多不一定就好，关键是方法要对。

compare.thai: เดิน จงกรม
compare.diff: 经行是边走边修，打坐是坐着修，是两种不同的修行姿势。

senses.use: 多多地坐禅修定，强调打坐的量多

en.meaning: This phrase means to sit in meditation a lot. นั่งสมาธิ is sitting to practise concentration and เยอะ ๆ means 'a great deal'. It is used to point out that doing a large amount of sitting does not help unless the method is right.

senses.use: Means sitting in meditation for long or many times, often in a warning that quantity alone is not enough (นั่งสมาธิเยอะ ๆ ไม่ได้ดีเสมอไป).

compare.thai: เดิน จงกรม
compare.diff: เดินจงกรม is practice done while walking, while นั่งสมาธิ is practice done while sitting.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 缺少、中断、断掉的意思。可以指修行中断（不要让修行断掉），也可以指缺乏某样东西（缺觉性、缺戒、缺禅定、缺智慧）。常用来提醒：每天要持续用功，不要断。

compare.diff: หมด 是东西用尽了；ขาด 是本该有的却缺了或断了。

senses.use: 指持续的事情断掉不继续，如ขาดไม่ได้、อย่าให้ขาด（不要中断）
指少了某样应有的东西，如ขาดสติ（缺乏觉性）
指东西断开、扯断，如เชือกขาด（绳子断了）

en.meaning: This word means that something is cut off, interrupted or lacking. In practice talk it is used for a practice that stops, or for missing a quality such as mindfulness, virtue, concentration or wisdom. It is often used as a reminder to keep practising every day without a break.

senses.use: Means a continuing thing is interrupted, as in อย่าให้ขาด (don't let it break off).
Means a needed quality is missing, as in ขาดสติ (lacking mindfulness).
Means something physical is torn or broken apart, as in เชือกขาด (the rope snapped).

compare.diff: หมด means something has been used up and is finished, while ขาด means something that should be there is missing or broken off.

parts.note: 尾音 ด 读 t
parts.noteEn: Final ด reads t

words.thai: เก่งมาตั้งแต่แรก
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「一开始就很棒」。เก่ง 是擅长、厉害，มา 表示一路过来，ตั้งแต่แรก 是从最初。常用来说：没有人一开始就修得好，都是慢慢练出来的。

senses.use: 指不用练习、起点就很厉害，常用于否定：没有人一开始就很棒

en.meaning: This phrase means being good at something from the very beginning. เก่ง is skilled, มา shows it has been so all along, and ตั้งแต่แรก means from the start. It is usually used in the negative to say that nobody is good at practice at first, and skill is built up gradually.

senses.use: Means skilled without needing to build up, usually in the negative: ไม่มีใครเก่งมาตั้งแต่แรก (nobody is good from the start).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；有声调符号，这里读短音
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. There is a tone mark, and here the vowel is read short.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读；尾音 ก 读 k
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it; ก as a final reads k.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「练习得多」。ฝึก 是训练、练习，มา 表示过去一路练过来，เยอะ 是多。常用来说明：有人修得快，是因为以前（包括前世）练得多，不是天生特别。

compare.diff: ฝึกฝน 更强调反复磨练的过程；ฝึกมาเยอะ 强调已经练过的量多。

senses.use: 指以前已经训练、练习了很多

en.meaning: This phrase means having trained a lot in the past. ฝึก is to train, มา shows it has been going on up to now, and เยอะ is 'a lot'. It is used to explain that some people progress quickly because of earlier training, not because they are naturally special.

senses.use: Means someone has already done a lot of training before, as in เคยฝึกมาเยอะ (has trained a lot before).

compare.diff: ฝึกฝน stresses the ongoing process of repeated training, while ฝึกมาเยอะ stresses that a large amount of training has already been done.

parts.note: ึ 读 ue；尾音 ก 读 k
parts.noteEn: ึ reads ue. Final ก reads k

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；เ◌อะ 读 oe
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. เ◌อะ reads oe.

words.thai: จิตเคลื่อนออกไป
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「心移出去了」。指修行时心从当下的所缘（如呼吸、身体、觉知）移开，跑去想别的事、或跑到外面的境界，而自己没有发现。重点是：要能看到心跑出去了，这就是觉性在工作。

compare.diff: จิตหลง 是心被烦恼或念头带走而忘了自己；จิตเคลื่อนออกไป 是描述心从原来的位置移出去的动作。

senses.use: 指心离开原本的所缘或安住处，跑到别处去

en.meaning: This phrase means the mind moves away from where it was. In practice it describes the mind leaving its object, such as the breath, the body or awareness, and going off to think or to outside things, often without the person noticing. Noticing that it has gone out is itself awareness working.

senses.use: Means the mind leaves its object or its resting place and goes elsewhere, as in จิตเคลื่อนออกไปแล้วไม่เห็น (the mind moved out and you did not see it).
