compare.diff: จิตหลง means the mind is carried off by defilements or thoughts and forgets itself, while จิตเคลื่อนออกไป describes the movement of the mind away from its place.

parts.note: ต作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ต as a final reads t

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读，อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

parts.note: 第一个อ是声母，第二个是元音
parts.noteEn: The first อ is the initial consonant; the second is a vowel

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.thai: ทำ ให้ ถูก
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 把它做对、修对。强调先知道正确的修行方法，再照着去做，而且要做得够量，这是修行的第一步。

compare.thai: ทำ ให้ พอ
compare.diff: ทำ ให้ ถูก讲方法对不对，ทำ ให้ พอ讲量够不够。

senses.use: 把修行的方法做正确，如 ทำให้ถูกและทำให้พอ

en.meaning: This phrase means to do something correctly. In practice it means first knowing the right method and then carrying it out properly. It is the first step, usually followed by doing enough of it.

senses.use: Means practising the method correctly, as in ทำให้ถูกและทำให้พอ (do it right and do enough).

compare.thai: ทำ ให้ พอ
compare.diff: ทำให้ถูก is about whether the method is correct, while ทำให้พอ is about whether the amount is enough.

parts.note: ำ读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「心」的日常说法，可指心、心意、心情。ตั้งใจ 是用心、决意去做；ใจรู้สึกตัว 是心有觉知。在讲法的语境里 ใจ 和 จิต 多半指同一个心，只是 ใจ 更口语。

compare.diff: จิต 是佛法里正式讲「心」的词，来自巴利语；ใจ 更日常、口语。

senses.use: 日常说的心，如ตั้งใจ（用心）、ใจรู้สึกตัว
指性情、为人的品质，如ใจดี（心地善良）
指敢不敢做的勇气，如ใจกล้า（胆大）

en.meaning: This is the everyday word for heart or mind. It can mean the mind, one's intention or one's feelings. In Dhamma talks it usually refers to the same thing as จิต, but it is the more spoken, informal word.

senses.use: Means the mind in everyday speech, as in ตั้งใจ (to intend, to put your mind to it) or ใจรู้สึกตัว (the mind is aware).
Means a person's nature or character, as in ใจดี (kind-hearted).
Means boldness or nerve, as in ใจกล้า (brave).

compare.diff: จิต is the formal Dhamma term from Pali, while ใจ is the more everyday, spoken word.

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「看到」。日常指眼睛看见，讲修行时常指心里清楚地看到、知道，比如看到心跑出去了、看到烦恼生起。多用于「看见实相」的意思，而不只是用眼睛看。

compare.diff: ดู 是主动去看；เห็น 是看到了、看见的结果。
รู้ 范围更广，可以是任何方式的知；เห็น 强调清楚看到。

senses.use: 指眼睛看见，或心里清楚地看见、察觉到
指有某种看法，如เห็นว่า（认为）
指赞同别人的意见，如เห็นด้วย（同意）

en.meaning: This word means to see. In daily speech it is seeing with the eyes, and in practice talk it often means seeing or knowing something clearly in the mind, such as seeing the mind run out or seeing a defilement arise. It is used for seeing things as they really are, not only with the eyes.

senses.use: Means seeing with the eyes, or noticing clearly in the mind, as in เห็นกิเลส (see a defilement).
Means holding an opinion, as in เห็นว่า (consider that).
Means sharing someone's view, as in เห็นด้วย (agree).

compare.diff: ดู is the active act of looking or watching, while เห็น is the result of having seen.
รู้ is a wider word for knowing in any way, while เห็น stresses seeing something clearly.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 「舒服、自在」，可指身体舒服、心里轻松，也可指没有病（如句中「ไม่สบาย」是不舒服、生病）。在修行语境里常提醒：觉得舒服、快乐，容易让心陶醉而迷失。

compare.diff: สุข 是快乐的感受，偏法义；สบาย 是舒适、轻松，较口语。

senses.use: 身心感到舒适、愉快，如 รู้สึกสบาย
身体健康无恙；反说 ไม่สบาย 则是生病
事情不费力、无压力，如 สบายๆ

en.meaning: สบาย means feeling comfortable, at ease and free of strain, in body or in mind. It is also used for being in good health, so ไม่สบาย means 'unwell' or 'sick'. In casual speech, สบายๆ means relaxed or easy-going.

senses.use: Body or mind feels comfortable and pleasant, as in รู้สึกสบาย.
Healthy and not sick; the negative ไม่สบาย means sick or unwell.
Easy, effortless or without pressure, as in สบายๆ.

compare.diff: สุข is the felt quality of happiness, often used in Dhamma teaching, while สบาย is everyday comfort or ease and is more colloquial.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 尾音ย读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 做布施，把东西或财物给予他人，是修福的基础之一。例句里说连动物也可能因为曾经懂得布施、持戒，才有较好的去处。

compare.diff: ทำ ทาน是主动给予，ศีล是约束自己不去做伤害别人的事。

senses.use: 把财物、食物等施予他人或僧团，积累功德

en.meaning: ทำทาน means to give or make an offering of food, money or other things to others or to the monastic community. It is one of the basic ways of making merit.

senses.use: Giving material things to others, especially to monks, as an act of merit, as in ไปทำทาน.

compare.diff: ทำทาน is actively giving to others, while ศีล is restraining oneself from actions that harm others.

parts.note: ำ读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

words.thai: ที่ แท้ จริง
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 指事物本来的真实面貌，如 ความจริงที่แท้จริง
放在句中表示与表面所想相反，事实上

en.meaning: ที่แท้จริง means 'real' or 'actual', pointing to how things truly are underneath what they seem to be. Placed in a sentence, it often means 'in fact', contrasting the truth with what one assumed.

senses.use: Describes the true nature of something, as in ความจริงที่แท้จริง.
Placed in a sentence to say the real situation differs from what one thought.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: ร 不发音
parts.noteEn: ร is silent

words.thai: ความ เฉย ๆ
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 不苦不乐（中性的感受）：没有明显的乐，也没有明显的苦

senses.use: 隆波说 สุข ทุกข์ เฉยๆ 时指三种受之一，如 ความเฉยๆ ไม่สุขไม่ทุกข์
日常指对人或事不关心、没反应

en.meaning: ความเฉยๆ is the neutral feeling, neither pleasant nor painful, one of the three kinds of feeling in Luangpor's talks (สุข ทุกข์ เฉยๆ). In daily speech it can also mean a cool, unresponsive attitude.

senses.use: Neither pleasant nor painful, as in ไม่สุขไม่ทุกข์.
Not caring about or reacting to someone or something.

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

words.thai: ครู บา อาจารย์
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 尊称前辈修行有成的禅师、师长们

en.meaning: ครูบาอาจารย์ is a respectful term for revered teachers, especially senior monks who have practised well and guided others. It is usually used for the elders of the practice tradition rather than for ordinary school teachers.

senses.use: Respected senior monks and meditation masters of the tradition.

parts.note: ร 当尾音读 น，ย์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ร as a final reads น; ย์ is silent

words.thai: หลวง ปู่ มั่น
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 指泰国森林传统的祖师阿姜曼·普里达多尊者

en.meaning: หลวงปู่มั่น is Luang Pu Mun Bhuridatta, regarded as the founding master of the Thai forest tradition. หลวงปู่ is a respectful title for an elder monk, and มั่น is his name.

senses.use: Refers to the great forest-tradition teacher Ajahn Mun Bhuridatta.

parts.note: ห 带 ล 读升调；ว 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ห leads ล to a rising tone; ว is part of the vowel

words.thai: ความ พอ ใจ
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 对所得或所处状态感到满足、中意
对某人或某事物有好感、乐意，如 มีความพอใจใน…

en.meaning: ความพอใจ means being pleased with or satisfied by something, liking it and being content with it. In Dhamma talks it often means the mind's contentment with a state of being, which keeps it attached there.

senses.use: Feeling content with what one has or the state one is in.
Being pleased with or fond of a person or thing, as in มีความพอใจใน…

parts.note: อ 在这里是元音，读 aw
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel and reads aw

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.thai: สัตว์ ทั้ง หลาย
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 泛指所有有情，包括人、动物及各界众生

en.meaning: สัตว์ทั้งหลาย means 'all beings', every living being that has a mind and experiences birth and death. It includes humans, animals and beings in other realms. In Dhamma talks, สัตว์ means 'being', not only an animal.

senses.use: Every sentient being, including humans, animals and beings in other realms.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

parts.note: ห 带 ล 读升调；ย 当尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ห leads ล to a rising tone; ย as a final reads i

words.thai: อะไร อย่าง เงี้
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 口语列举之后，表示还有类似的情况，如 อะไรอย่างเงี้ย

en.meaning: อะไรอย่างเงี้ย is a casual spoken phrase added after an example or a list. It means 'and so on' or 'things like that', showing there are other similar cases. เงี้ย is the colloquial form of อย่างนี้.

senses.use: Said after giving examples, to suggest other similar things, as in อะไรอย่างเงี้ย.

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: อ不发音，只是把ย变成中辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only makes ย act as a mid-class consonant

parts.note: 原文少写了一个 ย，读 เงี้ย（口语的「这样」）
parts.noteEn: A ย is missing from the spelling; it is read เงี้ย (casual "like this")

words.thai: ความ แช่ม ชื่น
words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

senses.use: 心清爽、不干枯，带着舒畅的感觉
心情开朗愉快，如 แช่มชื่นเบิกบาน

en.meaning: ความแช่มชื่น means a fresh, clear and pleasant feeling in the mind, the opposite of being dried up or heavy. It is often paired with เบิกบาน, meaning cheerful and bright.

senses.use: A mind that feels fresh, moist and comfortable.
A bright, cheerful mood, as in แช่มชื่นเบิกบาน.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.title: 其他
words.titleEn: Other

detail.meaning: 指狼，一种生活在野外的野兽，样子像狗，成群活动。也可以泛指野外的野狗、猎狗一类的动物，是由「หมา（狗）」加「ป่า（森林）」合成的词，字面意思就是「森林里的狗」。

compare.diff: หมา 是一般说的狗，多指家养或街上的狗；หมาป่า 是生活在森林野外的狗类，通常指狼。
สุนัข 是 หมา 的书面、礼貌说法，指家养的狗；หมาป่า 则是野外的狼。

senses.use: 指野生的狼这种动物，如 หมาป่าตัวหนึ่ง（一只狼）；也泛指野外生活的犬类

en.meaning: หมาป่า means a wolf, a wild dog-like animal that lives in the forest and often moves in packs. It is made from หมา (dog) and ป่า (forest), so it literally means "forest dog." It can also be used loosely for wild dogs or hunting dogs living outdoors.

senses.use: Refers to the wild animal, as in หมาป่าตัวหนึ่ง (a wolf).
Used loosely for any dog-like animal living in the wild, such as a hunting dog.

compare.diff: หมา is the ordinary word for a dog, usually a pet or street dog, while หมาป่า is a dog-like animal of the wild, usually a wolf.
สุนัข is the polite or written word for a domestic dog, while หมาป่า is a wild wolf.

parts.note: ห不发音，只把声调变成升调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent. It only changes the tone to rising.

detail.meaning: 否定词，放在动词或形容词前面，表示「不、没有」。泰语最常用的否定，几乎每句都有。

compare.diff: ไม่ได้ 说的是没做成或不被允许，ไม่ 只是单纯否定
ยังไม่ 是「还没有，但以后可能会」，ไม่ 没有这层意思

senses.use: 放在动词、形容词前表示否定，如 ไม่ ได้、ไม่ ดี
表示不存在、没有，如 ไม่ มี ใคร（没有谁）

en.meaning: The basic Thai word for "not" or "no". It goes right before a verb or adjective to make it negative, and it also appears in "ไม่มี" meaning "there is not". It is used in almost every sentence.

senses.use: Placed before a verb or adjective to negate it, as in "ไม่ดี" (not good) or "ไม่ถูก" (not correct).
Used with "มี" to say something does not exist, as in "ไม่มีใคร" (there is nobody).

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

detail.meaning: 连接前后两件事，可以表示「那就」「也」「当然」，常常只是让句子顺下去。放在主语后面、动词前面。

compare.diff: จึง 强调因果，偏书面；ก็ 更口语、更宽泛
ด้วย 放句尾表示「也」，ก็ 放动词前

senses.use: 承接前面的条件或情况，表示自然的结果，如 ช้า ก็ อดทน
表示同样、并列，如 ผม ก็ ไป（我也去）
表示强调、确认，如 ก็ คือ（就是）

en.meaning: A small connecting word that links two ideas and makes the sentence flow, often meaning "then", "also" or "so". It sits after the subject and before the verb. It is very common in speech and often just makes a sentence sound natural.

senses.use: Shows a natural result of what came before, as in "ช้าก็อดทน" (if slow, then be patient).
Shows that something is the same or parallel, as in "ผมก็ไป" (I'm going too).
Adds emphasis or confirmation, as in "ก็คือ" (that is, namely).

compare.diff: จึง stresses cause and effect and sounds more formal or written, while ก็ is more spoken and much broader.
ด้วย goes at the end of the sentence for "also", while ก็ goes before the verb.

parts.note: 读法特别：写法像 เก้าะ，元音是短的 aw，读 kâw
parts.noteEn: Irregular reading: it is written like เก้าะ, the vowel is a short aw, read kâw.

detail.meaning: 「我们」，也可以泛指「人」或口语里的「我」。开示里常用来指听众和说话人一起。

compare.diff: ฉัน 只指说话人自己；เรา 可以包含对方
เขา 是第三人称，不包含说话人

senses.use: 泛指包括说话者在内的大家，如 เรา ปฏิบัติ
说话者随意地自称，用于熟人或平辈之间

en.meaning: Means "we" and can also mean "people in general" or, casually, "I". In talks it often covers both the speaker and the listeners together, as in "we practitioners".

senses.use: Includes the speaker and the listeners, as in "เราปฏิบัติ" (we practice).
Used casually by a speaker about themselves, among friends or equals.

compare.diff: ฉัน refers only to the speaker, while เรา can include the listener too.
เขา is third person and does not include the speaker.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

detail.meaning: 关系代词，引出修饰前面名词的从句，相当于「…的」「…那个」。也可以表示「在…地方」。

compare.diff: ซึ่ง 更书面，ที่ 更口语常用
ของ 表示所属，ที่ 引出从句

senses.use: 连接修饰语和名词，引出关系从句，如 ตอน ที่ นอน หลับ
指处所、地点，如 ที่ นี่（这里）
引出处所，如 อยู่ ที่ บ้าน（在家）

en.meaning: A word that links a description to the noun before it, like "that" or "which" in English. It can also mean a place, "at" or "where". It is very common in spoken Thai.

senses.use: Introduces a clause describing the noun before it, as in "ตอนที่นอนหลับ" (the time when one sleeps).
Means a place or location, as in "ที่นี่" (here).
Introduces where something is, as in "อยู่ที่บ้าน" (is at home).

compare.diff: ซึ่ง is more formal and written, while ที่ is the everyday spoken choice.
ของ shows ownership, while ที่ introduces a describing clause.

detail.meaning: 放在动词后表示「能够、可以」，放在动词前表示「得到、已经做到」。很常用的助动词。

compare.diff: เป็น 指学会的技能，ได้ 指有能力或被允许
สามารถ 更正式，放动词前

senses.use: 放在动词后表示能够、可以做到，如 ทำ ได้
作主要动词，表示获得，如 ได้ เงิน（得到钱）
放在动词前表示已经发生过，如 ได้ ไป（去了）

en.meaning: A helper word meaning "can" or "be able to" when it comes after a verb, and "got" or "did" when it comes before. It can also be a main verb meaning "to get". It is very common in Thai.

senses.use: After a verb, it means being able or allowed to do something, as in "ทำได้" (can do).
As a main verb, it means to receive or obtain, as in "ได้เงิน" (get money).
Before a verb, it shows the action already happened, as in "ได้ไป" (went).

compare.diff: เป็น is for a learned skill, while ได้ is for ability in general or permission.
สามารถ is more formal and goes before the verb, while ได้ usually follows it.

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读；写法是短的 ai，平时说话拖长读 dâai
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it; it is spelled as a short ai, but in speech it is drawn out and read dâai.

detail.meaning: 指事物、动物，也常指心里的某个状态，比如「它（心）会跑掉」。口语里也可以用来泛指。

compare.diff: เขา 指人，มัน 指物或不太尊重地指人
นั่น 是指示词，มัน 是人称代词

senses.use: 指代事物、情况或心的活动，如 มัน ก็ ไม่ ได้ อะไร
粗俗或亲近地指人，带不敬或随意口气

en.meaning: Means "it", for things, situations, or animals. In Dhamma talks it often points to the mind or some state in the mind, as in "it runs off". For people it can sound rough or very familiar.

senses.use: Refers to a thing, situation, or the mind's activity, as in "มันก็ไม่ได้อะไร" (it gets nothing).
Refers to a person in a casual or disrespectful way.

compare.diff: เขา is for people, while มัน is for things, or for people in a disrespectful way.
นั่น points to something ("that"), while มัน is a pronoun standing in for it.

detail.meaning: 表示将来或打算做某事，放在动词前。也可以表示「会这样」的推测。

compare.diff: กำลัง 是正在做，จะ 是还没做
อยาก 强调愿望，จะ 强调打算或将来

senses.use: 表示将要、打算、将来，如 จะ ไป
表示推测、可能出现的结果，如 จะ ดี เสมอ ไป

en.meaning: Goes before a verb to show the future, an intention, or something expected. It means "will" or "going to". It can also express a guess about what would happen.

senses.use: Shows the future or an intention, as in "จะไป" (will go).
Shows a guess or expected result, as in "จะดีเสมอไป" (would always be good).

compare.diff: กำลัง means it is happening now, while จะ means it has not happened yet.
อยาก stresses wanting, while จะ stresses a plan or the future.

detail.meaning: 放在句尾表示动作已经完成或状态已经改变，放在句中表示「然后」。非常常用。

compare.diff: เคย 指有过这种经历，แล้ว 指已经完成
ยัง 是还没结束，แล้ว 是已经结束

senses.use: 放在句末或动词后表示事情已经发生，如 รู้ แล้ว
连接前后动作，表示接着，如 รู้ ถูก แล้ว ก็ ทำ

en.meaning: At the end of a sentence it means something is already done or a situation has changed, like "already". In the middle of a sentence it means "then" and links one action to the next. It is extremely common.

senses.use: After a verb or at the end, it shows something has happened, as in "รู้แล้ว" (already know).
Links one action to the next, as in "รู้ถูกแล้วก็ทำ" (know it correctly, then do it).

compare.diff: เคย means having had the experience at some time, while แล้ว means it has been completed.
ยัง means it is still going on or not finished, while แล้ว means it is finished.

parts.note: แ写在前面却在后面读；ว作尾音读成 o
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it; ว as a final reads o.

detail.meaning: 可以表示「给」「让」「为了」。放在动词后面常常表示「做给…」或「使…」。

compare.diff: ใช้ 是用某物或差遣人，ให้ 是给或让
ทำให้ 强调造成某种结果，ให้ 更宽泛

senses.use: 作动词表示给予，如 ให้ เงิน
表示使、令某事发生，如 ให้ จิต อยู่ กับ ตัว
引出对象或目的，如 ทำ ให้ ผม（为我做）

en.meaning: Can mean "give", "let/make", or "for". After another verb it often means "to do something for someone" or "to cause something to be so". It is a very flexible word.

senses.use: Means to cause something to happen, as in "ให้จิตอยู่กับตัว" (let the mind stay with oneself).
As a main verb, it means to give, as in "ให้เงิน" (give money).
Introduces the person or purpose, as in "ทำให้ผม" (do it for me).

compare.diff: ใช้ means to use something or tell someone to do a job, while ให้ means to give or let.

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

detail.meaning: 可以当动词表示「在、住」，也可以放在动词后表示动作正在持续。开示里常说「รู้ อยู่」，意思是一直知道着。

compare.diff: ยัง 放动词前，强调还没结束；อยู่ 放动词后，强调持续
กำลัง 放动词前，อยู่ 放动词后，常常可以一起用

senses.use: 表示处于某处或某状态、正在进行，如 ปฏิบัติ อยู่
表示居住，如 อยู่ บ้าน（住在家）

en.meaning: As a verb it means "to be at" or "to live". After another verb it shows the action is continuing, like "-ing". In talks "รู้อยู่" means keeping on knowing, continuously.

senses.use: After a verb it shows an ongoing action or state, as in "ปฏิบัติอยู่" (is practicing).
Shows being in a place or state, as in "อยู่กับตัว" (stay with oneself).
Means to dwell somewhere, as in "อยู่บ้าน" (live at home).

compare.diff: ยัง goes before the verb and stresses that it has not ended, while อยู่ goes after the verb and stresses continuing.
กำลัง goes before the verb and อยู่ after it, and the two are often used together.

parts.note: อ不发音，只用来改变ย的声调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only changes the tone of ย

detail.meaning: 放在动词或形容词前，把它变成名词，比如「ความ สุข」是「快乐」。凡是抽象的状态和感受几乎都靠它来构成。

compare.diff: การ 用在动作前，ความ 用在状态或感受前
เรื่อง 指具体的事或话题，ความ 只是构词用

senses.use: 加在动词或形容词前构成抽象名词，如 ความรู้สึก（感受）、ความทุกข์（苦）、ความคิด（思维）

en.meaning: A prefix placed before a verb or adjective to turn it into an abstract noun. Most abstract states and feelings in Thai are formed this way, for example ความสุข (happiness) and ความคิด (thinking, thought). It is not a word with its own meaning but a tool for building nouns.

senses.use: Goes before a verb or adjective to make an abstract noun, as in ความรู้สึก (feeling), ความทุกข์ (suffering), ความคิด (thought).

detail.meaning: 放在名词后面，表示「这个…」。比如「วัน นี้」是今天。

compare.diff: นั้น 指较远的，นี้ 指较近的
นี่ 可以单独当代词，นี้ 必须跟在名词后

senses.use: 指示近处或当下的事物，放在名词后，如 จุดนี้（这一点）、อย่างนี้（这样）

en.meaning: A word meaning 'this', placed after a noun to point to something near or present. It marks the thing as close in space, time or in the speaker's attention, as in วันนี้ (today) and จุดนี้ (this point).

senses.use: Follows a noun to point to something near or current, as in จุดนี้ (this point), วันนี้ (today).
Used in fixed phrases such as อย่างนี้ (in this way, like this).

detail.meaning: 放在句尾加强语气，否定句里表示「一点也不」，肯定句里表示「就直接」。也可以当动词表示「超过」。

compare.diff: ทันที 只表示马上，เลย 还有加强语气的作用
ก็ 放在动词前，เลย 放在句尾

senses.use: 放句尾加强语气，表示全部、彻底，如 หมดเลย（全都）、ทั้งวันเลย（整天）
作动词或趋向补语，表示越过、超出，如 เลยไป（走过头）
表示直接、于是，如 เลยทำ（就做了）

en.meaning: A word placed at the end of a sentence to add emphasis. In negative sentences it means 'not at all', and in positive sentences it often means 'completely' or 'right away'. It can also be a verb meaning to go past or beyond.

senses.use: Ends a sentence to stress totality, as in หมดเลย (all of it), ทั้งวันเลย (the whole day long).
As a verb or after a verb, means to go past or overshoot, as in เลยไป (go too far).
Before a verb, means 'so' or 'then', as in เลยทำ (so did it).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

detail.meaning: 疑问代词「什么」，也可以表示「任何东西」。放在句尾或动词后面提问。

compare.diff: ใคร 问人，อะไร 问事物
ไหน 问哪一个或哪里，อะไร 问是什么

senses.use: 疑问词，问事物，如 ทำอะไร（做什么）
用于否定或泛指，表示任何事物，如 ไม่รู้อะไร（什么都不知道）

en.meaning: A question word meaning 'what', used to ask about things. It can also mean 'anything' or 'something' in negative or general statements, as in ไม่รู้อะไร (doesn't know anything).

senses.use: Asks about a thing, as in ทำอะไร (doing what?).
In negative or general statements, means any thing at all, as in ไม่รู้อะไร (knows nothing).

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

detail.meaning: 当动词是「说、批评」，当连词引出所说或所想的内容，相当于「…说」「认为…」。很常用。

compare.diff: บอก 是告诉别人，ว่า 是引出内容
คือ 是判断「是」，ว่า 是引出说话的内容

senses.use: 表示说、讲，如 บอกว่า（说）
引出想法或认为的内容，如 นึกว่า（以为）、คิดว่า（认为）
动词，表示批评、责骂，如 ว่าเขา（骂他）

en.meaning: A very common word that is used as a verb meaning 'to say' or 'to scold', and as a connector that introduces what someone says or thinks. It works like 'that' in 'he said that…' or 'I think that…'.

senses.use: Introduces the content of speech or thought, as in บอกว่า (said that), คิดว่า (think that), นึกว่า (thought that).
As a verb, means to criticize or scold someone, as in ว่าเขา (scold him).

detail.meaning: 当介词表示所属，相当于「…的」；当名词是「东西」。

compare.diff: ที่ 引出从句，ของ 表示所属
แห่ง 更书面，ของ 更口语

senses.use: 表示所属关系，如 ของตัวเอง（自己的）
作名词，指物品，如 ของกิน（吃的东西）

en.meaning: A word that shows ownership or belonging, like 'of' or the possessive 's'. It is also a noun meaning 'thing' or 'object'.

senses.use: Shows that something belongs to someone, as in ของตัวเอง (one's own).
As a noun, means an object or item, as in ของกิน (food, something to eat).

detail.meaning: 引出条件，相当于「如果」。后面常接 ก็ 引出结果，比如「ถ้า…ก็…」。

compare.diff: หาก 更书面，ถ้า 更口语
เมื่อ 是确实发生的时候，ถ้า 是假设

senses.use: 引出假设条件，如 ถ้ารู้วิธี（如果知道方法）

en.meaning: A word that introduces a condition, meaning 'if'. The result is often introduced by ก็ in the pattern ถ้า…ก็… ('if…then…').

senses.use: Introduces a condition, as in ถ้ารู้วิธี (if one knows the method).

detail.meaning: 介词，表示在某个范围或空间之内，比如「ใน ใจ」是心里。也可以用于时间。

compare.diff: ที่ 泛指地点，ใน 强调在里面
ข้างใน 是名词性的「里面」，ใน 是介词

senses.use: 表示处在某范围或空间之内，如 ในร่างกาย（身体里）、ในโลก（世间）

en.meaning: A word meaning 'in' or 'inside', used before a noun to show that something is within a space or range. It is also used for time, as in ในวันนี้ (on this day).

senses.use: Before a noun, shows that something is inside a space or range, as in ในร่างกาย (in the body), ในโลก (in the world).

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

detail.meaning: 放在名词或代词后，强调「就是自己」「亲自」。常见的搭配是「ตัว เอง」。

compare.diff: ตัวเอง 是名词性的「自己」，เอง 只是放在后面强调
ด้วย 是「也」，เอง 强调是本人

senses.use: 强调是自己、亲自，如 ตัวเอง（自己）
表示自行发生、不假外力，如 เกิดขึ้นเอง（自己生起）

en.meaning: A word placed after a noun or pronoun to stress that it is the person themselves, as in 'oneself'. It can also mean that something happens by itself, without outside cause. It is most often seen in ตัวเอง (oneself).

senses.use: Stresses that it is the person themselves, as in ตัวเอง (oneself).
Shows something happens on its own, as in เกิดขึ้นเอง (arises by itself).

parts.note: 元音เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel เ is written before the consonant but read after it

detail.meaning: 连接转折的两个部分，相当于「但是」。放在后一句开头。

compare.diff: แต่ว่า 语气更柔和，แต่ 更直接
ถึงแม้ 引出让步，แต่ 引出转折

senses.use: 表示转折，连接相反的两句，如 แต่ถ้า（但如果）
与 ตั้งแต่ 搭配，表示自某时起，如 ตั้งแต่แรก（从一开始）
与 แต่ละ 搭配，表示每一个，如 แต่ละคน（每个人）

en.meaning: A word that links two contrasting parts of a sentence, meaning 'but'. It goes at the start of the second part. It also appears in ตั้งแต่ (since, from) and แต่ละ (each).

senses.use: Introduces a contrast with what came before, as in แต่ถ้า (but if).
In ตั้งแต่, means 'since' or 'from', as in ตั้งแต่แรก (from the start).
In แต่ละ, means 'each', as in แต่ละคน (each person).

parts.note: 元音แ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel แ is written before the consonant but read after it

detail.meaning: 表示动作或状态还在继续，或者还没发生。常和 ไม่ 一起，「ยัง ไม่」就是「还没」。

compare.diff: อีก 是再加一次，ยัง 是还在原来的状态
เคย 是以前有过，ยัง 是现在还是

senses.use: 表示动作或状态仍在持续，如 ยังรู้สึกได้（还能觉知）
放在否定前，表示还没有，如 ยังไม่…

en.meaning: ยัง means something is still going on, or still true, at the time of speaking. It goes before a verb or adjective. With ไม่, 'ยังไม่' means 'not yet'.

senses.use: A state or action continues, e.g. ยังรู้สึกได้ 'can still feel'.
Before a negative, e.g. ยังไม่… 'has not yet…'.
Asks or says whether something has happened up to now, e.g. ยังไหม 'not yet?'.

compare.diff: อีก adds one more time or amount, while ยัง says the same state is continuing.
เคย says something happened in the past, while ยัง says it is still so now.

detail.meaning: 可以表示「种类」，也可以表示「像…那样」。放在名词或动词前面。

compare.diff: แบบ 是样式或类型，อย่าง 是种类或方式
เหมือน 强调相似，อย่าง 强调方式或种类

senses.use: 举例或比喻，如 อย่างกิเลสคนอื่น（比如别人的烦恼）
量词，指种类、样式，如 แต่ละอย่าง（每一种）
放在形容词前构成副词，如 อย่างมาก（很地）、อย่างนี้（这样）

en.meaning: อย่าง means 'kind' or 'way'. It is used to count types of things and to give examples with the meaning 'such as' or 'like'. It also forms phrases like อย่างนี้ 'this way' and อย่างนั้น 'that way'.

senses.use: Introduces an example, e.g. อย่างกิเลสคนอื่น 'for example, other people's defilements'.
A type or manner of something, e.g. แต่ละอย่าง 'each kind', อย่างนั้น 'that way'.
Before an adjective, makes it describe how something is done, e.g. อย่างมาก 'greatly'.

compare.diff: แบบ is a style, model or pattern, while อย่าง is a kind or manner.
เหมือน stresses that two things are alike, while อย่าง gives an example or a kind.

parts.note: อ不发音，只是把ย变成中辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only makes ย act as a mid-class consonant

detail.meaning: 连接两个名词，表示「和」，也可以表示「与…一起」。

compare.diff: และ 连接并列的成分，กับ 常指伴随或对象
ด้วย 放句尾，กับ 放名词前

senses.use: 连接两个并列的人或事物，如 A กับ B
表示与某人一起或对某人，如 พูดกับเขา（跟他说）

en.meaning: กับ joins two nouns and means 'and' or 'with'. It can also show who or what an action is done together with or toward.

senses.use: Joins two things, A กับ B, e.g. ตอนนอนหลับกับตอนทำงาน 'when sleeping and when working'.
Doing something together with or toward someone, e.g. พูดกับเขา 'speak with him'.

compare.diff: และ simply joins items in a list, while กับ often suggests being together with or toward something.
ด้วย usually comes at the end of the clause, while กับ comes before a noun.

parts.note: 尾音บ读p
parts.noteEn: Final บ reads p

detail.meaning: 放在动词前，表示必须、应该做某事。也可以表示「一定是」。

compare.diff: ควร 是建议，ต้อง 是必须
จำเป็น 强调必要性，ต้อง 更口语

senses.use: 表示必要或义务，如 ต้องทำ（必须做）
表示肯定的推断，如 ต้องเป็นเขา（一定是他）

en.meaning: ต้อง goes before a verb and means someone has to do it, or it is necessary. It can also mean 'must be', a firm guess about something.

senses.use: Necessity or obligation, e.g. ต้องทำ 'have to do', ต้องใช้ความคิด 'need to use thinking'.
A sure guess, e.g. ต้องเป็นเขา 'it must be him'.

compare.diff: ควร is a suggestion or what is proper, while ต้อง is a must.
จำเป็น stresses that something is needed and is more formal, while ต้อง is the everyday word.

detail.meaning: 放在形容词或动词后面，表示程度很高或数量很多。比如「ดี มาก」是很好。

compare.diff: เยอะ 偏口语，主要指数量多；มาก 既可指数量也可指程度
ที่สุด 是最高级，มาก 只是程度高

senses.use: 放在形容词或动词后，表示程度高，如 ดีมาก（很好）
表示数量多，如 ทำให้มาก（多多地做）
表示程度加深、严重，如 หลงมากขึ้น（迷失得更厉害）

en.meaning: มาก means 'a lot' or 'very'. It goes after an adjective or verb to show a high degree or a large amount. It also appears in ขึ้นมาก and ทำให้มาก, meaning more and more or doing a lot.

senses.use: A large amount or much effort, e.g. ทำให้มาก 'do it a lot'.
A high degree after an adjective or verb, e.g. ดีมาก 'very good'.
Getting stronger over time, e.g. หลงมากขึ้น 'getting more lost'.

compare.diff: เยอะ is more casual and mostly means amount, while มาก can mean amount or degree.

parts.note: 尾音ก读k；无声调符号却读降调
parts.noteEn: Final ก reads k; there is no tone mark, but the tone is falling

detail.meaning: 表示「再一次」或「还有」，放在动词后或数量词前。

compare.diff: ยัง 是还在原来的状态，อีก 是追加
ซ้ำ 是重复同样的事，อีก 可以是新增

senses.use: 表示重复、再次，如 อยากเป็นคนอีก（想再当人）
表示追加、另外，如 อีกอย่าง（另外一点）

en.meaning: อีก means 'again' or 'more'. It says something happens one more time, or adds another item or amount. It goes after a verb or before a number.

senses.use: Repeating something, e.g. อยากเป็นคนอีก 'want to be human again'.
Adding something extra, e.g. อีกอย่าง 'one more thing'.

compare.diff: ยัง says a state is continuing, while อีก adds another time or amount.
ซ้ำ means doing the very same thing again, while อีก can also add something new.

parts.note: อ在这里是声母，不发辅音；尾音ก读k
parts.noteEn: Here อ is the initial but makes no consonant sound. Final ก reads k

detail.meaning: 引出原因，相当于「因为」。可以放在句首或句中，常说「เพราะ ว่า」。

compare.thai: เพราะ ว่า
compare.diff: เพราะว่า 更完整，เพราะ 更简短
ดังนั้น 引出结果，เพราะ 引出原因

senses.use: 引出原因，如 เพราะเขาเคยฝึกมา（因为他以前练过）

en.meaning: เพราะ introduces the reason for something and means 'because'. It can start a sentence or come in the middle, and is often said as เพราะว่า.

senses.use: Gives a reason, e.g. เพราะเขาเคยฝึกมา 'because he has trained before'.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；元音 เ◌าะ 包住复辅音 พร
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The vowel เ◌าะ wraps around the cluster พร.

detail.meaning: 放在动词前，表示动作正在进行。也可以当名词表示「力量」。

compare.diff: อยู่ 放动词后，กำลัง 放动词前，常常一起用
จะ 是将要做，กำลัง 是正在做

senses.use: 表示动作进行中，如 กำลังหลง（正在迷失）
作名词，指力气、能力，如 กำลังของโทสะ（嗔的力量）

en.meaning: กำลัง goes before a verb to show that the action is happening right now. As a noun it means 'strength' or 'power', for example the power of a defilement over the mind.

senses.use: Before a verb, the action is happening now, e.g. กำลังหลง 'is being lost'.
As a noun, power or force, e.g. กำลังของโทสะ 'the power of aversion'.

compare.diff: อยู่ goes after the verb while กำลัง goes before it, and they are often used together.
จะ is for what is going to happen, while กำลัง is for what is happening now.

parts.note: ◌ำ 读 am，带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ◌ำ is read am, with a final m

detail.meaning: 放在名词后面，表示「那个…」，指比较远或前面提过的。也可以单独当代词。

compare.diff: นี้ 指较近的，นั้น 指较远的
โน้น 指更远的，นั้น 指前面提过的

senses.use: 指示较远或前面提到的事物，如 เวลานั้น（那时候）

en.meaning: นั้น means 'that'. It goes after a noun to point to something already mentioned or a bit farther away, e.g. เวลานั้น 'that time'. It can also stand alone, as in อย่างนั้น 'that way'.

senses.use: Points to something already mentioned or farther away, e.g. เวลานั้น 'that time'.

compare.diff: นี้ points to something near or just now, while นั้น points to something farther or already mentioned.
โน้น points to something farther still, while นั้น refers to what was just talked about.

detail.meaning: 放在句尾表示「也」「一起」，也可以表示「用…」「因为…」。口语里很常用。

compare.diff: กับ 放名词前，ด้วย 放句尾
ก็ 放动词前，ด้วย 放句尾

senses.use: 放在句尾，表示同样、也是，如 ฉันไปด้วย（我也去）
表示凭借的方式或工具，如 ด้วยจิตที่มีโมหะ（带着有痴的心）
表示一同参与，如 ไปด้วยกัน（一起去）

en.meaning: ด้วย has several uses. At the end of a clause it means 'also' or 'too'. Before a noun it means 'with' or 'by means of', and it can also show the reason or state something is done in.

senses.use: The means or state something is done in, e.g. ด้วยจิตที่มีโมหะ 'with a mind that has delusion'.
At the end of a clause, e.g. ฉันไปด้วย 'I'm going too'.
Joining in, e.g. ไปด้วยกัน 'go together'.

compare.diff: กับ comes before a noun, while ด้วย in the sense of 'also' comes at the end of the clause.
ก็ comes before the verb, while ด้วย 'also' comes at the end.

parts.note: ว 当元音 ua，ย 尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ว acts as the vowel ua; ย as a final reads i

senses.use: 句末语气词，让话语更柔和、带叮嘱或劝勉，如 ทำนะ

en.meaning: A soft particle placed at the end of a sentence to make it gentler. It often adds a tone of friendly advice, reminder, or encouragement, and does not change the literal meaning of the sentence.

senses.use: Ends a sentence to soften it, often as a gentle reminder or encouragement, as in 'ทำนะ' (do it, okay?).
Asks for agreement or confirmation, as in 'ไปนะ' (let's go, okay?).

parts.note: 语气词，按习惯读高调
parts.noteEn: A particle; by habit it is read with a high tone.

senses.use: 表示拥有或存在，如 มีสติ

en.meaning: A verb meaning to have something or for something to exist. It is used for possession and for saying that something is present, and it is also used before a noun such as สติ (awareness) to say someone has that quality.

senses.use: Shows possession or having a quality, as in 'มีสติ' (have awareness).
Says that something exists or is present, as in 'มีคนอยู่' (there are people).
连接名词，表示等同或身份，如 เป็นครู
表示变成某种状态或结果，如 กลายเป็น
表示掌握某种技能，如 เป็นภาษาไทย 说得来、ว่ายน้ำเป็น

en.meaning: A verb used to say what someone or something is, or to say it becomes a state. It can also mean being able to do a learned skill. It is not used before adjectives the way 'is' is in English.

senses.use: Shows a change into a state or result, as in 'กลายเป็น' (turn into).
Links a noun to its identity, as in 'เป็นครู' (is a teacher).
Means knowing how to do something learned, as in 'ว่ายน้ำเป็น' (can swim).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在辅音后读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 表示离开说话者往别处移动，如 ไปวัด
放在动词后表示动作持续进行，如 รู้สึกไปเรื่อยๆ

en.meaning: A verb meaning to go, moving away from the speaker. After another verb, it shows the action keeps going on, as in 'รู้สึกไปเรื่อยๆ' (keep being aware on and on).

senses.use: After a verb, shows the action continues, as in 'รู้สึกไปเรื่อยๆ' (keep feeling on and on).
Moves away from the speaker to another place, as in 'ไปวัด' (go to the temple).

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在辅音后读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 表示身心的感受或觉得，如 รู้สึกเย็น
与 ตัว 连用，表示觉察当下的自己，如 รู้สึกตัว

en.meaning: A verb meaning to feel or sense something in body or mind. Joined with ตัว as รู้สึกตัว, it means being aware of oneself in the present moment, which is a key Dhamma term for awareness.

senses.use: With ตัว, as in 'รู้สึกตัว', means knowing oneself in the present moment.
Describes a bodily or mental sensation, as in 'รู้สึกเย็น' (feel cool).

parts.note: ก 作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

senses.use: 表示做事、从事某种行为，如 ทำงาน
表示造业或制作，如 ทำบุญ、ทำอาหาર

en.meaning: A verb meaning to do, make, or carry out an action. It is used for work and everyday actions, and also for practice and for creating kamma, as in ทำบุญ (make merit).

senses.use: Carries out an action or practice, as in 'ทำงาน' (work) or 'ทำให้ได้' (make yourself able to do it).
Creates or produces something, as in 'ทำอาหาร' (cook food) or 'ทำบุญ' (make merit).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am, with an m ending

senses.use: 表示生命终止，如 ตายไป

en.meaning: A verb meaning to die, when life ends. It is used for people and animals. In Dhamma talks it often appears in the context of what kind of mind one dies with and where one is reborn.

senses.use: Life ends, as in 'ตายไป' (pass away).

parts.note: ย 作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i.

senses.use: 表示向说话者移动而来，如 มาวัด
放在动词后表示从过去延续到现在，如 ฝึกมา

en.meaning: A verb meaning to come, moving toward the speaker. After another verb, it shows something that has continued from the past up to now, as in 'ฝึกมา' (have been training).

senses.use: After a verb, shows something done from the past until now, as in 'ฝึกมา' (have trained).
Moves toward the speaker or a place, as in 'มาวัด' (come to the temple).
连接先后发生的事或并列追加的内容，如 แล้วก็ทำต่อ

en.meaning: A linking phrase meaning 'and then'. It joins one thing to what follows in time, or adds another point to the one just made.

senses.use: Links an event to the next one in order, as in 'แล้วก็ทำต่อ' (and then continue doing).
Adds another point to the previous one, as in 'ไม่ถูกแล้วก็ไม่พอ' (not right and also not enough).

parts.note: แ写在前面却在后面读；ว作尾音读 o
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it; ว as a final reads o.

parts.note: 读法特别：写法像 เก้าะ，元音是短的 aw，读 kâw
parts.noteEn: Irregular reading: it is written like เก้าะ, the vowel is a short aw, read kâw.

senses.use: 指自己本人，如 ตัวเองทำเอง

en.meaning: A noun meaning oneself or one's own self. It points back to the person who is doing the action. In Dhamma talks it often refers to one's own body and mind that one should be aware of.

senses.use: Points back to the person doing the action, as in 'ตัวเองทำเอง' (does it by oneself).

parts.note: ว是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读；อ只是占位
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is only a placeholder.

senses.use: 放在形容词或动词后表示程度最高，如 สำคัญที่สุด 最重要
ในที่สุด 表示经过一番过程，最后、终于

en.meaning: ที่สุด comes after an adjective or verb and means the highest degree, like "most" or "-est" in English. For example, สำคัญที่สุด means "most important". It can also appear as ในที่สุด, meaning "in the end" or "finally".

senses.use: After an adjective or verb to show the highest degree, as in ดีที่สุด "the best" or แย่ที่สุด "the worst".
In ในที่สุด, meaning that after some process or waiting, something happens in the end.

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 接在动词后，表示让某个状态持续，如 รู้สึกตัวไว้ 保持觉知
把东西存放起来以后用，如 เก็บไว้ 收着、ไว้ใช้ 留着用

en.meaning: ไว้ comes after a verb and means to keep something in a state or set it aside for later. For example, รู้สึกตัวไว้ means "keep awareness of the body". It is also used for saving things for future use, as in เก็บไว้ "keep it" or ไว้ใช้ "to use later".

senses.use: After a verb to mean keep a state going or hold something in place, as in มีสติไว้ or เลี้ยงไว้ "keep (an animal)".
To store or save something for future use, as in เก็บไว้ "put away" or ไว้ใช้ "to use later".

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读，读 ai
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it; it reads ai.

senses.use: 指一段时间或时刻，如 ไม่มีเวลา 没有时间
放在句首引出一个动作发生的时候，如 เวลาทำสมาธิ 修禅定时

en.meaning: เวลา means time, either an amount of time or a particular moment. At the start of a sentence it also means "when" or "while", introducing the situation in which something happens. For example, เวลาทำสมาธิ means "when practicing concentration".

senses.use: A period or moment of time, as in ไม่มีเวลา "no time" or เวลานอก "the other times".
At the start of a clause to say when or while something happens, as in เวลาทำสมาธิ "when practicing concentration".

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 把食物吃下去，如 กินข้าว 吃饭
占去时间、燃料、钱等，如 กินเวลา 耗时间

en.meaning: กิน means to eat. It is also used figuratively for something that uses up time, fuel or money, as in กินเวลา "takes up time". It is a plain, everyday word for eating.

senses.use: Putting food in the mouth and swallowing it, as in กินข้าว "eat rice / have a meal".
When something takes up time, money or resources, as in กินเวลา "takes time".
说方法、答案、做法没有错，如 ทำให้ถูก 做对
放在动词前表示遭受，如 ถูกตี 被打
说价钱低，如 ราคาถูก 价格便宜

en.meaning: ถูก means correct or right, said of a method, an answer or the way something is done. For example, ทำให้ถูก means "do it correctly". The same word also marks the passive ("to be hit") and means "cheap" when talking about price.

senses.use: When a method, answer or way of doing something is right, as in ทำให้ถูก "do it correctly" or สมาธิไม่ถูก "the concentration practice is wrong".
Before a verb to show that something unpleasant happens to the subject, as in ถูกตี "get hit".
When the price is low, as in ราคาถูก "low price".

parts.note: ก作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

senses.use: 说事物、人、状态好，如 ไม่ดี 不好

en.meaning: ดี means good. It describes people, things, conditions or results, and ไม่ดี means "not good". It is also used in compounds that describe character, such as ใจดี "kind-hearted".

senses.use: To say that something is of good quality or in a good state, as in ดีที่สุด "the best" or ไม่ดี "not good".
In compounds about the mind or character, as in ใจดี "kind, good-hearted".
拿取或想要某物，如 เอาไหม 要不要
把某人某物拿来当成、用作什么，如 เอาแม่มาทำเมีย 把母亲当成妻子

en.meaning: เอา means to take or to want something, as in เอาไหม "do you want it?". It also means to bring something, as in เอามา, or to take one thing and treat it as another, as in เอา...มาทำ... "take X and make it Y". It is a very common verb with many uses.

senses.use: To take or want something, as in เอาไหม "do you want it?".
In เอา A มาทำ B to mean use or treat A as B, as in เอาแม่มาทำเมีย "take its mother as its mate".
After a verb of motion or with มา/ไป to mean bring or fetch something, as in เอามาเลี้ยง "bring it home to raise".

parts.note: เ写在前面，但在辅音后面读；อ是零声母
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is a silent initial (no consonant sound).

senses.use: 用脚步前行，如 เดินไป 走去
机器、车辆、事情运行起来，如 เดินเครื่อง 开动机器

en.meaning: เดิน means to walk, moving forward on foot. It is also used for machines or processes that are running, as in เดินเครื่อง "start the engine". In practice talk it appears in เดินจงกรม, walking meditation.

senses.use: Moving on foot, as in เดินไป "walk there" or เดินจงกรม "walking meditation".
When a machine or process is going or operating, as in เดินเครื่อง "run the machine".

parts.note: เ写在前面，但在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 放在动词前表示以前有过这个经历，如 เคยเห็น 见过

en.meaning: เคย goes before a verb and shows that someone has done or experienced something before. For example, เคยเห็น means "have seen before". It can also mean having done something habitually in the past, like "used to".

senses.use: Before a verb to say one has had that experience, as in เคยฝึกมา "has trained before" or เคยอ่านเจอ "once read it".
Before a verb to say one did something habitually in the past, as in เคยทำ "used to do".

parts.note: เ写在前面，但在辅音后面读；ย是尾音，不是声母
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is the final, not the initial.

senses.use: 放在动词前表示没做或并没有，如 ไม่ได้ไป 没去
放在动词后表示做不到或不可以，如 ทำไม่ได้ 做不到

en.meaning: ไม่ได้ is a negative with two main uses. Before a verb it means "did not" or "has not", as in ไม่ได้ไป "did not go". After a verb it means "cannot" or "is not able to", as in ทำไม่ได้ "cannot do it".

senses.use: Before a verb to say something was not done or is not the case, as in ไม่ได้ตั้งมั่นจริง "was not truly steady".
After a verb to say one is unable to do it or it is not allowed, as in ทำไม่ได้ "can't do it".

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: ไ写在前面却在后面读；写法是短的 ai，平时说话拖长读 dâai
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it; it is spelled as a short ai, but in speech it is drawn out and read dâai.

senses.use: 否定一个判断或身份；常用 ไม่ใช่ว่า… 表示“而不是…”，用来对比纠正

en.meaning: ไม่ใช่ means "is not" or "it isn't." It denies that something is true or that something is a certain thing. It is often used as ไม่ใช่ว่า... ("it's not that...") to correct a wrong idea and set it against the right one.

senses.use: Denies a statement or identity, as in นั่นไม่ใช่หมา ("that is not a dog").
In ไม่ใช่ว่า..., it corrects a mistaken idea by contrasting it with the right one.

parts.note: ไ写在前面，但在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

parts.note: ใ写在前面，但在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 人坐着，身体坐下的姿势或动作
后面接 สมาธิ，指坐着修禅定
后面接交通工具，如 นั่งรถ（坐车）

en.meaning: นั่ง means "to sit," the posture or the act of sitting down. It is also used in set phrases, such as นั่งสมาธิ (sit in meditation) and นั่งรถ (ride in a car).

senses.use: The body is in a seated posture, as in นั่งอยู่ ("is sitting").
Followed by สมาธิ, as in นั่งสมาธิ, it means sitting to practice meditation.
Followed by a vehicle, as in นั่งรถ ("go by car").

words.zh: （放在动词前，把动作变成名词）

detail.meaning: （放在动词前，把动作变成名词）

senses.use: 放在动词前，把动作变成名词，如 การปฏิบัติ（修行）

en.meaning: การ is a word placed before a verb to turn the action into a noun. It works like "-ing" or "the act of" in English. It is not usually translated by itself.

senses.use: Placed before a verb to make it a noun, as in การปฏิบัติ ("practice") and การสะสม ("accumulating").

parts.note: 尾音ร读成 n
parts.noteEn: Final ร reads n

senses.use: 表示动作持续到某个时点或结果，如 จนโต（直到长大）
指没钱、贫穷，如 คนจน（穷人）

en.meaning: จน means "until": an action goes on up to a certain point or result. It also means "poor," having little money, and this is a separate meaning of the same spelling.

senses.use: An action continues to a point or result, as in จนโต ("until grown up").
Having little money, as in คนจน ("a poor person").

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 数量、程度多，如 ทำเยอะๆ（多多地做）

en.meaning: เยอะ means "a lot" or "many/much." It is a casual, common word for large quantity or degree. Repeating it as เยอะๆ means "a lot, plenty," often when urging someone to do something a lot.

senses.use: Large amount or degree, as in ทำเยอะๆ ("do a lot").

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读；อ在这里是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. Here อ is part of the vowel.

words.thai: เรียน รู้

senses.use: 学习并了解某事，如 เรียนรู้ได้เร็ว、เรียนรู้เรื่อยๆ

en.meaning: To learn and come to understand something by studying it or by experience. It suggests a gradual process of picking things up over time, and is often used for learning the practice, with the idea that some people learn quickly and some slowly.

senses.use: Gaining knowledge or understanding step by step, as in เรียนรู้ได้เร็ว or เรียนรู้เรื่อยๆ.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 数量或程度足够，如 ไม่พอ（不够）、พอแล้ว（够了）
พอ…ก็… 的句型，表示一发生某事紧接着就发生另一事

en.meaning: พอ means "enough": the amount or degree is sufficient. It is also used in the pattern พอ...ก็... ("as soon as... then..."), where one thing happens right after another.

senses.use: Amount or degree is sufficient, as in ไม่พอ ("not enough") and พอแล้ว ("that's enough").
In พอ...ก็..., the second event follows right after the first.

parts.note: อ在这里是元音，不是辅音
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel, not a consonant

senses.use: 想得到某物或想做某事，如 อยากได้（想要）、อยากเป็น（想成为）
作为名词 ความอยาก，指内心的欲求、贪求

en.meaning: อยาก means "to want": to wish to get something or do something. As the noun ความอยาก it means craving, an inner wanting or desire. In Dhamma talks it can refer to craving as a defilement.

senses.use: Wishing to get or do something, as in อยากได้ ("want to get") and อยากเป็น ("want to be").
As ความอยาก, the inner wanting or desire that drives the mind.

parts.note: อ不发音，只是把ย的声调提成中调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only lifts the tone of ย to the mid tone

senses.use: 把信息、话讲给别人，也指开示、说出，如 บอกว่า…（说…）
后接 ให้，表示叫人去做某事，如 บอกให้ทำ

en.meaning: บอก means "to tell": to give information or say something to someone. When followed by ให้, as in บอกให้ทำ, it means telling someone to do something. It can also mean to explain or to teach, depending on the speaker.

senses.use: Passing information or words to someone, as in บอกว่า... ("said that...").
Followed by ให้, as in บอกให้ทำ ("told (someone) to do it").

parts.note: อ在这里是元音，不是辅音
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel, not a consonant

senses.use: 在空中飘浮不着地；心飘走用 ใจลอย，指走神、发呆
漂浮在水面上，如 ลอยน้ำ

en.meaning: ลอย means "to float": to drift in the air or on water without settling. In ใจลอย it describes a mind that has drifted away from the present, meaning absent-minded or spaced out. In Dhamma talks it describes a mind that is not aware of itself.

senses.use: Drifting on water or in the air, as in ลอยน้ำ ("float on water").
In ใจลอย, the mind wanders away and goes blank or absent-minded.

parts.note: อ是元音；尾音ย读成 i
parts.noteEn: อ is a vowel. Final ย reads i

senses.use: 时间长，常说 นานแล้ว（很久了）、นานมาก

en.meaning: Describes a long span of time. It is often used after a verb or with แล้ว (already) and มาก (very), as in นานแล้ว (a long time ago) and นานมาก (a very long time).

senses.use: Says that a period of time is long, as in นานแล้ว or เกิดซ้ำๆ นาน.
尊称第三人称，指受尊敬的人，如 ท่านบอก（他说）
尊称第二人称，当面称呼对方，如 ท่านสบายดีไหม

en.meaning: A respectful pronoun used for a person who deserves respect, such as a monk, teacher or elder. It can refer to someone being talked about (he, she) or be used to address someone politely (you). In Dhamma talks it often refers to revered teachers.

senses.use: Refers to a respected person being talked about, as in ท่านบอก (he said).
Politely addresses a respected person directly, as in ท่านสบายดีไหม.
饲养、抚养动物或孩子，如 เลี้ยงหมา
出钱请人吃喝，如 เลี้ยงข้าว（请吃饭）

en.meaning: To look after and feed someone or something so that it grows, such as an animal or a child. It can also mean to treat someone to food or drink.

senses.use: Keeps and cares for an animal or child until it grows, as in หมาที่เลี้ยงไว้.
Pays for someone's meal or drink, as in เลี้ยงข้าว.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；ย 是元音的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is part of the vowel, not a final.

senses.use: 一点一点积聚，如 สะสมบุญ（积累功德）
把东西收集起来保存，如 สะสมแสตมป์（集邮）

en.meaning: To gather something little by little over time until it builds up. It is used for both good and bad things, such as merit or delusion, and also for collecting objects as a hobby.

senses.use: Builds something up gradually, as in สะสมบุญ or สะสมโมหะ (accumulating delusion).
Gathers objects as a collection, as in สะสมแสตมป์.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 由低到高，如 ขึ้นไป、ขึ้นรถ（上车）
放在动词后表示生起、开始，如 เกิดขึ้น（生起）
与 มาก/ดี 连用表示程度增加，如 มากขึ้น（更多）

en.meaning: A very common word whose basic meaning is to go up or rise. After another verb it shows that something arises or begins. After words like มาก (more) or ดี (good) it shows that the degree increases.

senses.use: Follows words like มาก or ดี to show increase, as in หลงมากขึ้น (more and more lost).
Follows a verb to show something comes into being, as in เกิดขึ้น.
Describes movement from low to high or getting on, as in ขึ้นไป or ขึ้นรถ.
尽力去做某事，如 พยายามรู้สึกตัว

en.meaning: To put effort into doing something and not give up. It is followed by the thing one is trying to do, as in พยายามรู้สึกตัว (try to be aware of oneself).

senses.use: Makes an effort to do something, as in พยายามรู้สึกตัว.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

senses.use: 指一部分人，常与另一个 บางคน 对举

en.meaning: A phrase meaning 'some people', referring to a part of a group rather than everyone. It is often said twice in a row to contrast one kind of person with another.

senses.use: Pointing to part of a group, often contrasted with another บางคน, as in บางคนเร็ว บางคนช้า.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 能力强、有本事，如 เก่งมาก
某方面做得好，如 เก่งภาษา（擅长语言）

en.meaning: Describes someone who is capable, clever or good at something. It can be used by itself for general ability, or with a skill to say what the person is good at.

senses.use: Describes strong ability, as in เก่งมาก or ทำบ่อยๆ ก็เก่ง.
Followed by a field to say what someone does well, as in เก่งภาษา.

parts.note: 写法像长 ee，实际读短 e
parts.noteEn: It looks like a long ee but is read as a short e

senses.use: 不拥有、不存在，如 ไม่มีใคร（没有人）

en.meaning: A negative word meaning that something does not exist or is not possessed. It is placed before the thing that is absent, such as a person, a quality or an object.

senses.use: Saying something is absent or does not exist, as in ไม่มีใคร (no one).
Saying someone lacks something, as in ไม่มีสติ (has no awareness).

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 反复训练使熟练，如 ฝึกสติ、ฝึกทำ

en.meaning: To train or practise something again and again until one becomes skilled. It is used for skills and for the mind, as in ฝึกสติ (train awareness).

senses.use: Trains repeatedly to become skilled, as in ฝึกสติ or ฝึกทำ.
做事、修行的办法或做法，如 วิธีปฏิบัติ（修行的方法）

en.meaning: A way or method of doing something, such as a practice, a skill or a task. It often comes before the thing being done, as in วิธีปฏิบัติ (method of practice). In these talks it means the correct way to train the mind.

senses.use: A particular way of doing or practicing something, as in วิธีฝึก (method of training).
The manner or procedure by which something is done, as in มีวิธีอะไร (what way is there?).
指那样、那么，如 อย่างงั้น（像那样）
承接上文引出结论或建议，相当于「那就、那么」，如 งั้นไปเลย
叠用表示普通、不怎么样，如 งั้นๆ

en.meaning: A spoken word that links back to what was just said and draws a conclusion or suggestion from it, like 'so then' or 'in that case'. It can also mean 'like that', and when doubled it means 'so-so'.

senses.use: Introduces a conclusion or suggestion that follows from what was just said, as in งั้นไปเลย (then let's go).
Points to that manner or kind, as in อย่างงั้น (like that).
Doubled as งั้นๆ, it means ordinary or unremarkable.
表示先做某事，放在动词后，如 ไปก่อน（先走）
指过去、之前，或放在事情前表示「在……之前」，如 ก่อนนอน（睡前）

en.meaning: A word about order in time. It means 'first' (do this before other things) or 'before' (earlier than something). It can also point to the past, meaning 'formerly'.

senses.use: Placed after a verb to mean doing it first, as in ไปก่อน (go first) or ทำตรงนี้ก่อน (do this part first).
Placed before a noun or verb to mean earlier than that event, as in ก่อนนอน (before sleeping).
Refers to an earlier time in the past, as in เคยเลี้ยงไว้ก่อน (kept one earlier).
记不起来、忘了做某事，如 ลืมตัว（忘我）
只用于 ลืมตา（睁开眼睛）

en.meaning: To forget, meaning to fail to remember something or to fail to do it. In Dhamma talks, ลืมตัว means forgetting oneself, that is, living without awareness of one's own body and mind. In ลืมตา it means to open the eyes.

senses.use: Not remembering, or neglecting to do something, as in ลืมตัว (forget oneself, lose awareness of oneself).
Used only in ลืมตา, meaning to open the eyes.
不容易做到，如 ทำยาก（难做）

en.meaning: Describes something hard to do or hard to achieve. It comes after the verb, as in ทำยาก (hard to do). In some compounds, such as ยากจน, it relates to being poor or in hardship.

senses.use: Not easy to do or achieve, as in ไม่ยากเกินไป (not too difficult).
In ยากจน it means poor or hard up.
口语里放在名词或句中，加强语气、强调所指的事物

en.meaning: A spoken particle that stresses the thing just mentioned, like 'this one here' or 'this very thing'. It adds emphasis or marks a topic and has no exact English equivalent. It is common in casual speech.

senses.use: Placed after a noun or phrase to stress it, as in ภพเนี่ย (this very state of existence).

parts.note: 元音写在前面，后面的ย属于元音
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it; the ย that follows is part of the vowel

senses.use: 指生气、恼怒、嗔恨的心

en.meaning: The mental state of aversion: anger, irritation, ill will or hatred toward something. It is one of the three roots of defilements, along with greed and delusion. In these talks it is also the state of mind that leads to rebirth in hell when someone dies under its force.

senses.use: The defilement of pushing away, disliking or being angry at something, as in จิตที่มีโทสะ (a mind with aversion).
Ordinary anger or irritation in the mind.

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it

words.thai: สัตว์ อื่น

senses.use: 指自己以外的其他动物或众生

en.meaning: Other animals, or other living beings besides oneself. It is สัตว์ (animal, being) plus อื่น (other). In Dhamma talks it often refers to creatures that one could harm, bite or steal from.

senses.use: Animals other than the one being talked about, as in ไม่กัดสัตว์อื่น (doesn't bite other animals).
Other living beings in general, as in ไม่ทำร้ายสัตว์อื่น (doesn't harm other beings).

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

parts.note: อ 是空声母，不发辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial; it makes no consonant sound

senses.use: 用牙齿咬，如 หมากัด（狗咬）

en.meaning: To bite, using the teeth. It is commonly used for dogs and other animals, as in หมากัด (a dog bites). It can also be used figuratively, as in กัดฟัน (clench one's teeth).

senses.use: To seize or wound with the teeth, as in หมากัด (a dog bites).

parts.note: ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 在旁看管、监督，使不偏离，如 สติกำกับ（有觉性管着）
指导拍摄，如 กำกับหนัง（导演电影）

en.meaning: To keep watch over something so that it does not go off course, or to supervise it. In Dhamma talks, สติกำกับ means awareness overseeing the practice, such as sitting or walking meditation. Without it the practice does not work. It is also the word for directing a film.

senses.use: To watch over and keep something on track, as in สติกำกับ (awareness overseeing the practice).
To direct a film or performance, as in กำกับหนัง (direct a movie).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带尾音 m
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own final m

parts.note: บ 作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: บ as a final reads p

senses.use: 判断、等同，A 就是 B，如「มัน ก็ คือ…」
引出解释或说明，意思是、也就是说，如「ปัญหา คือ…」

en.meaning: A linking word meaning "is" or "namely". It joins two things to say that one is the same as the other, or introduces an explanation of what was just named. It is common in definitions and when stating a point, as in "the problem is...".

senses.use: Introduces an explanation or statement of what something is, as in "ปัญหา คือ…" (the problem is…).
Equates A with B, as in "มัน ก็ คือ…" (that is simply…).
一日、每天，如「ทุก วัน」「ทั้ง วัน」
指某个特定的日期或日子，如「วัน นี้」

en.meaning: The word for a day, either the whole span of daytime and night or a particular date. It is often combined with other words, such as "every day" or "all day long", and is also used in "today" (วันนี้).

senses.use: A day as a period of time, as in "ทุก วัน" (every day) and "ทั้ง วัน" (all day).
A particular day, as in "วัน นี้" (today).
禁止、劝阻，放在动词前，如「อย่า ให้ ขาด」

en.meaning: A word placed before a verb to tell someone not to do something. It is used for prohibiting, warning or advising against an action, and is often followed by "ให้" as in "อย่า ให้ ขาด" (don't let it break off).

senses.use: Forbids or discourages an action, placed before a verb, as in "อย่า ให้ ขาด".

parts.note: อ 不发音，只带着 ย 定声调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only carries the tone for ย

senses.use: 放在名词前，表示全部、整个，如「ทั้ง วัน」「ทั้ง หมด」
「ทั้ง…ทั้ง…」连接并列的两项，既…又…

en.meaning: A word meaning "whole" or "all". It is placed before a noun to show that the entire thing is included, as in "all day" or "all of it". It can also be used in pairs (ทั้ง…ทั้ง…) to mean "both…and…".

senses.use: Placed before a noun to mean the entire thing, as in "ทั้ง วัน" and "ทั้ง หมด".
In "ทั้ง…ทั้ง…", joins two items together.
持续不断地做，如「รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ」
平平常常、不着急地，如「สบาย ๆ เรื่อย ๆ」

en.meaning: A word showing that an action goes on steadily without stopping, or is done in a relaxed, ordinary way. It follows a verb, as in "รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ" (keep being aware continually).

senses.use: An action carries on without a break, as in "รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ".
Done in an easy, unhurried, ordinary way, as in "สบาย ๆ เรื่อย ๆ".

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 速度快、进展快，如「เรียน รู้ ได้ เร็ว」
时间上提前，如「มา เร็ว」

en.meaning: A word meaning fast or quick. It describes speed or how quickly something progresses, such as learning quickly. It can also mean early in time.

senses.use: Quick in speed or progress, as in "เรียน รู้ ได้ เร็ว" (learns quickly).
Ahead of the expected time, as in "มา เร็ว" (come early).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在 ร 后读；ว 作尾音读 o
parts.noteEn: เ is written before but read after ร. Final ว reads o

senses.use: 速度慢、进展慢，如「เรียน รู้ ได้ ช้า」
迟、耽误，如「มา ช้า」

en.meaning: A word meaning slow. It describes low speed or slow progress, such as learning slowly. It can also mean late or delayed.

senses.use: Slow in speed or progress, as in "เรียน รู้ ได้ ช้า" (learns slowly).
Behind the expected time, as in "มา ช้า" (come late).
起初、开始的时候，如「ตั้ง แต่ แรก」
排在最前面的，如「จุด แรก」

en.meaning: A word meaning first or at the beginning. It refers to the start of something or the item that comes first in order. It is often used in "ตั้ง แต่ แรก" (from the start) and "จุด แรก" (the first point).

senses.use: The item that comes first in order, as in "จุด แรก" (the first point).
The start of something, as in "ตั้ง แต่ แรก" (from the very beginning).

parts.note: แ 写在前面，在 ร 后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after ร.

words.zh: （语气词，跟「不」一起用，加强否定）

detail.meaning: （语气词，跟「不」一起用，加强否定）

senses.use: 句尾语气词，常与「ไม่」连用加强否定，如「ไม่ มี หรอก」

en.meaning: A particle placed at the end of a sentence. It is mostly used with "ไม่" (not) to make a denial stronger and softer at the same time, like "not at all" or "of course not". It has no meaning of its own in English.

senses.use: Ends a sentence, usually with "ไม่", to emphasize a denial, as in "ไม่ มี หรอก" (there isn't any, you know).

parts.note: ห 不发音，只让 ร 读低调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only makes ร read with a low tone

senses.use: 口语的「他、她、他们」，指第三人称，如「เค้า เคย ฝึก มา」
口语里亲昵地自称，常见于年轻人之间

en.meaning: A spoken form of the third-person pronoun, meaning he, she or they. It is used in casual speech, in place of the more formal "เขา". In some casual settings, people also use it to refer to themselves.

senses.use: Refers to another person or other people in casual speech, as in "เค้า เคย ฝึก มา" (they have trained before).
Used casually and affectionately for oneself, mostly among younger people.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在 ค 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ค.

senses.use: 指一个个分开来说的每一个，如 แต่ ละ คน（每个人）、แต่ ละ อย่าง（每一种）

en.meaning: แต่ ละ means "each" or "every one separately". It goes before a noun or classifier and picks out the members of a group one at a time, rather than the group as a whole. It is often used when people or things differ from one another.

senses.use: Picks out every individual in a group, as in แต่ ละ คน (each person) and แต่ ละ อย่าง (each kind).

parts.note: แ 写在前面，在 ต 后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after ต.

senses.use: 放在主语或话题后面，提示停顿、强调所说的内容，如 พวกเรา น่ะ（我们啊）
句末用来强调或解释，带“就是这样”的口气，如 ก็ อย่าง นี้ น่ะ

en.meaning: น่ะ is a spoken particle with no direct English equivalent. After a subject or topic it marks a small pause and draws attention to what follows. At the end of a sentence it adds an explaining or "that's just how it is" tone.

senses.use: Follows the subject to highlight it, as in พวกเรา น่ะ (as for us...).
Ends a sentence to stress or explain, as in ก็ อย่าง นี้ น่ะ (it's just like this).
在已有的基础上再往前发展、提升
植物学上把枝条接在原树上，即字面意思

en.meaning: ต่อ ยอด means to build on what already exists and take it further. It is used for developing skills, knowledge or qualities from a base you already have. Literally it means grafting a shoot onto a plant.

senses.use: Develop further from an existing foundation, as in ต่อ ยอด ของ ตัว เอง (build on one's own base).
In gardening, attach a cutting to an existing tree.

parts.note: ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 对长老、高僧的尊称，也用来自称

en.meaning: หลวง พ่อ is a respectful title for an elder or senior monk, literally "venerable father". Monks may also use it to refer to themselves. In English it is usually kept as "Luang Por".

senses.use: Respectful title for a senior monk, used by others or by the monk speaking of himself.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只带声调；ว 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only carries the tone; ว is part of the vowel

senses.use: 指某个位置、要点或阶段，如 จุด อ่อน（弱点）、จุด แรก（第一点）
指点火、点灯，如 จุด ไฟ
指圆点、句点、小斑点

en.meaning: จุด means a point, meaning a particular place, spot or key item. It can also mean a stage or a main issue. As a verb it means to light something such as a fire or lamp, and it can also mean a dot.

senses.use: A spot, key item or stage, as in จุด อ่อน (weak point) and จุด แรก (first point).
To ignite something, as in จุด ไฟ (light a fire).
A small round mark or full stop.

parts.note: ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 表示数量或程度大，叠词加强语气，常放在动词后，如 ทำ เยอะ ๆ

en.meaning: เยอะ ๆ means "lots" or "a great deal". The doubled form adds emphasis to เยอะ (many, much). It is often placed after a verb to say do it a lot, as in ทำ เยอะ ๆ.

senses.use: Large amount or degree, often after a verb, as in ทำ เยอะ ๆ (do it a lot).

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

words.thai: เดิน จงกรม

senses.use: 指来回走动的行禅，边走边修觉知

en.meaning: เดิน จงกรม means walking meditation. It is practised by walking back and forth along a path while keeping awareness of the body and mind. It is one of the main formal practices alongside sitting meditation.

senses.use: Formal practice of walking back and forth while cultivating awareness.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 指事、事项、事务，如 เรื่อง ตัว เอง（自己的事）
指叙述的故事、情节
放在名词前引出话题，如 เรื่อง เวียน ว่าย ตาย เกิด（关于轮回）

en.meaning: เรื่อง means a matter, affair or topic. It can also mean a story. Before a noun it means "about" or "concerning" and introduces the subject being discussed.

senses.use: An affair or subject, as in เรื่อง ตัว เอง (one's own affairs).
A narrative or plot.
Introduces a topic, as in เรื่อง เวียน ว่าย ตาย เกิด (about the cycle of birth and death).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

senses.use: 指自己以外的其他人

en.meaning: คน อื่น means "other people" or "others", anyone apart from oneself. It is often set against ตัว เอง (oneself) to contrast what we notice in others with what we notice in ourselves.

senses.use: People other than oneself, often contrasted with ตัว เอง.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: อ 是空声母，不发辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial; it makes no consonant sound

senses.use: 指全都、一点不剩，如 รู้ หมด（全都知道）、ทั้ง หมด（全部）
指东西耗尽、没有了，如 เงิน หมด（钱用完了）
指时间、事情到了尽头，如 หมด เวลา（时间到）

en.meaning: หมด means everything, with nothing left, and also to run out or come to an end. It is used after a verb to say something was done completely, as in รู้ หมด (know it all). It is also used for things being used up or finished.

senses.use: All of it, completely, as in รู้ หมด (know everything) and ทั้ง หมด (all of it).
Used up, as in เงิน หมด (money has run out).
Time or an event has finished, as in หมด เวลา (time is up).

parts.note: ห 不发音，只管声调；隐藏元音 o；ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; hidden vowel o; ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 指品质、状态不好，如 เขาไม่ดี（他不好）
指身体或心情不佳，如 รู้สึกไม่ดี（感觉不好受）
指处境不好、不容易，如 ลำบาก ไม่ดี（很难、不利）

en.meaning: A phrase meaning 'not good', made from the negative ไม่ and ดี (good). It describes a person, thing, or situation as bad, unpleasant, or difficult. In talks it can point to someone's faults, or to a hard, unfavorable situation.

senses.use: Describes a person or thing as having faults or poor quality, as in เขาไม่ดี (he is not good).
Describes a bad feeling in body or mind, as in รู้สึกไม่ดี (feel unwell, feel bad).
Describes a hard or unfavorable situation, as in สัตว์เดรัจฉานไม่ดี ลำบาก (animals have it hard).

parts.note: ไ 写在前面，却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 问方式、状况，如 รู้สึกยังไง（感觉怎样）
问如何做、为何，如 ทำยังไง（怎么做）

en.meaning: A spoken Thai question word meaning 'how' or 'in what way'. It asks about the manner or state of something. It is the casual form of ยังไง, also written อย่างไร in formal speech.

senses.use: Asks about a state or manner, as in รู้สึกยังไง (how do you feel).
Asks how something is done or what is wrong, as in ทำยังไง (how do you do it) or เขาไม่ดียังไง (in what way is he bad).

parts.note: ไ 写在前面，却在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 指另外的人或事物，如 คนอื่น（别人）、อย่างอื่น（别的）

en.meaning: A word meaning 'other' or 'another'. It comes after a noun to point to someone or something different from the one already mentioned. In talks it often contrasts other people with oneself.

senses.use: Refers to a different person or thing, as in คนอื่น (other people) or อย่างอื่น (something else).

parts.note: อ 是空声母，不发辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial; it makes no consonant sound

senses.use: 连接选项，如 A หรือ B（A或者B）
句尾表疑问，如 ใช่หรือ（是吗）

en.meaning: A word meaning 'or' that joins two choices or possibilities. At the end of a sentence it also turns the sentence into a yes/no question. Which use applies depends on where it sits in the sentence.

senses.use: Joins alternatives, as in เดินใจลอยหรือเดินเคร่ง ๆ (walking absent-minded or walking tensely).
Placed at the end of a sentence to ask a yes/no question, as in ใช่หรือ (is that so?).

parts.note: ห 不发音，只管声调；อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; อ is part of the vowel

senses.use: 指身心用力过度、紧绷，如 เดินเคร่ง ๆ（紧绷地走）
指对规矩、戒律要求严，如 เคร่งครัด（严格）

en.meaning: A repeated form of เคร่ง, meaning stiff, tight, or forcing oneself too hard. In practice talks it describes a mind or body that is held tensely and strained, the opposite of relaxed. The same root also means being strict about rules, as in เคร่งครัด.

senses.use: Describes forcing the body or mind too tightly, as in เดินเคร่ง ๆ (walking in a strained way).
Describes being rigorous about rules or discipline, as in เคร่งครัด (strict).

parts.note: 写法像长 ee，实际读短 e
parts.noteEn: It looks like a long ee but is read as a short e

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 指动物或人的肉，如 เนื้อหมู（猪肉）
指文章、事情的主体内容，如 เนื้อหา（内容）
固定搭配 เนื้อตัว（身体、自身），如 ลืมเนื้อลืมตัว（忘我）

en.meaning: A word meaning 'flesh' or 'meat', and by extension the main substance of something. In the fixed phrase เนื้อตัว it refers to one's own body or self. In the phrase ลืมเนื้อลืมตัว it means forgetting oneself, losing self-awareness.

senses.use: In the phrase เนื้อตัว or อยู่กับเนื้อกับตัว (stay with oneself); ลืมเนื้อลืมตัว means to forget oneself.
Means animal or human flesh, as in เนื้อหมู (pork).
Means the main substance of a text or matter, as in เนื้อหา (content).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读，อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

senses.use: 指身体平卧，如 นอนลง（躺下）
指睡觉，如 นอนหลับ（睡着）

en.meaning: A verb meaning to lie down, and also to sleep. Context shows which is meant: นอนลง is lying down, while นอนหลับ is falling asleep. It is one of the four basic postures (standing, walking, sitting, lying down).

senses.use: Describes the body lying flat, as in นอนลง or the posture in ยืน เดิน นั่ง นอน.
Describes sleeping, as in นอนหลับ (fall asleep).

parts.note: อ 在这里是元音 aw，不是声母
parts.noteEn: Here อ is the vowel aw, not an initial consonant

senses.use: 指东西、症状不见了，如 หายไป（消失不见）
指病痛好了，如 หายป่วย（病好了）
固定搭配 หายใจ（呼吸），如 หายใจเข้า（吸气）

en.meaning: A verb meaning to disappear, be lost, or recover. It can describe something that is gone, or an illness that has gone away. It is also part of the fixed word หายใจ, meaning 'to breathe'.

senses.use: In the fixed word หายใจ, as in หายใจเข้า (breathe in) and หายใจออก (breathe out).
Means something is gone or lost, as in หายไป (gone away).
Means an illness has gone, as in หายป่วย (recover from illness).

parts.note: 尾音 ย 读成 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i

senses.use: 指心情舒畅开朗，如 จิตใจเบิกบาน（心愉悦）
指花朵绽放，如 ดอกไม้เบิกบาน（花盛开）

en.meaning: A word describing a mind or heart that feels open, bright, and cheerful. It is used for a pleasant, fresh state of mind, and is also used for flowers in full bloom. It is the opposite of a mind that is dull, sunken, or heavy.

senses.use: Describes a bright, open, happy mind, as in จิตใจเบิกบาน (a joyful mind).
Describes flowers opening fully, as in ดอกไม้เบิกบาน (flowers in bloom).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

detail.meaning: 走神、一时忘了觉知；口语也说「说不定」

senses.use: 指心不在当下、忘了觉知，如 เผลอ（一不留神）
口语，指有可能，如 เผลอ ๆ ก็…（搞不好就……）

en.meaning: A repeated form of เผลอ, meaning to be absent-minded, to drift off and lose awareness for a moment. In Dhamma talks it describes a mind that has wandered away from the present and forgotten to be aware. It can also be a casual way to say 'maybe' or 'before you know it'.

senses.use: Describes the mind drifting and forgetting awareness, as in เพลิน ๆ เผลอ ๆ (drifting along, off in a daze).
Used in casual speech to mean 'it could happen that', as in เผลอ ๆ ก็… (before you know it, perhaps…).

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

words.thai: ส่วน ใหญ่

senses.use: 指绝大多数、多半，如 ส่วนใหญ่จะรู้สึกอย่างนั้น

en.meaning: The larger part of something, meaning most or the majority. It is used when saying that something is true of most people or most cases, though not all.

senses.use: Referring to the majority of a group, as in ส่วนใหญ่จะรู้สึกอย่างนั้น (most feel that way).
Saying something is generally the case, with some exceptions.

parts.note: ว 是元音 ua 的一部分，ั 省略了
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel ua; the ั is left out

parts.note: ห 不发音只带声调，ญ 读 y；ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; ญ reads y; ใ is written in front but read after the consonant

senses.use: 使某事物产生某种结果或状态，如 ทำให้เกิด
把事情做出来、做成，常带 ได้，如 ทำให้ได้
为某人做某事，如 ทำให้หน่อย

en.meaning: A common phrase with several uses. It can mean to make something happen or bring about a result, to manage to do something, or to do something for someone else.

senses.use: Bringing about a result or state, as in ทำให้เกิด (cause to arise).
Managing to do or complete something, usually with ได้, as in ทำให้ได้ (be able to do it).
Doing something on someone's behalf, as in ทำให้หน่อย (please do it for me).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own m ending

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 把事情记在心里，如 จำได้
认出人或物，如 จำหน้าได้
不得不，如 จำต้อง

en.meaning: Means to remember something or to recognise someone or something. It refers to keeping something in memory. In the talk it appears in จำไม่ได้ ("I can't remember"), used to hedge about a half-remembered story.

senses.use: Keeps something in memory, as in จำได้ ("remember") and จำไม่ได้ ("can't remember").
Identifies a person or thing as known, as in จำหน้าได้ ("recognise the face").
Means to be forced to or have no choice, as in จำต้อง.

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own m ending

senses.use: 轮回中的一生，如 ๕๐๐ ชาติ
指国家、民族，如 ประเทศชาติ
指出生、种姓出身，如 ชาติตระกูล

en.meaning: Here it means "a lifetime," one whole life from birth to death within the cycle of rebirth. It is counted with numbers, as in 500 ชาติ ("500 lifetimes"). The same word also means "nation" and "birth."

senses.use: Counts lives in the cycle of rebirth, as in เกิดเป็นหมาป่า 500 ชาติ.
Means a country or a people, as in ประเทศชาติ.
Means the background one is born into, as in ชาติตระกูล.

parts.note: ต 作尾音读 t，ิ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ต as a final reads t; ิ is silent

senses.use: 分辨是非对错，如 รู้ผิดชอบ

en.meaning: Right and wrong, the ability to tell what is proper from what is improper. It is usually paired with ชั่วดี and used for moral judgment. Having it means being aware that actions have right and wrong sides.

senses.use: Moral discernment, as in รู้ผิดชอบ (know right from wrong).

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

parts.note: บ作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: บ as a final reads p

senses.use: 分辨好坏善恶，如 รู้ชั่วดี

en.meaning: Bad and good, meaning good and evil. It describes the quality of actions or people in moral terms. It is often said together with ผิดชอบ as a pair for moral understanding.

senses.use: Telling bad from good in moral terms, as in รู้ชั่วดี.

parts.note: ว是元音的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel, not a final consonant

senses.use: 口语句末或停顿时的语气词，表示强调、提醒或停顿

en.meaning: A casual spoken particle added at the end of a phrase or at a pause. It adds emphasis, draws the listener's attention, or simply marks a pause. It has no fixed meaning of its own and is typical of relaxed, informal speech.

senses.use: Adds emphasis or a pause at the end of a phrase in casual speech, as in มันมีความทุกข์อ่ะ.

words.thai: อย่าง นี้

senses.use: 指这种方式或情形，如 ทำอย่างนี้

en.meaning: A phrase meaning 'in this way' or 'like this'. It points to a manner, situation or example that has just been mentioned or is being shown.

senses.use: Pointing to a way of doing something or a situation, as in ไม่น่าทำอย่างนี้เลย (I shouldn't have done this).
Referring back to a situation just described, as in อย่างนี้ตายไป... (in this case, when it dies...).

parts.note: อ不发音，只用来带声调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only carries the tone

senses.use: 认识某人某物，或懂得某件事，如 รู้จักทำทาน

en.meaning: To know or be acquainted with a person or thing, or to know how to do something. It is a more familiar kind of knowing than just having heard of it, and it can also mean having come to see or realize something.

senses.use: Knowing a person or thing, or knowing how to do something, as in รู้จักทำทาน (know how to give).
Becoming aware of something, as in รู้จักผิดชอบชั่วดี (come to know right and wrong).

parts.note: ก作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

words.thai: อะไร เงี้ย

senses.use: 列举后表示等等、这类，如 หมาฝรั่งอะไรเงี้ย

en.meaning: A casual spoken phrase that comes after an example and means 'something like that' or 'and so on'. It makes the example sound loose and not exact. เงี้ย is a spoken form of อย่างนี้.

senses.use: Ending an example to suggest other similar things, as in หมาฝรั่งอะไรเงี้ย (a Westerner's dog or something like that).
Ending a casual statement in a loose way.

parts.note: 元音写在前面，在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it

parts.note: 元音写在前面，在后面读；声调符号写在 ี 上面
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it; the tone mark sits above ี

senses.use: 过得艰难、吃苦受累，如 ชีวิตลำบาก
事情难做、不容易，如 ทำลำบาก
给人添麻烦、不方便，如 ขอโทษที่ทำให้ลำบาก

en.meaning: ลำบาก describes a life or situation that is hard, full of struggle or suffering. It can also mean that something is difficult to do, or that something is a trouble or inconvenience to someone. In the talk it describes a hard, unfortunate existence, such as being reborn as an animal.

senses.use: Describes a hard, unfortunate life or state, as in ชีวิตลำบาก or an unlucky rebirth.
Describes a task or situation that is hard to do, as in ทำลำบาก.
Means causing trouble or inconvenience to someone, as in ขอโทษที่ทำให้ลำบาก.

parts.note: ำ读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

parts.note: ก作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

senses.use: 表示来源或起点，如 มาจากจุฬา
作动词，离别、离去，如 จากบ้านไป

en.meaning: จาก is a small word that marks where something starts or comes from. It can also be a verb meaning to leave or part from a person or place. In the talk it means 'from', as in picking up a dog from Chula, or changing from the state of a dog.

senses.use: Marks the source or starting point, as in มาจากจุฬา or เปลี่ยนจากภพของหมา.
Used as a verb for parting or going away, as in จากบ้านไป.

parts.note: ก作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

senses.use: 指朱拉隆功大学的简称
