en.meaning: จุฬา is the common short name for Chulalongkorn University, one of the most famous universities in Thailand. Thai speakers say 'Chula' for both the university and being a student there. In the talk it only marks the time and place when the speaker was a student.

senses.use: Short for Chulalongkorn University, as in เรียนอยู่จุฬา.

parts.note: ฬ 读 l
parts.noteEn: ฬ reads l

senses.use: 从外向说话者所在处进入，如 เข้ามาในบ้าน
事物、情况接近或来到，如 อารมณ์เข้ามา

en.meaning: เข้ามา means to come in, moving from outside toward the speaker or toward a place. It is also used for things that arrive or approach, such as feelings or situations. In the talk it describes other animals coming into the house.

senses.use: Means entering toward the speaker's place, as in เข้ามาในบ้าน.
Means a thing, feeling or situation arrives or approaches, as in อารมณ์เข้ามา.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 住的地方、家庭所在，如 กลับบ้าน
指住宅建筑本身，如 สร้างบ้าน
乡村、村落，如 หมู่บ้าน

en.meaning: บ้าน is the place where one lives, so it means 'home'. It can also mean the house as a building, or a village. In the talk it means the home that the dog misses.

senses.use: Means the place where one lives and belongs, as in กลับบ้าน or คิดถึงบ้าน.
Means the building itself, as in สร้างบ้าน.
Means a rural village, as in หมู่บ้าน.
把东西放在某处或放手，如 วางไว้
不再执取、不管，如 วางใจ

en.meaning: วาง means to put or set something down in a place, or to let go of holding it. It is often used with ไว้ to show the thing is left there. In the talk it means placing food where the dog can smell it.

senses.use: Means placing something somewhere or releasing it from the hand, as in วางไว้.
Means leaving a worry or concern alone, as in วางใจ (to feel at ease).
帮忙、救助他人，如 ช่วยสัตว์
客气地请人做事，如 ช่วยบอกหน่อย

en.meaning: ช่วย means to help, assist or rescue someone or something. It is also put before a verb to make a polite request. In the talk it means helping animals so that their minds are at ease when they die.

senses.use: Means helping or assisting someone, as in ช่วยสัตว์.
Put before a verb to politely ask someone to do something, as in ช่วยบอกหน่อย.

parts.note: ว 是元音的一部分；ย 尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel; ย as a final reads i

words.thai: เศร้า หมอง

senses.use: 心里难过郁闷、不开朗，如 จิตเศร้าหมอง
心或事物失去光彩、不清净

en.meaning: เศร้าหมอง describes a mind that is sad, heavy and dull, not bright or clear. It is used for the state of the mind (จิต) or heart rather than for events. In the talk it describes the mind of a dog dying among strangers, which is not good.

senses.use: Describes a mind that is sad and depressed, as in จิตเศร้าหมอง.
Describes the mind or something else that has lost its brightness or purity.

parts.note: ศ 读 s；ร 不发音
parts.noteEn: ศ reads s; ร is silent

parts.note: ห 不发音，只带声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only carries the tone

senses.use: 使用东西或能力，如 ใช้ความคิด
用于 ใช้ได้ 表示行得通、合格
用于 ใช่/ใช้ 式的肯定，如 ไม่ใช่ 不是

en.meaning: ใช้ means to use something, such as a tool, a skill or the thinking mind. In ใช้ได้ it means 'works' or 'is acceptable', and in ใช้ไม่ได้ it means 'is no good'. In the talk it appears in both ways: using thought, and 'it doesn't work'.

senses.use: Means making use of something, as in ใช้ความคิด.
In ใช้ได้ / ใช้ไม่ได้ it means something works or does not work, is good enough or is not.

parts.note: ใ 写在前面，在辅音后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 状态转变为另一种，如 กลายเป็นทอง

en.meaning: กลาย means to change into something else, to turn into a different state. It is almost always used as กลายเป็น followed by what the thing has become. In the talk it describes meditation without awareness turning into an accumulation of delusion, and lumps of earth turning into gold.

senses.use: Means changing into another state, as in กลายเป็นทอง.

parts.note: ย 尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

senses.use: 一种来回行走的修行方式，用行走来培养觉性，如 เดินจงกรม

en.meaning: Walking meditation: walking back and forth along a set path as a way to develop awareness. It is usually used as เดินจงกรม. The word names the practice itself; whether it helps depends on whether awareness is present while walking.

senses.use: A formal practice of pacing back and forth with awareness, as in เดินจงกรม.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: กร是复辅音，隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: กร is a consonant cluster; hidden vowel o

senses.use: 认真专注地去做某事，如 ตั้งใจภาวนา
决定要做某事、有意去做，如 ตั้งใจว่าจะไป

en.meaning: To put your heart into doing something, paying careful and steady attention to it. It also means to decide to do something and mean to do it. It is often followed by a verb, as in ตั้งใจภาวนา (practice with real effort) or ตั้งใจว่าจะไป (intend to go).

senses.use: Used when you apply yourself earnestly to something, as in ตั้งใจภาวนา.
Used when you have decided to do something, as in ตั้งใจว่าจะไป.

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 培养觉性、训练心的修习，如 ภาวนาทุกวัน

en.meaning: Mental development: training the mind to cultivate awareness and understanding. In Thai practice it is the ordinary word for meditating or practising, and it covers more than sitting. It is often used as ภาวนาทุกวัน.

senses.use: You train the mind and cultivate awareness, as in ตั้งใจภาวนา.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

senses.use: 指全部中的每一个，如 ทุกวัน、ทุกคน

en.meaning: A word meaning every or each, placed before a noun to include all of them. It is used for time and for people, as in ทุกวัน and ทุกคน.

senses.use: Each one without exception, as in ทุกวัน (every day) or ทุกคน (everyone).
指事情分量大、不可忽视，如 สำคัญที่สุด

en.meaning: Important: something with great weight that should not be neglected. It describes a matter, a thing, or a quality. It is often used with ที่สุด to mean the most important.

senses.use: Something matters a great deal, as in สำคัญที่สุด or เป็นเรื่องสำคัญ.

parts.note: ำ读 am，带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am, with an m ending

parts.note: 尾音 ญ 读 n
parts.noteEn: Final ญ reads n

senses.use: 指发生或去做的次数频繁，如 บ่อยๆ

en.meaning: Often: happening or being done many times. It is usually placed after a verb and is often doubled as บ่อยๆ for emphasis. In practice talk it means doing something again and again.

senses.use: Something happens or is done frequently, as in ทำบ่อยๆ.

parts.note: 尾音 ย 读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i

senses.use: 表示程度或数量很少，如 นิดหน่อย
放在动词后使语气缓和，请对方做某事，如 ช่วยหน่อย

en.meaning: A little, a bit. It marks a small amount or degree. Placed after a verb it also softens a request or suggestion.

senses.use: A small amount or degree, as in นิดหน่อย or ทำบ่อยหน่อย.
Placed after a verb to make a request gentler, as in ช่วยหน่อย.

parts.note: ห不发音，只改变声调；尾音 ย 读 i
parts.noteEn: ห is silent; it only changes the tone. Final ย reads i

senses.use: 疑问句里问人，如 ใครทำ
否定句或泛指时表示任何人、无论谁，如 ไม่มีใคร

en.meaning: Who, used to ask about a person. In statements, especially negative ones, it means anyone or no one. It refers to people only.

senses.use: Asking about a person, as in ใครทำ.
In negative or general statements, as in ไม่มีใคร (no one).

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读；คร是复辅音
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it; คร is a consonant cluster.

senses.use: 指时间或起点的开始，如 ตั้งแต่แรก

en.meaning: A word that marks the point where something starts, in time or in place. It is followed by the starting point and usually means that things continued from then on. It is often paired with ถึง or จน to give the end point.

senses.use: Marks the starting point of a time, as in ตั้งแต่แรก (from the beginning).
Marks the start of a range, as in ตั้งแต่เช้าถึงเย็น (from morning to evening).

parts.note: แ 写在前面，却在 ต 后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after ต.

senses.use: 说话者连同听者或同伙一起的复数自称

en.meaning: A group word meaning 'we' or 'us', where the speaker counts themselves as part of the group. It is used when speaking to others as one of the same group, so it feels inclusive and friendly. It is common when a speaker talks about what everyone shares.

senses.use: Used when the speaker includes themselves and the listeners as one group, as in พวกเราแต่ละคน.

parts.note: ว 是元音 ua 的一部分，不是辅音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel ua, not a consonant

parts.note: เ 写在前面，却在 ร 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ร.

senses.use: 彼此相等、相同，如 ไม่เท่ากัน 不一样
作副词，表示同等程度地，如 เท่ากันหมด 全都同样

en.meaning: Means 'equal' or 'the same as each other.' It describes people or things that match in amount, level or degree. It is often used in the negative, ไม่เท่ากัน, meaning 'not the same' or 'unequal.'

senses.use: Two or more things match in amount or level, as in ต้นทุนไม่เท่ากัน 'starting capital is not equal.'
As an adverb, doing something to the same degree, as in เท่ากันหมด 'all equal.'

parts.note: เ 写在前面，却在 ท 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ท.

senses.use: 做事或做生意的资本，也指自己原有的基础、条件
资助学习的钱，如 ทุนการศึกษา

en.meaning: Means 'capital': the resources a person starts with for doing something, such as money in business. In the talk it refers to the foundation or qualities a person already has before practicing. It can also mean a grant of money for study.

senses.use: What a person starts with, as in ต้นทุน 'starting capital' or คนทุนเยอะ 'a person with a lot of capital.'
Money given to support study, as in ทุนการศึกษา.

words.thai: นิด หน่อย

senses.use: 数量或程度很少，如 นิดหน่อย 稍微一点
作副词，程度轻微，如 ดีขึ้นนิดหน่อย 稍微好一点

en.meaning: Means 'a little' or 'a bit.' It describes a small amount or a slight degree. It is very common in everyday speech and often softens a statement.

senses.use: A small amount or degree, as in ต่อยอดนิดหน่อย 'build on it a little.'
As an adverb, to a light degree, as in ดีขึ้นนิดหน่อย 'a little better.'

parts.note: 尾音 ด 读 t
parts.noteEn: Final ด reads t

parts.note: ห 不发音，只管声调；尾音 ย 读 i
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; the final ย reads i

senses.use: 修行上到达、证入某个境界或法，如 เข้าถึงธรรม
能够接近、获取，如 เข้าถึงข้อมูล 取得信息
深入体会、领会某事，如 เข้าถึงใจ 懂得人心

en.meaning: Means 'to reach' or 'to arrive at.' In Dhamma talks it means arriving at or realizing a state or the Dhamma through practice. In everyday speech it can mean getting access to something, or deeply understanding it.

senses.use: Arriving at or realizing a state or the Dhamma in practice, as in เข้าถึงธรรมะ or เข้าถึงฌาน.
Being able to get to something, as in เข้าถึงข้อมูล 'access information.'
Deeply grasping something, as in เข้าถึงใจ 'understand the heart of someone.'

parts.note: เ 写在前面，却在 ข 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ข.

senses.use: 佛陀所教导的真理，以及修行所证的实相
泛指佛教的教理与修行，如 ฟังธรรมะ 听法
指善良、正当的品行，如 มีธรรมะ 有道德

en.meaning: Means 'Dhamma': the truth taught by the Buddha and the reality that is realized through practice. It is used for the teachings of Buddhism in general, and also for goodness or virtue in a person's conduct.

senses.use: The truth the Buddha taught and the reality realized in practice, as in เข้าถึงธรรมะ 'reach the Dhamma.'
The teachings and practice in general, as in ฟังธรรมะ 'listen to Dhamma.'
Goodness in a person's character, as in มีธรรมะ 'has virtue.'

parts.note: รร 合起来读 a；ม 同时是后一音节的声母
parts.noteEn: รร together read a; ม is also the initial of the next syllable

senses.use: 泛指一般的人，带有“人这种东西”的意味
说话者把自己也包括进去的人类，泛指大家

en.meaning: Means 'people' in a general sense, with the speaker included. It is like saying 'we humans' or 'people like us.' It is used to talk about human nature or what is true of everyone.

senses.use: Humans in general, as a type, as in คนเราต้องฝึก 'people have to train.'
The speaker includes themself among everyone being talked about.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，却在 ร 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ร.

senses.use: 连接并列的名词或动作，也可连接分句

en.meaning: Means 'and.' It joins nouns, actions or whole clauses together. It is a little more formal or written in tone than the spoken ก็ or กับ.

senses.use: Joins two things or actions, as in ทำให้ถูกและทำให้พอ 'do it correctly and do enough.'

parts.note: แ写在前面，却在ล后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after ล.

senses.use: 某人或某事容易出问题、不足的地方

en.meaning: Means 'weak point': a place where a person or thing is lacking or easily goes wrong. It is used for a shortcoming in ability, practice or character.

senses.use: A shortcoming or place where something is lacking, as in จุดอ่อนของฆราวาส 'the weak point of laypeople.'

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

parts.note: 第二个อ是元音 aw，不是辅音
parts.noteEn: The second อ is the vowel aw, not a consonant.

senses.use: 相对于出家人，指在家的人

en.meaning: Means 'layperson': someone living the household life, as opposed to a monk or nun. It is used in Dhamma talks to speak about ordinary people who practice while living at home.

senses.use: A person who is not ordained, as in ฆราวาสกับพระ 'laypeople and monks.'

parts.note: ฆ 后面藏着短 a，读 khá
parts.noteEn: A short a is hidden after ฆ; read khá

parts.note: ส作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ส as a final reads t

senses.use: 真实、不虚假，如 ตั้งมั่นจริง 真的安住
表示肯定属实，如 จริงด้วย 的确如此
常叠用作 จริงๆ，指实际上、说真的

en.meaning: Means 'true' or 'real.' It describes something that is genuinely so and not false. Doubled as จริงๆ, it means 'really' or 'in fact,' and it is often placed after a word for emphasis.

senses.use: Real, not false, as in ตั้งมั่นจริง 'truly stable.'
Confirming that something is so, as in จริงด้วย 'that's right.'
Doubled as จริงๆ to say 'actually' or 'to tell the truth,' as in การปฏิบัติจริงๆ.

parts.note: ร不发音
parts.noteEn: ร is silent

senses.use: 位置改变、离开原处，如 จิตเคลื่อน（心移走）、เคลื่อนไหว（动）

en.meaning: เคลื่อน means to move or shift from one position or place to another. It is used for physical movement and also for the mind drifting away from where it was. In Dhamma talks it often describes the mind moving away from its object, such as the body or the breath.

senses.use: Something changes position or leaves its place, as in จิตเคลื่อน (the mind moves away).
Something slides or drifts off its original spot, often slowly or without being noticed.

parts.note: เ写在前面，却在คล后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after คล.

senses.use: 从里面往外移出，如 เดินออกไป（走出去）、จิตเคลื่อนออกไป（心移出去）
离开某处或某个范围，如 ออกไปจากที่นี่（离开这里）

en.meaning: ออกไป means to go out or move away from the inside of something or from a place. It combines ออก (out) and ไป (go, away). In Dhamma talks it is often used for the mind going out toward thoughts or outside objects.

senses.use: Something moves from inside to outside, as in จิตเคลื่อนออกไป (the mind moves out).
Someone departs from a place or area, as in ออกไปจากที่นี่ (leave here).

parts.note: 第二个อ是元音 aw，不是辅音
parts.noteEn: The second อ is the vowel aw, not a consonant.

parts.note: ไ写在前面，却在ป后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after ป.

senses.use: 句末加强语气、提示或强调，如 แล้วล่ะ（已经……了呢）
问话时用，追问或转问，如 แล้วเธอล่ะ（那你呢）

en.meaning: ล่ะ is a particle placed at the end of a sentence. It adds emphasis or a sense of pointing something out, and it also forms follow-up questions meaning 'and what about...?'. It has no fixed meaning of its own; it adds tone to the sentence.

senses.use: Ends a statement to stress or point out something, as in แล้วล่ะ (already, you see).
Follows a noun or clause to ask 'and what about...?', as in แล้วเธอล่ะ (and you?).
想当然地认为，事实往往并非如此，如 นึกว่าใช่（以为是）

en.meaning: นึกว่า means to think or assume that something is so, when in fact it turns out not to be. It carries a sense of a mistaken belief. In Dhamma talks it describes believing we are doing something right when we are actually deluded.

senses.use: Assumed something was true, but it was not, as in นึกว่าใช่ (thought it was right).

words.thai: เท่า ไหร่

senses.use: 问数量或价钱，如 ราคาเท่าไหร่（多少钱）
不问答案，表程度，如 ไม่ได้อะไรเท่าไหร่（没什么多大收获）

en.meaning: เท่าไหร่ is a question word asking 'how much' or 'how many', often about price or quantity. It can also be used in a non-asking way to express degree, usually in negative sentences, meaning 'not very much'.

senses.use: Asks about an amount or price, as in ราคาเท่าไหร่ (how much does it cost).
In negative sentences it expresses degree, as in ไม่ได้อะไรเท่าไหร่ (didn't gain much).

parts.note: เ写在前面，在ท后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ท.

parts.note: ห不发音，只带高音字母的声调；ไ写在前面，在后面读
parts.noteEn: ห is silent; it only gives the high-class tone. ไ is written before the letter but read after it

words.thai: นั่ง สมาธิ

senses.use: 盘腿静坐修习禅定

en.meaning: นั่งสมาธิ means to sit in meditation, usually cross-legged and still, to practice concentration. It is the common Thai phrase for formal seated meditation practice.

senses.use: Formal seated meditation practice.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

senses.use: 无论何时都这样，如 ดีเสมอไป（总是好）

en.meaning: เสมอไป means always or in every case. It is mostly used in negative sentences to say that something is not always true, as in 'not always good'.

senses.use: In every case or at all times, often in negatives like ดีเสมอไป (not always good).

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a；เ写在ส前面，却在后一音节读
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a; เ is written before ส but is read in the next syllable.

parts.note: เ写在前面，在ม后面读；声调跟着前面的ส读升调
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ม. The tone follows the ส before it: rising tone.

parts.note: ไ写在前面，在ป后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after ป.

words.thai: ตั้ง มุ่ง

senses.use: 下定决心朝某个目标去做，如 ตั้งมุ่งไปที่จุดนี้（把重点放在这里）
把心力集中在一个对象或目标上

en.meaning: ตั้งมุ่ง means to set one's intention and aim toward a goal or a point. It describes directing effort and attention at something specific and keeping it there.

senses.use: Set a goal and direct effort toward it, as in ตั้งมุ่งไปที่จุดนี้ (aim at this point).
Put attention and effort on one object or target.

words.thai: พระ พุทธเจ้า

senses.use: 指释迦牟尼佛，觉悟者

en.meaning: พระพุทธเจ้า means the Buddha, the awakened one. It usually refers to the Buddha Gotama, who taught the Dhamma. It is the respectful Thai term used for him.

senses.use: Refers to Gotama Buddha, the awakened teacher.

parts.note: ท作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ท as a final reads t

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: เ写在前面，在จ后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after จ.

senses.use: 与烦恼、敌人或困难对抗，如 ต่อสู้กับกิเลส（与烦恼战斗）
努力拼搏克服困难，如 ต่อสู้ชีวิต（为生活奋斗）

en.meaning: ต่อสู้ means to fight or struggle against an opponent or a difficulty. It can describe a real fight, or effort against hardship or inner enemies. In Dhamma talks it is used for struggling against defilements.

senses.use: Oppose an enemy or defilements, as in ต่อสู้กับกิเลส (fight defilements).
Strive hard to overcome difficulty, as in ต่อสู้ชีวิต (struggle through life).
指人类生活的世界、众生所处的世间，如 คนในโลก（世间的人）
指我们居住的星球，如 โลกกลม（地球是圆的）

en.meaning: The world: the place where people and living beings live, or the human world of ordinary life. It can also mean the planet Earth. In Dhamma talks it often means the world of ordinary people who live caught up in their own thoughts and defilements, so going beyond the world means freeing the mind from that.

senses.use: The human world or the beings living in it, as in คนในโลก (people in the world), including the mind going beyond it (พ้นโลก).
The planet we live on, as in โลกกลม (the Earth is round).

parts.note: โ写在前面，在ล后面读
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after ล.

senses.use: 从早到晚一整天，如 ทั้งวัน（一整天都…）

en.meaning: All day long, from morning to night. It is placed after a verb or clause to say the action or state continues the whole day. It stresses how constant or unbroken something is.

senses.use: Something goes on from morning to evening without a break, as in รู้สึกตัวทั้งวัน (be aware all day).
数量或程度上比另一方多，如 รู้เรื่องคนอื่นมากกว่า（了解别人多过…）
放在形容词或动词后表示比较起来更…，如 ดีมากกว่า（更好）

en.meaning: More than, or more. It compares two things and says one is greater in amount or degree than the other. It is placed after the verb or adjective, followed by what is being compared.

senses.use: One thing exceeds another in amount or degree, as in รู้เรื่องคนอื่นมากกว่าตัวเอง (know about others more than about oneself).
Placed after an adjective or verb to say 'more so', as in ดีมากกว่า (better).

parts.note: ก 作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

parts.note: ก 和 ว 连读成 kw
parts.noteEn: ก and ว are read together as kw

senses.use: 指第三人称的他或她、他们，如 เขาไป（他去了）
指山，如 ภูเขา（山）、ขึ้นเขา（上山）

en.meaning: He, she or they: a general word for a third person who is not the speaker or the listener. It does not show gender. The same sound also means 'mountain', written differently in context.

senses.use: Refers to another person or other people, as in เขาไป (he/she went).
A hill or mountain, as in ภูเขา or ขึ้นเขา (go up the mountain).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读，整个元音读 ao
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The whole vowel is read ao.

senses.use: 逃跑、逃离，心跑开不在当下也用此词，如 ใจหนีไป（心跑掉了）
回避不愿面对的事物，如 หนีปัญหา（逃避问题）

en.meaning: To run away from or escape something. It is used for people who flee, and also for the mind that slips away from the present moment and wanders off. It can also mean avoiding something you do not want to face.

senses.use: Run away or leave, including the mind running off from the present, as in ใจหนีไป (the mind ran off).
Dodge something unwelcome, as in หนีปัญหา (avoid a problem).

parts.note: ห 不发音，只负责把声调抬成升调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only lifts the tone to rising

senses.use: 清楚知道自己此刻的身心状态，如 รู้ตัว（有觉知）
意识到自己正在做什么或处于什么状态，如 ไม่รู้ตัว（没发觉）

en.meaning: To be aware of oneself: to know clearly what the body and mind are doing or feeling right now. Its opposite, ไม่รู้ตัว, means the mind has drifted off and one does not notice what one is doing. It is a key word in practice about staying present.

senses.use: Clearly know the present state of one's body and mind, as in รู้ตัว (be aware).
Realize what one is doing or in what state one is, as in ไม่รู้ตัว (not realize).

parts.note: ว 是元音的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel, not a final consonant

words.thai: ย่อ หย่อน

senses.use: 用功或心的状态太松、不够力，如 ย่อหย่อนไป（太松了）
能力、条件等有欠缺、不够标准，如 ย่อหย่อนในหน้าที่（疏于职责）

en.meaning: Slack, lax or lacking in effort. It describes effort or the mind that is too loose and not firm enough. It can also mean falling short in duty or standard.

senses.use: Effort or the mind is too loose, as in ย่อหย่อนไป (too slack).
Falling short of what is required, as in ย่อหย่อนในหน้าที่ (lax in one's duties).

parts.note: อ 在这里当元音，读 aw
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel and reads aw

parts.note: ห 不发音，只管声调；อ 当元音读 aw
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only sets the tone; อ as a vowel reads aw

words.thai: ตึง เครียด

senses.use: 心或身体绷得太紧、压力大，如 ตึงเครียดเกินไป（太紧绷了）

en.meaning: Tense and strained. It describes a body or mind that is wound too tight and under pressure. It is used when someone forces themselves too much and cannot relax.

senses.use: Body or mind is tight and under pressure, as in ตึงเครียดเกินไป (too tense).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；ด 作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ด as a final reads t.

senses.use: 超过适当的程度，如 เกินไป（太过了）

en.meaning: Too much, or beyond what is suitable. It is placed after an adjective or verb to say it goes past the right amount. It usually carries the sense that this is a problem.

senses.use: Goes past the proper degree, as in ตึงเครียดเกินไป (too tense).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读，读 ai
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it; it reads ai.

senses.use: 心里绷紧、有压力、不放松，如 เครียด ๆ（紧绷绷的）

en.meaning: Stressed or tight. The repeated form gives a casual feeling of being tense and not relaxed in the mind. It is used for a mind that is forcing itself or under pressure.

senses.use: The mind is tight and not relaxed, as in เครียด ๆ (feeling stressed).

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 指泰国的语言，如 พูดภาษาไทย（说泰语）

en.meaning: The Thai language. ภาษา means language or way of speaking, and ไทย means Thai. In talks it is used when pointing out how Thai people say or name something, as in 'in Thai there is a word...'.

senses.use: The national language of Thailand, as in พูดภาษาไทย (speak Thai) or ภาษาไทยมีคำว่า... (Thai has a word...).

parts.note: ษ 读 s，是高辅音
parts.noteEn: ษ reads s and is a high-class consonant

parts.note: 最后的 ย 不读
parts.noteEn: The last ย is silent

senses.use: 指语言里的词、字眼，如 คำบริกรรม（念诵的词）
指一句话、言语，如 คำพูด（说的话）

en.meaning: A word, or something said. It is also used for a spoken phrase. It often appears in compounds such as คำพูด (speech) and คำบริกรรม (a word repeated silently in meditation).

senses.use: A single word or term in a language, as in คำบริกรรม (a repeated meditation word).
Something said, as in คำพูด (what is said).
A bite of food, as in ข้าวคำหนึ่ง (one mouthful of rice).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own m ending

words.zh: 一（口语，就是 หนึ่ง）

detail.meaning: 一（口语，就是 หนึ่ง）

senses.use: 口语的 หนึ่ง，用于数量，如 คนนึง（一个人）
放在动词后表示稍微、片刻，如 รอนึง（等一下）

en.meaning: A casual, spoken way of saying หนึ่ง (one). It is used for counting one of something and, after a verb, for 'a little while' or 'a moment'.

senses.use: Counts a single item or person, as in มีคนนึง (there is one person).
After a verb it softens the request to a short time, as in รอนึง (wait a moment).
引出一个词或名称，如 คำว่าสติ（叫做“觉性”的词）

en.meaning: A phrase used to introduce a word or name that is about to be mentioned or explained. It means 'the word...' or 'what is called...'. The speaker uses it to point to a term and then comment on it.

senses.use: Introduces a particular term, as in คำว่าสติ (the word 'awareness').
Gives the name of something, as in มีคำนึงคำว่า... (there is a word called...).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own m ending

senses.use: 重复强调数量或程度很多，如 รู้สึกตัวให้มากๆ（多多觉知）

en.meaning: A repeated form of มาก (much, many) for extra emphasis. It means 'a lot' or 'very much' and is often used when urging someone to do something more. The repeat mark ๆ means the word is said twice.

senses.use: Urges more of an action, as in รู้สึกตัวให้มากๆ (be aware of yourself a lot).
Strengthens a quality, as in ดีมากๆ (very good).

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 身体站立，如 ยืนเดินนั่งนอน（行住坐卧中的站）
固守、坚持某个立场或状态，如 ยืนยัน（坚持、确认）

en.meaning: To stand upright on one's feet. It is one of the four main body postures: standing, walking, sitting and lying down. It is also used in compounds for holding firm to something.

senses.use: The body is upright on the feet, as in ยืนเดินนั่งนอน (standing, walking, sitting, lying).
Appears in compounds such as ยืนยัน (to insist or confirm).
持续不断地做某事，如 คอยรู้สึก（不停地觉知）
等候人或事，如 คอยอยู่（等着）

en.meaning: Before a verb, it means to keep doing that action steadily over time. On its own it means to wait. In these talks it usually means continuing to watch or be aware, not waiting.

senses.use: Before a verb, for steady, ongoing action, as in คอยรู้สึก (keep being aware).
Waiting for a person or event, as in คอยอยู่ (waiting).

parts.note: ย 作尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: Final ย reads i.

senses.use: 感受上的快乐，如 ความสุข（乐受、快乐）

en.meaning: Happiness, pleasure, or ease. In these talks it is mainly a pleasant feeling that arises in the body or mind. ความสุข is the noun form.

senses.use: A pleasant feeling in the body or mind, as in ความสุข.
Comfort or well-being, as in สบายและสุข (comfortable and well).

parts.note: ข 作尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ข as a final reads k

senses.use: 感受上的痛苦、不舒服，如 ความทุกข์（苦受）
指生命中不如意的逼迫，如 ทุกข์ใจ（心里难受）

en.meaning: Suffering, pain, or distress. In these talks it is mainly an unpleasant feeling in the body or mind, the opposite of สุข. It is also the Dhamma term for the unsatisfactoriness of life. ความทุกข์ is the noun form.

senses.use: An unpleasant feeling in the body or mind, as in ความทุกข์.
Mental pain or trouble, as in ทุกข์ใจ (heartache, mentally troubled).

parts.note: ข์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ข์ is silent

senses.use: 想要占有、渴求更多的烦恼，如 มีความโลภ（有贪）

en.meaning: Greed: the wanting to get, own or have more. It is one of the main defilements in the mind. ความ turns the word โลภ (to be greedy) into a noun.

senses.use: A mental state of craving or wanting more, as in มีความโลภ (greed arises).

parts.note: คว 是复辅音，读 khw
parts.noteEn: คว is a consonant cluster, read khw

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在后面读；ภ 作尾音读 p
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it; ภ as a final reads p.

senses.use: 心情低落、萎靡不振，如 จิตหดหู่

en.meaning: Describes a mind or mood that is low, heavy and discouraged, without energy. It is used for a gloomy, shrunken state of the mind. In Dhamma talks it names a mental state to notice, the opposite of a bright, uplifted mind.

senses.use: Used for a low, gloomy or discouraged mind, as in จิตหดหู่.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 困难、麻烦、症结所在，如 มีปัญหา
需要解答的题目、疑问，如 ถามปัญหา

en.meaning: Means a difficulty, trouble or the root of what is going wrong. It can also mean a question that needs an answer. It is very common in everyday speech.

senses.use: A difficulty or the heart of what is wrong, as in มีปัญหา or ปัญหาคือ…
A question or puzzle that needs answering, as in ถามปัญหา.

parts.note: ญ 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ญ as a final reads n

senses.use: 把注意力放在某事上、关注，如 ไม่สนใจ
对某事有兴趣、想了解或参与，如 สนใจที่จะ…

en.meaning: To pay attention to something because it matters to you, or to feel curious about it. It is often used in the negative, ไม่สนใจ, meaning to take no notice of something. It can also be followed by ที่ and a verb to mean being interested in doing something.

senses.use: Used when you want to know about or take part in something, as in สนใจที่จะรู้สึกตัว.
Used when you put your attention on something, as in ไม่สนใจ (not caring about it).

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 事物本身值得珍惜的好处与意义，如 รู้คุณค่า

en.meaning: The worth of something, meaning the good and the meaning it has that make it worth treasuring. It is often used with รู้ (know), as in รู้คุณค่า, meaning to understand how precious something is. It is about real worth, not price.

senses.use: Used for the worth that makes something precious, as in รู้คุณค่า.

parts.note: ณ 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ณ as a final reads n

words.thai: เพลิด เพลิน

senses.use: 玩得忘我、沉迷其中而不自觉
轻松开心、享受，如 เพลิดเพลินกับงาน

en.meaning: To enjoy something so much that you become absorbed in it and lose track of yourself. It can mean simple, relaxed enjoyment, but in Dhamma talks it often points to being lost in pleasure without awareness. It is used for both light enjoyment and heedless indulgence.

senses.use: Used when you are so happy in something that you forget yourself, as in เพลิดเพลินหลงไป.
Used for light, relaxed enjoyment, as in เพลิดเพลินกับงาน.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

senses.use: 玩得入迷、不知不觉沉浸其中

en.meaning: Means being carried along happily and absorbed without noticing. The repeated form gives a drifting, easygoing feel. It is used for getting lost in something enjoyable.

senses.use: Drifting along absorbed in something without noticing, as in หลงมันเพลิน ๆ.

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 业或因成熟后产生果报
对某事产生作用或后果，如 ส่งผลต่อ…

en.meaning: To lead to a result or have an effect. It is used when a cause brings its outcome, such as when an action or a state of mind ripens into a result. It is often followed by ต่อ and the thing affected.

senses.use: Used when a cause brings its result, as in ส่งผลแล้วไปเกิดเป็น…
Used when something has an effect on something else, as in ส่งผลต่อ…

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；ล 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; ล as a final reads n.

senses.use: 普通的、大多数的，如 คนทั่วไป
遍及各处，如 ทั่วไปหมด

en.meaning: Describes what is common, ordinary, or true for most cases. It is often placed after a noun, as in คนทั่วไป (people in general). It can also mean 'everywhere' when used about places.

senses.use: Used for what is ordinary or true of most people or things, as in คนทั่วไป.
Used when something spreads across all places, as in ทั่วไปหมด.

parts.note: ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 思考、有某种想法或认为，如 คิดว่า
考虑要做某事，如 คิดจะไป
算钱、算费用，如 คิดเงิน

en.meaning: Means to think, whether reasoning something through or holding an opinion. It is also used for planning to do something and for working out costs. In Dhamma talks it often means thinking as an activity of the mind, which is different from simply being aware.

senses.use: Thinking, reasoning or holding a view, as in คิดว่า or ความคิด.
Intending to do something, as in คิดจะไป.
Working out money or a charge, as in คิดเงิน.
指情况、品质很差、很不好，如 แย่ ที่ สุด（最糟）
遇到麻烦、事情不妙时的感叹，如 แย่ แล้ว（糟了）

en.meaning: แย่ means bad, awful, or in a poor state. It describes situations, conditions or quality that are very unsatisfactory, and with ที่สุด it means 'the worst'. As an exclamation, แย่แล้ว means 'oh no, this is trouble'.

senses.use: Describes something of poor quality or in a poor state, e.g. แย่ที่สุด 'the worst'.
Exclaims that something has gone wrong, e.g. แย่แล้ว 'oh no'.

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it

words.thai: อย่าง นั้น

senses.use: 指前面说过的那种样子、状态或想法，如 รู้สึก อย่าง นั้น（那样觉得）

en.meaning: A phrase meaning 'like that' or 'in that way'. It points back to something already said, such as a manner, state or opinion. It is often used after a verb, as in รู้สึกอย่างนั้น (feel that way).

senses.use: Points to a manner, state or idea already mentioned, as in รู้สึกอย่างนั้น.

parts.note: อ 只用来把 ย 的声调变成中调，不发音
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only turns the tone of ย into the mid tone

senses.use: 用眼睛看，或观察、查看某件事，如 ดู เหตุ（看因）
表示从外表判断显得如何，如 ดู ดี（看起来好）
接在动词后，表示试一试，如 ลอง ทำ ดู（做做看）

en.meaning: ดู means to look at, watch or observe something. It can also mean to examine a matter in order to understand it. After another verb it means 'try and see', and it can also mean 'seem'.

senses.use: Looking at or examining something, e.g. ดูเหตุ 'look at the cause'.
Describes how something appears, e.g. ดูดี 'looks good'.
Follows a verb to mean 'give it a try', e.g. ลองทำดู 'try doing it'.
指造成结果的原因、缘由，如 เหตุ ผล（因与果）
指发生的事情、事故，如 เหตุ การณ์（事件）

en.meaning: เหตุ means cause, the reason something happens or the condition that produces a result. It is often paired with ผล (result) in เหตุผล, 'cause and effect' or 'reason'. It can also mean an event or incident.

senses.use: What brings about a result, e.g. เหตุผล 'cause and result; reason'.
An incident that happens, e.g. เหตุการณ์ 'event'.

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读；ต 尾音读成 ด 的 t；ุ 不发音
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it; final ต reads t, like ด; ุ is silent

senses.use: 指心忘了觉知、被境界带走而不自知
指不明白真相的无明、愚痴，即 โมหะ

en.meaning: ความหลง is the state of being deluded: the mind forgets to be aware and is carried away by what it experiences without noticing. It also means not understanding the truth of things, which is ignorance or stupidity (โมหะ). It is one of the defilements, and is described as the hardest to see.

senses.use: The mind is lost in its objects and unaware of itself, as in ตายด้วยความหลง.
Not understanding how things really are; this is โมหะ, a root defilement.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o；ห 不发音，只管声调
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o; ห is silent and only sets the tone.

senses.use: 用水把脏东西洗掉，如 ล้าง จาน（洗碗）
比喻把烦恼等去除干净，如 ล้าง กิเลส（清除烦恼）

en.meaning: ล้าง means to wash, to clean something with water. In Dhamma talks it is used figuratively for cleansing the mind of defilements until none remain.

senses.use: Cleaning something with water, e.g. ล้างจาน 'wash dishes'.
Figurative removal of defilements, e.g. ล้างกิเลส 'wash away defilements'.
同一件事反复发生，如 เกิด ซ้ำ ๆ（一再投生）

en.meaning: ซ้ำ ๆ means repeatedly, again and again. The doubled word shows the same thing happening over and over. In the talk it describes being born as an animal many times in a row.

senses.use: The same thing happening again and again, e.g. เกิดซ้ำ ๆ 'be born over and over'.

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 指年长、地位高而值得尊敬的人，如 ครู บา อาจารย์ ผู้ ใหญ่（高僧大德）
相对于小孩，指成人、大人

en.meaning: ผู้ใหญ่ refers to someone senior, either by age or by standing. It is used respectfully for elders, and in the phrase ครูบาอาจารย์ผู้ใหญ่ it refers to a senior, highly respected teacher. It also simply means an adult as opposed to a child.

senses.use: A senior, respected person, as in ครูบาอาจารย์ผู้ใหญ่.
A grown-up as opposed to a child, as in คนเป็นผู้ใหญ่แล้ว.

parts.note: 元音写在前面却在后面读；ห 不发音，ญ 读 y
parts.noteEn: The vowel is written before the consonant but read after it; ห is silent and ญ reads y

senses.use: 用来数僧人、佛像、王室等尊贵者，如 พระ องค์ หนึ่ง（一位僧人）
放在尊贵者名词前表示敬称，如 พระ องค์ นี้（这位）

en.meaning: องค์ is a classifier used when counting monks, Buddha images and royalty, and it carries respect. It comes after the noun or number, as in พระองค์หนึ่ง 'one monk'. It can also appear before a respected person as a polite marker.

senses.use: Counts monks and other revered beings, e.g. พระองค์หนึ่ง 'one monk'.
Placed before a revered person to show respect, e.g. พระองค์นี้ 'this monk'.

parts.note: 隐藏元音读 o；ค์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel read as o; ค์ is silent.

senses.use: 数字一，或表示一个，如 องค์ หนึ่ง（一位）
指某个一定的程度、点或时刻，如 ถึง จุด หนึ่ง（到某一点）

en.meaning: หนึ่ง means one, the number. It is also used to mean 'a certain' one, a particular point or moment. In the talk it comes after องค์ to mean 'one monk'.

senses.use: The number one or a single item, e.g. องค์หนึ่ง 'one (monk)'.
A particular point or level, e.g. ถึงจุดหนึ่ง 'to a certain point'.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只负责带声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only carries the tone

senses.use: 句末表否定或询问是否，如「ถูกเปล่า」是不是对的、「เปล่า」没有
里面没有东西、空无所有，如「มือเปล่า」空手

en.meaning: เปล่า (plàao) is a word that means "no" or "empty." At the end of a sentence it works as a tag question, asking "or not?", and on its own it is a short denial, "no." Before or after a noun it means empty, bare, or without anything in it.

senses.use: Added at the end of a sentence to ask yes or no, as in "จำถูกเปล่า" (did I remember it right or not?).
Said alone to deny something, as in "เปล่า" (No, not so).
Describes something with nothing in it or on it, as in "มือเปล่า" (empty-handed).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

senses.use: 看文字并读出或读懂，如「อ่านหนังสือ」读书
看透、解读他人或自己的心思、情况，如「อ่านใจ」读心

en.meaning: อ่าน (àan) means to read: to look at writing and take in what it says. It is also used figuratively for working out what is going on in a person or situation, such as reading a mind. It is a common everyday verb.

senses.use: Looking at written words and understanding them, as in "อ่านหนังสือ" (read a book); in this talk, "เคยอ่านเจอ" (read it somewhere once).
Seeing through or interpreting the mind or state of someone, as in "อ่านใจ" (read the mind), including watching one's own mind.

parts.note: อ 是空声母，不发辅音
parts.noteEn: อ is an empty initial; it makes no consonant sound

senses.use: 碰见、遇上人或事，如「เจอกัน」遇见
找见、发现某物，如「หาเจอ」找到了

en.meaning: เจอ (joe) means to meet, come across, or run into something or someone. It also means to find something. It is a very common spoken word, and often follows another verb to show that the action turned up a result.

senses.use: Finding something by chance while reading or looking, as in "อ่านเจอ" (read it somewhere); also "ไม่เจอ" (did not come across it).
Running into or meeting a person or situation, as in "เจอกัน" (see you / meet each other).
Locating something one was looking for, as in "หาเจอ" (found it).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；อ 是元音的一部分
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is part of the vowel.

senses.use: 野外生活的狗，开示里也指猎狗，如 เกิดเป็นหมาป่า
指野生的狼

en.meaning: หมาป่า literally means 'forest dog'. It refers to a dog living in the wild, and can also mean a wolf. In the talk it is used for a wild or hunting dog that one can be reborn as.

senses.use: A dog living wild or used for hunting, as in เกิดเป็นหมาป่า.
A wild wolf, in everyday usage.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只负责带声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only carries the tone

words.thai: สัตว์ ป่า

senses.use: 生活在森林里的野生动物

en.meaning: สัตว์ป่า means animals that live wild in the forest, such as deer, tigers or wild dogs. It is a general term for wildlife, in contrast to domestic animals.

senses.use: Any animal living in the forest, as in สัตว์ป่าในป่าใหญ่.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

senses.use: 放在名词或动词前指一类人或事物，如「พวกที่…」那些……的
指同伙、同类的一伙人，如「พวกเรา」我们大家

en.meaning: พวก (phûak) is a word for a group, a kind, or a set of people or things. It comes before a noun or a clause to mean "those who..." or "the ones that...". It is also used with pronouns to make a plural, as in "พวกเรา" (we, all of us).

senses.use: Points to a kind of beings or things, as in "พวกที่เป็นสัตว์" (those who are animals).
Marks a group or plural of people, as in "พวกเรา" (all of us).

parts.note: ว 是元音的一部分，读 ua
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel and reads ua

senses.use: 表示经过很久或很多步骤之后才发生，如 นานกว่าจะเปลี่ยนแปลงได้

en.meaning: กว่าจะ introduces something that happens only after a long time or after many steps. It often carries the feeling that the result is slow or hard to reach. It is followed by the thing that finally happens.

senses.use: The result comes only after a long wait, as in นานกว่าจะเปลี่ยนแปลงได้ ('it takes long before it can change').
After much effort or many stages, as in กว่าจะถึงก็ดึก.

parts.note: กว 是复辅音，ว 跟 ก 一起读
parts.noteEn: กว is a consonant cluster; ว is read together with ก

words.thai: เปลี่ยน แปลง

senses.use: 状态、情况变得不同，如 เปลี่ยนแปลงได้

en.meaning: เปลี่ยนแปลง means to change, to become different from before. It is used for conditions, situations or people that are no longer the same. In the talk it refers to a being's state changing, such as no longer being an animal.

senses.use: Something becomes different, as in เปลี่ยนแปลงได้.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读，ย 属于元音 เ◌ีย
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is part of the vowel เ◌ีย.

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

words.thai: ลูก สัตว์

senses.use: 动物的幼崽、小动物

en.meaning: ลูกสัตว์ means the young of an animal, a baby or juvenile animal. It is a general word for the offspring of any kind of animal, not one particular species.

senses.use: The offspring of any animal, as in ลูกสัตว์ตัวเล็ก ๆ.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

senses.use: 狗的幼崽

en.meaning: ลูกหมา means a puppy, the young of a dog. It is a simple everyday word, and can be used for a dog that has not yet grown up.

senses.use: A young dog, as in ลูกหมาตัวเล็ก ๆ.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只让 ม 读升调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only makes ม read with a rising tone

senses.use: 人或动物长大成熟，如 ลูกหมาโตขึ้น

en.meaning: This phrase means to grow up or become bigger and more mature. It is used for children, animals and plants as they develop from small to large. Literally it combines โต (big, grown) with ขึ้น (up).

senses.use: Describes a person or animal maturing, as in ลูกหมาโตขึ้น (the puppy grew up).
Describes something increasing in size, such as a plant or a body, as in ต้นไม้โตขึ้น.

parts.note: โ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 指母亲，如 พ่อแม่、ฆ่าแม่
放在名词前表示女性或母性，如 แม่น้ำ（河）、แม่ทัพ（主帅）的“主要、母体”义

en.meaning: แม่ means mother, the female parent. It is also used as a prefix before nouns to mean something main, large or source-like, and as a polite way to address women.

senses.use: Refers to one's female parent, as in พ่อแม่ (parents) or ฆ่าแม่ (kill one's mother).
Placed before a noun to mean the principal or source one, as in แม่น้ำ (river) and แม่ทัพ (army commander).
Used to address or refer to a woman, often an older or respected one, as in แม่ค้า (female vendor).

parts.note: แ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 指配偶中的女方，如 ผัวเมีย（夫妻）

en.meaning: เมีย means wife, the female partner in a marriage. It is an everyday, plain word and can sound blunt or informal. For animals it can also mean the female mate, which is how it is used in this talk.

senses.use: Refers to a woman's role as spouse, as in ผัวเมีย (husband and wife).
Refers to an animal's female partner, or to taking someone as a mate, as in เอาแม่มันมาทำเมีย.

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读，ย 属于元音
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is part of the vowel.

words.thai: ทั้ง สิ้น

senses.use: 放在句末，表示无一例外，如 ไม่รู้อะไรทั้งสิ้น

en.meaning: ทั้งสิ้น means entirely, all, without exception. It is placed at the end of a clause to stress that nothing is left out. It sounds somewhat formal or emphatic.

senses.use: Ends a clause to mean no exception, as in ไม่รู้อะไรทั้งสิ้น (knows nothing at all).
Stresses that everything is the result or cause named, as in เป็นผลของกรรมทั้งสิ้น (all of it is the result of kamma).
泛用量词，用于物件或抽象事物，如 อันนี้、อันอื่น
作关系词连接前后，相当于“所…的”，如 อันเป็นที่รัก

en.meaning: อัน is a general classifier for things, both objects and abstract matters, and it also works like 'the one'. It can also link a noun to a descriptive phrase, like 'which is' or 'that'. In this talk it appears in the sense of 'another one' (อันอื่น).

senses.use: Counts or points to a thing, as in อันนี้ (this one) and อันอื่น (another one).
Links a noun to a describing phrase in formal speech, as in อันเป็นที่รัก (that which is dear).
只存在某物，别无其他，如 มีแต่ความทุกข์
满是同类的东西，含不好的意味，如 มีแต่ปัญหา

en.meaning: มีแต่ means there is only, or there is nothing but. It says that one kind of thing exists and nothing else. It often points to something unpleasant, such as suffering or problems.

senses.use: Says only one thing is present, as in มีแต่ความทุกข์ (there is only suffering).
Says something is full of one kind of thing, often bad, as in มีแต่ปัญหา (nothing but problems).

parts.note: แ 写在前面，在 ต 后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after ต.

senses.use: 指前面所说的那一刻，如 ตายไปขณะนั้น、ดับในขณะนั้น

en.meaning: ขณะนั้น means at that moment, the instant just mentioned. ขณะ is a moment or instant, and นั้น means that. It points back to a moment already described in the talk.

senses.use: Refers back to a moment just spoken of, as in ตายไปขณะนั้น (dying at that moment) or ดับในขณะนั้น.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 声调跟着前面的 ข
parts.noteEn: The tone follows the ข before it

senses.use: 偶尔发生，如 บางทีสำนึกได้
表示推测，可能如此，如 บางทีเขาอาจจะมา

en.meaning: บางทีmeans sometimes, on some occasions. It can also mean perhaps, when it expresses a guess about what may be true. Which meaning applies depends on the sentence.

senses.use: Says something happens on some occasions but not always, as in บางทีสำนึกได้ (sometimes it can realize).
Expresses a guess that something may be so, as in บางทีเขาอาจจะมา (perhaps he will come).

words.thai: คร่ำ ครวญ

senses.use: 因痛苦或后悔而悲叹诉说

en.meaning: คร่ำครวญ means to lament, to cry out and mourn in sorrow or regret. It describes someone who keeps pouring out their pain or remorse in words or sobbing. It is a strong, emotional word.

senses.use: Mourning aloud out of suffering or regret, as in คร่ำครวญว่า โถ ไม่น่าทำอย่างนี้เลย.

parts.note: ◌ำ 读 am，带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ◌ำ is read am, with a final m

parts.note: ว 与隐藏的 ั 合成元音 ua；ญ 作尾音读 n
parts.noteEn: ว joins a hidden ั to form the vowel ua; ญ as a final reads n

senses.use: 感叹词，表示惋惜、哀怜或后悔

en.meaning: โถ is an exclamation like 'alas' or 'oh dear'. It expresses pity, sorrow or regret, either for someone else or for oneself. It is a spoken interjection and is usually followed by the thing being regretted.

senses.use: Expresses regret or sorrow at something, as in โถ ไม่น่าทำอย่างนี้เลย (alas, I should not have done this).
Expresses pity for someone's misfortune.

parts.note: โ 写在前面，在 ถ 后面读
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after ถ.

senses.use: 后悔时说不应该做某事，常接动词，如 ไม่น่าทำเลย（真不该做）
指某事不值得、不划算或不令人想要，如 ไม่น่าสนใจ（不值得关注）

en.meaning: Placed before a verb, this phrase expresses regret that something was done, meaning "shouldn't have" or "never should have." It is often followed by เลย for emphasis, as in ไม่น่าทำเลย. It can also mean that something is not worth or not appealing to do, as in ไม่น่าสนใจ.

senses.use: Said in regret about something already done, as in ไม่น่าทำอย่างนี้เลย.
Says something is not worth attention, not appealing or not desirable, as in ไม่น่าสนใจ.

parts.note: ไ 写在前面，在 ม 后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after ม.

words.thai: เห็น มั้ย

senses.use: 说话者用事实印证自己的说法，引起对方注意，是否定对方时的口语提醒
字面上问对方是否看见某物或某现象

en.meaning: Literally "do you see?" It is commonly used to point out that the facts prove the speaker's point and to draw the listener's attention to it. It can also be a plain question asking whether someone sees something.

senses.use: Used to point to evidence that supports what was just said, as in เห็นมั้ย ยังรู้จักผิดชอบชั่วดี.
Literally asks whether the listener can see something.

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在 ห 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ห.

parts.note: ◌ัย 读 ai，ย 不读 y
parts.noteEn: ◌ัย reads ai; ย is not read as y.

senses.use: 接在动词后表示动作或状态出现、浮现，如 รู้สึกขึ้นมา（觉知到了）
接在 มากขึ้น 等后，表示程度逐渐加深，如 หลงมากขึ้นมากขึ้น（迷失得越来越厉害）
表示由低处向上、朝说话者方向移动，如 ขึ้นมาข้างบน（上来）

en.meaning: A word placed after a verb to show that an action or state arises or appears, as in รู้สึกขึ้นมา (to feel/become aware). It can also show a gradual increase in degree, as in มากขึ้น. As a plain motion phrase, it means coming up toward the speaker.

senses.use: After a verb, shows something arising or appearing, as in รู้จักผิดชอบชั่วดีขึ้นมาได้.
After words like มาก, shows a growing degree, as in มากขึ้นมากขึ้น.
Describes physical movement from a lower place up toward the speaker, as in ขึ้นมาข้างบน.
叫人或引起注意的口语感叹，也可表示惊讶、意外

en.meaning: A casual exclamation used to call someone or get attention. It can also express surprise or something unexpected. It is informal and not polite for formal use.

senses.use: Calls attention or shows surprise, as in เฮ้ย มันยังเหนือกว่าสัตว์นะ.

parts.note: 元音 เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel เ is written before the consonant but read after it

words.thai: เหนือ กว่า

senses.use: 指层次、地位、能力上比另一方更高、更胜一筹

en.meaning: Means being higher or better than something else in level, status or ability. It is used when comparing two things and saying one surpasses the other.

senses.use: One thing is higher in level or status than another, as in มันยังเหนือกว่าสัตว์.
One is better or stronger in ability than the other.

parts.note: 元音 เ 写在前面却在后面读；ห 不发音，只决定声调
parts.noteEn: The vowel เ is written before the consonant but read after it; ห is silent and only sets the tone

senses.use: 指布施、持戒、供养等行善积福的行为

en.meaning: To do good deeds that are believed to bring good results, such as giving, keeping precepts and making offerings. The word บุญ is merit, the good result stored up by wholesome actions. It is a very common everyday Thai Buddhist expression.

senses.use: Doing wholesome acts like giving, offering to monks or keeping precepts, as in ทำบุญแล้วอธิษฐาน.

parts.note: ำ 读 am
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am

parts.note: 尾音 ญ 读成 n
parts.noteEn: Final ญ reads n

senses.use: 表示祝愿或祈愿某事发生，如 ขอให้มีความสุข（愿你快乐）
请求对方做某事，如 ขอให้ช่วย（请帮忙）

en.meaning: Placed before a clause to express a wish or prayer that something happens, like "may...". It can also be used to ask someone to do something.

senses.use: Expresses a wish or aspiration, as in ขอให้มีความสุข or ขอให้ไปเกิดเป็น...
Asks someone to do something, as in ขอให้ช่วย.

parts.note: 元音 ใ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel ใ is written before the consonant but read after it

senses.use: 泛指白种人或欧美外国人
指水果番石榴

en.meaning: A common Thai word for a white person or a Westerner from Europe or America. It is informal and widely used. The same word also names the guava fruit.

senses.use: Refers to a Western foreigner, as in หมาฝรั่ง (a Westerner's dog).
Refers to the fruit.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 声调读法特别，读低调
parts.noteEn: The tone is irregular; read it with a low tone

senses.use: 指道路、途径，也可比喻方法，如 หาทางออก（找出路）
指某个方面或方向，如 ทางใจ（心理方面）

en.meaning: Means a road, path or route, and also a way or method of doing something. It can also mark a side or aspect of something, as in ทางใจ (on the mind side).

senses.use: A route, path or method, as in หาทางออกจากป่า or ไม่มีทางพัฒนา.
A side or area of something, as in ทางใจ.
口语中放在人名或事物名前，带随便、亲昵或轻蔑的语气

en.meaning: An informal prefix placed before a name or noun. It sounds casual and can be affectionate, rough or scornful depending on context. It is not polite in formal speech.

senses.use: Put before a person or thing, as in ไอ้หมา or ไอ้ก้อนดิน, with a casual or slightly rough tone.

parts.note: 元音 ไ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel ไ is written before the consonant but read after it

senses.use: 只有一个，常接在量词后，如 ตัวเดียว（只一只）、อย่างเดียว（只是…）
同一个，如 เดียวกัน（同一个、相同）
稍等一下、待会儿，如 เดี๋ยว（等一下）

en.meaning: Means 'only one' or 'single'. It usually follows a classifier or a word like 'kind' to say there is just one, as in 'only one animal' or 'only this and nothing else'. It also appears in เดียวกัน (the same) and, with a different tone, เดี๋ยว (wait a moment).

senses.use: Follows a classifier or อย่าง to mean just one, as in หมาตัวเดียว (only one dog) or หลงอย่างเดียว (only getting lost).
In เดียวกัน, it means one and the same, identical.
In เดี๋ยว (with a different tone), it means wait a moment or soon.

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读；ว尾音读 o
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. The final ว reads o.

senses.use: 某个时代、阶段，如 สมัยนั้น（那个时候）、สมัยพุทธกาล（佛陀时代）
合乎当下潮流，如 ทันสมัย（现代、新潮）

en.meaning: Means a period of time, an age or an era. It is often used with a demonstrative or a name to point to a time in the past, as in 'back then' or 'in the Buddha's time'.

senses.use: Points to a certain time or stage, as in สมัยนั้น (back then) or สมัยพุทธกาล (the Buddha's time).
In ทันสมัย, it means up to date or in style.

parts.note: ส后面藏着元音 a
parts.noteEn: ส has a hidden vowel a after it

parts.note: 声调跟着前面的 ส 读升调；ัย读 ai
parts.noteEn: The tone follows the ส before it, so it is rising; ัย reads ai

senses.use: 读书、学习，如 เรียนรู้（学习、了解）
对尊长或客气地说、请，如 เรียนท่าน（敬告您）

en.meaning: Means to study or to learn, especially in school or by being taught. It is also a polite word used when addressing or reporting to someone respected.

senses.use: Means to study or be taught, as in เรียนรู้ (learn and understand) or ยังเรียนอยู่ (still studying).
Used as a polite way to speak to a respected person, as in เรียนท่าน (to inform you respectfully).

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant.

senses.use: 把东西或动物从别处拿到、带到这里，如 เอามาเลี้ยง（带来养）

en.meaning: Means to take something or someone from another place and bring it here. It is often followed by what is done with it afterwards, such as keeping or raising it.

senses.use: Moves a thing or animal here from elsewhere, as in เอามาเลี้ยง (bring it to raise).

parts.note: เ写在前面却在后面读；อ只是占位的声母
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. อ is only a placeholder initial.

senses.use: 体型、年纪长大，如 โตขึ้น（长大）
从小养育到成人，如 เลี้ยงจนโต（养大）

en.meaning: Means big, or to grow up. It describes size or age, and often follows a verb to say that something has grown, as in raising a young animal until it is grown.

senses.use: Describes growing from small to adult, as in เลี้ยงจนโต (raise until grown) or โตขึ้น (grow up).
Describes a large body or size.

parts.note: โ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: โ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 心地好、待人待物温和不伤害，如 หมาใจดี（心善的狗）

en.meaning: Means kind-hearted, good-natured. It describes someone, a person or an animal, whose mind is gentle and does not want to harm others. It is made of ใจ (heart, mind) and ดี (good).

senses.use: Describes a gentle, good-natured person or animal, as in หมาใจดี (a kind dog).
Taken literally as ใจ (mind) and ดี (good), it can mean the mind has become settled or comfortable, as in 'once the mind is well'.

parts.note: ใ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: ใ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 指幼猫，ลูก 是幼崽，แมว 是猫

en.meaning: Means a kitten, a young cat. It is made of ลูก (offspring, young one) and แมว (cat).

senses.use: Refers to a young cat.

parts.note: แ写在前面却在后面读；ว尾音读 o
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it; ว as a final reads o.

senses.use: 把东西分出一份给别人，如 จัดแบ่งอาหารให้กิน（分食物给它吃）

en.meaning: Means to arrange and divide something into portions, so that each one gets a share. In this talk it is about sharing food out to another animal.

senses.use: Means to portion something and give a share to others, as in จัดแบ่งอาหารให้กิน (share food out to eat).

parts.note: ด尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

parts.note: แ写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: แ is written before the consonant but read after it.

senses.use: 吃的饭、餐食，如 กินข้าว（吃饭）
稻谷、大米这种作物或粮食

en.meaning: Means rice, and also food or a meal in general, since rice is the main food in Thai meals. กินข้าว literally means 'eat rice' and is the ordinary way to say have a meal.

senses.use: Means a meal, as in กินข้าว (eat) or หิวข้าว (hungry).
Means the grain or crop itself.

parts.note: ว 在这里当尾音，读 o/w 的音
parts.noteEn: ว works as a final consonant here and reads o/w

senses.use: 指另一只动物（ตัว 是动物量词），如 ให้ตัวอื่นกินก่อน（让别的狗先吃）

en.meaning: Means 'another one' or 'the other ones', used for animals. ตัว is the classifier for animals, and อื่น means other, so it points to a different animal from the one just spoken of.

senses.use: Points to a different animal, as in ให้ตัวอื่นกินก่อน (let the other one eat first).

parts.note: ว 是元音 ◌ัว 的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel ◌ัว, not a final consonant

parts.note: อ 只是占位的声母，不发音
parts.noteEn: อ is just a placeholder initial and is silent

senses.use: 表示事情发生之后、条件满足之后才做，如 แล้วค่อย…
表示一步一步、不急地进行，如 ค่อยๆ ทำ
用在否定前，如 ไม่ค่อย…，表示程度不高

en.meaning: A word that shows something happens step by step, slowly, or only after something else has happened. It often appears as ค่อยๆ + verb for doing things gradually and gently, or as แล้วค่อย… for 'and only then'. Before a negative, as in ไม่ค่อย, it means 'not very'.

senses.use: Shows an action done slowly, step by step, without rushing, as in ค่อยๆ ทำ or ค่อยสังเกตตัวเอง.
Shows an action happens after another is finished or a condition is met, as in แล้วมันค่อยกิน.
Placed before a negative to mean a low degree, as in ไม่ค่อยดี.

parts.note: อ 在这里是元音；ย 当尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel. Final ย reads i

senses.use: 指戒律、戒条，如 ถือศีล、ศีล 5

en.meaning: Precepts are the rules of training that keep one's actions of body and speech from harming oneself or others. The usual set is five: not killing, not stealing, not engaging in sexual misconduct, not lying, and not taking intoxicants. It is used with verbs like ถือ (to keep) and ขาด (to be broken).

senses.use: The ethical training rules, as in ศีล 5, ถือศีล, ผิดศีล, ศีลขาด.

parts.note: ศ 读 s；尾音 ล 读成 n
parts.noteEn: ศ reads s; the final ล reads as n

senses.use: 表示数量多，如 หลายคน、ทั้งหลาย
放在量词前表示不止一个但不特别多，如 หลายข้อ

en.meaning: Means 'many' or 'several'. It is used before a noun or classifier for a number that is more than one, and it also appears in ทั้งหลาย, meaning 'all' or a plural marker.

senses.use: Placed before a classifier to mean more than one but not extremely many, as in หลายข้อ, หลายคน.
In ทั้งหลาย, marks a whole group, as in สัตว์ทั้งหลาย.

parts.note: ห 不发音，只让 ล 读升调；ย 当尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only makes ล read with a rising tone; ย as a final reads i

senses.use: 计量条款、条目，如 ศีลข้อ 4
指题目、要点、项目，如 ข้อสอบ、ข้อสงสัย

en.meaning: A counting word for items in a list, such as rules, points, or questions. It is used with numbers, as in ศีลข้อ 4 (the fourth precept), or with words like หลาย for 'several items'.

senses.use: Classifier for numbered or listed things such as precepts or clauses, as in ศีลหลายข้อ, ข้อ 4.
A topic, question or issue, as in ข้อสอบ (exam question), ข้อสงสัย (doubt).

parts.note: อ 在这里是元音，读 aw
parts.noteEn: Here อ is a vowel and reads aw

senses.use: 泛指可吃的东西

en.meaning: A general, everyday word for things that can be eaten. It is made of ของ (thing) and กิน (eat), and is used for any kind of food or snack.

senses.use: Anything edible, as in เอาของกินวางไว้.

parts.note: อ 是元音，读 aw
parts.noteEn: อ is a vowel and reads aw

senses.use: 指嘴里分泌的唾液，如 น้ำลายยืด

en.meaning: The liquid in the mouth that helps with eating. It is often used in expressions about craving or strong desire for food.

senses.use: The fluid in the mouth, as in น้ำลายยืด (mouth watering).

parts.note: ◌ำ 读 am，自带 m 的尾音
parts.noteEn: ◌ำ is read am; it has its own final m

parts.note: ย 当尾音读 i
parts.noteEn: ย as a final reads i

senses.use: 指把东西拉长、伸长，如 น้ำลายยืด
指伸直身体或肢体，如 ยืดตัว、ยืดแขน
指把时间或期限拉长，如 ยืดเวลา

en.meaning: To stretch, extend or make longer. It can be used for body parts, for things that stretch, or for time. In น้ำลายยืด it describes saliva stretching, meaning one is very hungry or craving.

senses.use: Making something longer or pulling it out, as in น้ำลายยืด.
Straightening the body or a limb, as in ยืดตัว, ยืดแขน.
Making time or a deadline longer, as in ยืดเวลา.

parts.note: ด 当尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 指示离说话者较远的事物，如 นั่นคืออะไร
放在句中引出或强调后面的话，语气词式用法

en.meaning: Means 'that', pointing to something farther from the speaker than นี่. In speech it is also used in the middle of a sentence to bring in or stress what comes next, almost like 'there, you see'.

senses.use: Points to something farther away or already mentioned, as in นั่นคืออะไร.
Sentence-internal marker that draws attention to the following clause, as in นั่น พวกเล่นเน็ต….
把东西举起、端起，如 ยกของ、ยกให้
指把水平、程度提高，如 ยกระดับ、ต่อยอด
提出、举例，如 ยกตัวอย่าง

en.meaning: To lift something up or carry it up with the hands. It is also used for raising a level, and for bringing something up, as in ยกตัวอย่าง (give an example). In this talk it is used for lifting up food and giving it to someone.

senses.use: Raise or carry something with the hands, as in ยกของ, ยกให้.
Raise a level or standard, as in ยกระดับ.
Bring up something such as an example, as in ยกตัวอย่าง.

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

words.thai: อย่าง เนี้ย

senses.use: 指像眼前所说的这样，如 ทำอย่างเนี้ย

en.meaning: A spoken phrase meaning 'like this' or 'in this way', pointing to what is happening or has just been described. เนี้ย is the casual spoken form of นี้. It is often used to sum up an example.

senses.use: Points to the manner or example at hand, as in ทำอย่างเนี้ย, กินอย่างเนี้ย.

parts.note: อ 不发音，只管声调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it only sets the tone

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written before the letter but read after it

senses.use: 指前面提到的一类人或众生，如 พวกนี้ 指这些动物、这些众生

en.meaning: Means "these" or "this group", pointing back to a kind of people or beings just mentioned. It treats them together as one group. It is often used when speaking about a class of beings, such as these animals or these people.

senses.use: Points back to a group already mentioned, as in สัตว์พวกนี้ (these animals) or พวกนี้สอนไม่ได้ (this lot can't be taught).
Refers to a type of person or being as a whole, rather than to individuals.

parts.note: ว 是元音 ua 的一部分；ก 当尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ว is part of the vowel ua; ก as a final reads k

senses.use: 反复练习以培养能力或品质，如 ฝึกฝนตัวเอง

en.meaning: Means to train or practise something repeatedly in order to build a skill or a quality. It is used for deliberately working on oneself, such as training the mind or one's habits. It stresses steady, repeated effort over time.

senses.use: Practise something again and again to develop it, as in ฝึกฝนตัวเอง (train oneself).
Develop a quality or ability through long effort, as in ฝึกฝนจิตใจ (train the mind).

parts.note: ก 当尾音读 k
parts.noteEn: ก as a final reads k

parts.note: 隐藏元音 o
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel o.

senses.use: 指近处的事物或前面说到的事，如 นี่คืออะไร
句中或句末的语气词，用来提醒、强调，如 นี่นะ

en.meaning: Means "this", pointing to something near or just mentioned. It can also be a small particle in the middle or at the end of a sentence to draw attention or add emphasis. In speech it is often drawn out or softened, as in เนี่ย.

senses.use: Points to something near or already mentioned, as in นี่คืออะไร (what is this?).
Added in a sentence or at its end to draw attention, as in นี่นะ or สัตว์นี่ (as for animals…).
凭借某种条件或力量，如 อาศัยบุญเก่า
住在某处，如 อาศัยอยู่

en.meaning: Means to depend on or make use of something as a support or condition. It is also used for living in a place. The thing relied on comes right after the word.

senses.use: Depend on a condition or support, as in อาศัยบุญเก่า (relying on past merit).
Stay or dwell in a place, as in อาศัยอยู่ (to reside).

parts.note: ศ 读 s；ัย 读 ai，ย 当尾音
parts.noteEn: ศ reads s; ัย reads ai, with ย as the final

senses.use: 过去的、以前的，如 บุญเก่า
用了很久、不新的东西，如 ของเก่า

en.meaning: Means old, either from the past or no longer new. It describes things done or made earlier, and also things that have been used for a long time. In Dhamma talks, บุญเก่า means merit made in the past.

senses.use: Belongs to an earlier time, as in บุญเก่า (past merit).
Describes something used for a long time, as in ของเก่า (old things).

parts.note: เ 写在前面，和 า 合起来读 ao
parts.noteEn: เ is written first. Together with า it reads ao.

senses.use: 因长期反复做而熟悉、成自然，如 ทำจนเคยชิน

en.meaning: Means to be used to something because of doing it again and again. The repeated action becomes familiar and natural, almost automatic. It is often used for habits that build up over a long time.

senses.use: Familiar and natural from long repetition, as in ทำจนเคยชิน (do it until it's habitual).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；ย 是尾音，读 oei
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is the final and reads oei.

senses.use: 把眼睛张开，如 นอนลืมตา

en.meaning: Means to open one's eyes. It describes the physical act of opening the eyes, or being in a state where the eyes are open. It is the opposite of closing the eyes.

senses.use: Open the eyes, or have them open, as in นอนลืมตา (lie with eyes open).

parts.note: ื 读长 ue，后面藏了 อ
parts.noteEn: ื reads long ue, with a hidden อ after it

senses.use: 眼睛睁得大而清亮的样子，如 ตาแป๋ว

en.meaning: Describes eyes that are wide open, bright and alert, often with an innocent look. It is a repeated, playful-sounding word used mainly with eyes (ตาแป๋ว). It suggests someone awake and clear rather than drowsy.

senses.use: Eyes wide, clear and alert, as in ตาแป๋ว or นอนลืมตาแป๋ว ๆ (lying with eyes wide open).

parts.note: 这里写成 ๆ，意思是把前面的词再说一遍
parts.noteEn: Here it is written as ๆ, which means to say the previous word again.

senses.use: 变得和原来不同，如 เปลี่ยนแปลง
用一个换掉另一个，如 เปลี่ยนเสื้อ

en.meaning: Means to change or to replace. It can describe something becoming different from before, or swapping one thing for another. It often appears in compounds like เปลี่ยนแปลง (to change, to alter).

senses.use: Become different from before, as in เปลี่ยนแปลง or เปลี่ยนจากภพของหมา (change out of a dog's existence).
Swap one thing for another, as in เปลี่ยนเสื้อ (change clothes).

parts.note: เ 写在前面却在后面读；ย 是元音的一部分，不是尾音
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after the consonant. ย is part of the vowel, not a final.

senses.use: 带领某人去某处，如 พาเราไปเกิด

en.meaning: Means to lead, take or bring someone or something along to a place. The one doing the leading goes with the other or guides it. It can also be used when a cause, such as kamma, carries beings to a result.

senses.use: Take someone along to a place or outcome, as in กรรมพาเราไปเกิด (kamma leads us to be born).
Go together with someone, as in พาไป (take along).
指较远或前面提到的那个地方，常与「ที่ นี้」对举
作定语指那个地方、那件事，如「ที่ นั้น」放在名词后

en.meaning: A word for a place or thing that is farther away or has already been mentioned. It is often paired with ที่ นี้ (here) to mean 'here and there', 'one place or another'. It can also come after a noun to point to it as 'that'.

senses.use: Points to a place that is far away or was mentioned before, as in 'ไป เกิด ที่ นั้น' (be born there).
Placed after a noun to point to a particular place or thing.

parts.note: ั 是短元音 a，要接尾音
parts.noteEn: ั is the short vowel a; it needs a final consonant

senses.use: 指说话者所在或近处的地方，常与「ที่ นั้น」对举
指这个地方、这件事，放在名词后作指示

en.meaning: A word for the place where the speaker is, or a place close by. It is often paired with ที่ นั้น (there) to mean 'here and there', 'one place or another'. It can also come after a noun to point to it as 'this'.

senses.use: Points to where the speaker is or somewhere near, as in 'ไป เกิด ที่ นี้' (be born here).
Placed after a noun to point to this place or thing.
指巧妙的手法、办法或小手段
字面意思，指小孩玩的东西

en.meaning: A clever method, device or little move that someone uses to get something done. It can sound admiring (a skilful way of doing something) or slightly sly (a gimmick). Literally it is a child's plaything, which is its other meaning.

senses.use: A clever method or special technique someone has up their sleeve, as in 'มี ลูก เล่น'.
Literally, something a child plays with.

parts.note: 没有声调符号，但收 k 的长音节读降调
parts.noteEn: There is no tone mark, but a long syllable ending in k has a falling tone

parts.note: 写法像长 ee，实际读短 e
parts.noteEn: It looks like a long ee but is read as a short e

words.thai: สัตว์ เลี้ยง

senses.use: 指人家里或寺里饲养的动物，如猫、狗，即宠物

en.meaning: An animal that people keep and look after, such as a dog or cat at home or an animal living in a temple. It is the ordinary word for a pet or domestic animal.

senses.use: An animal kept and cared for by people, such as a dog, cat or temple animal.

parts.note: ว์ 不发音
parts.noteEn: ว์ is silent

senses.use: 指佛教的寺庙、道场
作动词，指量长短、温度等，如「วัด ไข้」量体温

en.meaning: A Buddhist temple or monastery, where monks live and people go to make merit and practise. As a verb it also means to measure something. The meaning is clear from the context.

senses.use: A Buddhist temple or monastery, as in 'สัตว์ เลี้ยง ใน วัด' (animals kept in the temple).
As a verb, to measure length, temperature and the like, as in 'วัด ไข้' (take a temperature).

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

senses.use: 指把慈爱、功德等向外传送、回向，如「แผ่ เมตตา」「แผ่ ส่วน บุญ」
指把东西摊开、展开，如「แผ่ ผ้า」

en.meaning: To spread something out or send it outward. In Dhamma talks it is used for sending out loving-kindness or sharing merit with others, as in 'แผ่ เมตตา' and 'แผ่ ส่วน บุญ'. In everyday use it also means to spread or lay something out flat.

senses.use: To send out loving-kindness or share merit with others, as in 'แผ่ ส่วน บุญ' (dedicate merit).
To lay or open something out flat, as in 'แผ่ ผ้า' (spread out cloth).

parts.note: 元音แ写在前面，在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel แ is written before the consonant but read after it

words.thai: โรง พยาบาล

senses.use: 指看病、住院治疗的地方

en.meaning: A place where sick people go to be treated and where they may stay as patients. It is the ordinary Thai word for a hospital.

senses.use: A place for medical treatment and for staying as a patient.

parts.note: 元音โ写在前面，在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel โ is written before the consonant but read after it

parts.note: 隐藏元音 a
parts.noteEn: Hidden vowel a.

parts.note: 尾音ล读 n
parts.noteEn: Final ล reads n

senses.use: 指思念远方的人或家，如「คิด ถึง บ้าน」
指想起、考虑到某事，如「ลอง คิด ถึง ...」试想一下

en.meaning: To think of someone or something far away and want to be with them again. It is the usual way to say 'miss' someone or home, as in 'คิด ถึง บ้าน'. It can also mean to think about something or bring it to mind, as in 'ลอง คิด ถึง ...' (try to imagine).

senses.use: To long for a person or place that is far away, as in 'คิด ถึง บ้าน' (miss home).
To bring something to mind or consider it, as in 'ลอง คิด ถึง ...' (just imagine).

parts.note: ด作尾音读 t
parts.noteEn: ด as a final reads t

words.thai: ท่าม กลาง

senses.use: 指处在某群体或环境的中间，如「ท่าม กลาง คน」

en.meaning: In the middle of a group or surroundings, or surrounded by them. It is followed by the people or setting a person is in, as in 'ท่าม กลาง คน' (among people).

senses.use: Being in the middle of a group or surroundings, as in 'ท่าม กลาง คน แปลก หน้า' (among strangers).

words.thai: แปลก หน้า

senses.use: 指不认识、没见过的人，如「คน แปลก หน้า」

en.meaning: Not known or not seen before, used for people whose faces you do not recognise. It is usually used with people, as in 'คน แปลก หน้า' (a stranger).

senses.use: Describes a person you do not know or have not met before, as in 'คน แปลก หน้า' (stranger).

parts.note: 元音แ写在前面，在后面读
parts.noteEn: The vowel แ is written before the consonant but read after it

parts.note: ห 不发音，只用来定声调
parts.noteEn: ห is silent and only fixes the tone

senses.use: 指布料、织物，如 ผ้าขนหนู（毛巾）、ผ้าฝ้าย（棉布）
指衣物，常与 เสื้อ 连用成 เสื้อผ้า，或指僧衣 ผ้าเหลือง
指一块抹布、围布、布巾，如 ผ้าเช็ดหน้า（手帕）、ผ้าห่ม（被子）

en.meaning: A word for cloth or fabric, and by extension a piece of cloth used for a purpose, such as a towel, blanket or robe. It also appears in the compound เสื้อผ้า (clothes). In the talk it refers to a piece of cloth or clothing that carries a person's smell.

senses.use: Fabric or material in general, e.g. ผ้าฝ้าย (cotton cloth).
Garments or robes, often with เสื้อ as เสื้อผ้า, or ผ้าเหลือง for a monk's robe.
A cloth for a particular use, e.g. ผ้าเช็ดหน้า (handkerchief), ผ้าห่ม (blanket).

words.thai: เสื้อ ผ้า

senses.use: 泛指穿的衣物，如 ซักเสื้อผ้า（洗衣服）

en.meaning: A common compound meaning clothes or clothing in general. It joins เสื้อ (shirt, garment) and ผ้า (cloth) and is used for the things people wear, such as in washing or packing clothes.

senses.use: Garments in general, e.g. ซักเสื้อผ้า (wash clothes).

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在 ส 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ส.

words.thai: อย่า เงี้ย

senses.use: 口语，举例或指示时用，如 อะไรอย่างเงี้ย（诸如此类）
口语，指方式或状态，如 ทำอย่างเงี้ย（这样做）

en.meaning: A spoken, casual form of อย่างงี้ / อย่างนี้, meaning "like this" or "like that". People use it to give an example or to point to a way or state of something. It often comes after a list or a phrase, as in อะไรอย่างเงี้ย (things like this).

senses.use: Giving an example or a type, e.g. อะไรอย่างเงี้ย (something like this, and so on).
Pointing to a manner or state, e.g. ทำอย่างเงี้ย (do it this way).

parts.note: อ 不发音，只让 ย 按中辅音定声调
parts.noteEn: อ is silent; it makes ย take its tone as a mid-class consonant

parts.note: เ 写在前面，在 ง 后面读
parts.noteEn: เ is written first but read after ง.

senses.use: 问原因，如 ทำไมถึงเป็นอย่างนั้น（为什么会那样）
表示惊讶、不解的语气，如 ทำไมเป็นอย่างนี้（怎么会这样）

en.meaning: A question word meaning "why". It asks for a reason or cause. It can also show surprise or puzzlement, like "how come".

senses.use: Asking the reason for something, e.g. ทำไมถึงเป็นอย่างนั้น (why is it like that).
Showing surprise or confusion, e.g. ทำไมเป็นอย่างนี้ (how come it is like this).

parts.note: ำ 读 am，自带 m 尾音
parts.noteEn: ำ reads am and has its own m ending

parts.note: ไ 写在前面，在 ม 后面读
parts.noteEn: ไ is written before the consonant but read after ม.

senses.use: 指想要、抓取的心所，是不善心所之一，巴利语 lobha

en.meaning: A Pali word (lobha) meaning greed, the mind's wanting and grasping at things. It is one of the unwholesome mental factors and is counted among the defilements. In the talk it is the wanting and attachment that leads a mind toward rebirth as a hungry ghost.

senses.use: The mind wanting, grasping and clinging to an object, as one of the defilements.
句末或停顿处，表示强调、追问或承接，如 แล้วคุณละ（那你呢）
作动词，指放下、断除，如 ละกิเลส（断烦恼）

en.meaning: A short particle placed at the end of a sentence or at a pause. It adds emphasis, follows up a question, or carries on from what was just said, as in แล้วคุณละ (and you?). It is also a verb meaning to abandon or let go, as in ละกิเลส (abandon defilements). In the talk it is a particle, and in แต่ละคน it means "each".

senses.use: At the end of a clause for emphasis or a follow-up question, e.g. แล้วคุณละ (and what about you).
As a verb meaning to give up or cut off, e.g. ละกิเลส (abandon defilements).

lines.text: 如果打坐了之后没有觉性的话，那也不行，
lines.thai: ถ้า นั่ง สมาธิ เรา ไม่ มี สติ กำกับ ก็ ใช้ ไม่ ได้ กลาย เป็น การ สะสม โมหะ
lines.en: If you meditate but have no mindfulness guiding it, that won't work.

lines.text: 会变成在累积痴
lines.thai: ถ้า นั่ง สมาธิ เรา ไม่ มี สติ กำกับ ก็ ใช้ ไม่ ได้ กลาย เป็น การ สะสม โมหะ
lines.en: It becomes an accumulation of delusion.

lines.text: 经行却没有觉性，那也是在累积痴，
lines.thai: เดิน จงกรม ไม่ มี สติ กำกับ มัน ก็ คือ การ สะสม โมหะ จน ที่ จะ หลง มาก ขึ้น มาก ขึ้น
lines.en: Walking meditation without mindfulness is also accumulating delusion,

lines.text: 训练后迷失得更厉害、更严重
lines.thai: เดิน จงกรม ไม่ มี สติ กำกับ มัน ก็ คือ การ สะสม โมหะ จน ที่ จะ หลง มาก ขึ้น มาก ขึ้น
lines.en: and you end up more and more lost.

1.sourceEn: Luangpu Pramote Pamojjo · live Dhamma talk 2026.07.12 · Thai audio 02:57–03:14

lines.text: 要每一天都用心修行，不要中断，
lines.thai: เรา ตั้ง ใจ ภาวนา ทุก วัน นะ อย่า ให้ ขาด ทำ ให้ ได้ เยอะ ๆ
lines.en: Practice every day, without a break,

lines.text: 要多多地去用功，有觉性
lines.thai: เรา ตั้ง ใจ ภาวนา ทุก วัน นะ อย่า ให้ ขาด ทำ ให้ ได้ เยอะ ๆ
lines.en: and do a lot of it, with mindfulness.

lines.text: 觉性是最重要的，努力地去觉知自己，
lines.thai: สติ สำคัญ ที่ สุด นะ พยายาม รู้ สึก ตัว ให้ สม่ำ เสมอ ทั้ง วัน นะ รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ
lines.en: Mindfulness matters most. Try hard to be aware of yourself,

lines.text: 要一整天都不停地去觉知自己
lines.thai: สติ สำคัญ ที่ สุด นะ พยายาม รู้ สึก ตัว ให้ สม่ำ เสมอ ทั้ง วัน นะ รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ
lines.en: all day long, without stopping.

3.sourceEn: Luangpu Pramote Pamojjo · live Dhamma talk 2026.07.12 · Thai audio 00:00–00:25

lines.text: 要每一天都用心修行，不要中断，
lines.thai: เรา ตั้ง ใจ ภาวนา ทุก วัน นะ อย่า ให้ ขาด ทำ ให้ ได้ เยอะ ๆ
lines.en: Practice every day with real intent, don't break off,

lines.text: 要多多地去用功，有觉性
lines.thai: เรา ตั้ง ใจ ภาวนา ทุก วัน นะ อย่า ให้ ขาด ทำ ให้ ได้ เยอะ ๆ
lines.en: and practise a lot, with mindfulness.

lines.text: 觉性是最重要的，努力地去觉知自己，
lines.thai: สติ สำคัญ ที่ สุด นะ พยายาม รู้ สึก ตัว ให้ สม่ำ เสมอ ทั้ง วัน นะ รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ
lines.en: Mindfulness matters most. Try hard to be aware of yourself,

lines.text: 要一整天都不停地去觉知自己
lines.thai: สติ สำคัญ ที่ สุด นะ พยายาม รู้ สึก ตัว ให้ สม่ำ เสมอ ทั้ง วัน นะ รู้ สึก ไป เรื่อย ๆ
lines.en: all day long, without stopping.

4.sourceEn: Luangpu Pramote Pamojjo · live Dhamma talk 2026.07.12 · Thai audio 00:00–00:25

lines.text: 有的人学得比较快，有的人学得比较慢
lines.thai: บาง คน ก็ เรียน รู้ ได้ เร็ว บาง คน ก็ เรียน รู้ ได้ ช้า นะ
lines.en: Some people learn quickly, and some learn slowly.

lines.text: 学得慢就要忍耐，不停地学习下去
lines.thai: เรียน รู้ ช้า ก็ อด ทน เรียน รู้ เรื่อย ๆ ไป
lines.en: If you learn slowly, have patience and keep learning.

lines.text: 有觉性去觉知自己，常常地去做，
lines.thai: มี สติ รู้ สึก ตัว ไว้ ทำ บ่อย หน่อย ก็ เก่ง
lines.en: Be mindful and aware of yourself, and do it often,

lines.text: 以后就会越来越棒的
lines.thai: มี สติ รู้ สึก ตัว ไว้ ทำ บ่อย หน่อย ก็ เก่ง
lines.en: and you'll get better and better.

5.sourceEn: Luangpu Pramote Pamojjo · live Dhamma talk 2026.07.12 · Thai audio 00:45–01:08

lines.text: 没有谁是从一开始就很棒的
